title: Performance Portability of Out-of-Kernel Optimizations on GPUs: A Molecular Docking Case Study
summary: Achieving performance portability is challenging for irregular scientific applications built as repeated multi-kernel GPU pipelines, because throughput depends on out-of-kernel decisions as much as on kernel efficiency. Using molecular docking as a representative case study, we propose an out-of-kernel tuning methodology that treats batching policy, worker concurrency, and per-worker memory allocation as explicit optimization parameters, replacing backend-dependent occupancy-driven choices with a more portable execution strategy based on explicit resource bounds. We implement this methodology in the muDock mini-app under a manager/worker execution model where multiple host workers share a GPU through independent streams. We then evaluate the methodology on NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel GPUs across CUDA, HIP, and SYCL implementations. Across all evaluated platform/backend pairs, the memory-bounded formulation exceeds the peak throughput of the occupancy-guided baseline. The fully tuned methodology improves the end-to-end throughput on all tested configurations, achieving an average speedup of 1.53x over the baseline.

title: Executable Specifications in Transition Algebra
summary: Transition Algebra can be viewed as an extension of many-sorted first-order logic by borrowing essential features from dynamic logic. This leads us to new, more expressive sentences that include transitions labelled with actions, which are built from terms using union, composition, and iteration operators. We define a suitable notion of Horn clause, develop a system of proof rules for reasoning about clauses, and subsequently show that the proof system is sound and complete. We then introduce a rewriting relation based on Horn clauses, capturing transitions along established paths expressed as actions. This rewriting relation is naturally extended to a narrowing procedure for solving queries, thereby laying foundation for logic programming in Transition Algebra. As usual, soundness for both rewriting and narrowing is straightforward, whereas completeness requires additional conditions. Finally, we provide a prototype tool that demonstrates the practical aspects and shows the effectiveness of the proposed method.

title: Sublinear Approximations for Spanning Tree Congestion
summary:
The spanning tree congestion of a connected graph \(G\) is the minimum, over all spanning trees \(T\) of \(G\), of the maximum number of edges of \(G\) crossing a cut induced by deleting an edge of \(T\). In the spanning tree congestion problem we are asked to compute a spanning tree with minimum congestion.
  We describe two sublinear-ratio approximation algorithms for the spanning tree congestion problem (STC): a simple $\Ot(n^{8/9})$-approximation, and a more involved $\Ot(n^{2/3})$-approximation, where the notation $\Ot$ hides factors polynomial in $\log n$.. Until now, no algorithm with sublinear ratio was known.
  We also prove that for any fixed $0<\varepsilon<1$, approximation of the spanning tree congestion within $2-\varepsilon$ is NP-hard. This improves the previous best known lower bound $6/5$.

title: Riemannian Optimization-based Whole-body Obstacle Avoidance for Mobile Continuum Robots in Cluttered Environments
summary: Inspired by the coordination of global motion and local shape adaptation in snakes, elephant trunks, and octopus arms, we propose a unified planning and control framework for mobile continuum robots in cluttered and confined environments. Existing approaches often address high-level path planning and local motion control separately, limiting coordinated base-arm motion, kinematic consistency, and collision avoidance. Our framework integrates long-horizon trajectory planning with real-time geometric refinement under kinematic and environmental constraints. The global layer combines A* search with minimum-jerk planning to generate smooth reference trajectories. The local layer uses a geometry-consistent inverse kinematics solver and Riemannian optimization to coordinate mobile-base motion and continuum deformation while avoiding obstacles. We evaluate the framework through simulated pipe-traversal tasks with multiple baseline planners and real-world experiments involving navigation among dense obstacles and manipulation in confined spaces. Results demonstrate improved motion consistency, feasibility, and adaptability, supporting coordinated whole-body motion of mobile continuum robots in constrained environments.

title: A Definition of Catastrophic Performance
summary: A central challenge in AI is specifying objectives that align with human preferences. While existing theoretical results elucidate how misspecification impacts performance, they typically do not distinguish between merely suboptimal and catastrophic outcomes. To enable rigorous analysis of catastrophic risk from AI misalignment, we introduce a formal definition of catastrophic performance. Our definition is based on two reference values. The first, baseline value, captures the value attained if no agent is deployed. The second, orthogonal value, captures the value of a trajectory that is unrelated to human preferences, in a sense we describe. Orthogonal value is typically far worse than baseline value. We interpret these reference values through examples in which past human activity has altered the state of the environment to human benefit. Starting at the resulting state, an AI agent is deployed with the goal of accelerating further progress. Catastrophic performance represents this agent's undoing of benefits afforded by human activity.

title: FedXCrop: Privacy-Preserving Crop Disease Detection via Federated Learning with Post-Aggregation Explainability under Non-IID Farm Distributions
comments: 26 pages. Includes 38-class crop disease classification experiments, federated learning evaluation under non-IID client distributions, and quantitative explainability analysis using Grad-CAM and SmoothGrad. Code and experimental results: https://github.com/Kriti2709/fedxcrp
summary: Deep learning can classify crop diseases accurately from benchmark leaf images, but centralized training requires farms to share raw data, and predictions without explanations offer limited support for treatment decisions. We present FedXCrop, a federated crop disease classification pipeline that quantitatively evaluates explanations of the aggregated global model. A MobileNetV2 model trained centrally on PlantVillage achieved 99.38% test accuracy (standard deviation 0.05 over three seeds) on a fixed test set of 5,428 images across 38 classes. Federated models initialized with ImageNet weights were trained for 30 rounds across five clients. FedAvg achieved 98.81% accuracy with identically distributed clients and 98.81%, 98.59%, and 97.78% under Dirichlet label skew (alpha = 1, 0.5, and 0.1, respectively). FedProx was not significantly different from FedAvg at any heterogeneity level (McNemar p > 0.3). Grad-CAM and SmoothGrad explanations were evaluated on 380 test images. Both attributed more energy to the leaf than chance (0.70-0.78 versus 0.60), while Grad-CAM maps from federated and centralized models showed Spearman correlations of 0.74-0.76. Agreement decreased as heterogeneity increased, lesion localization was only modestly above chance, and a model-randomization test indicated that SmoothGrad maps depended substantially on image structure rather than learned parameters. In this setting, label skew reduced federated accuracy by 0.6-1.6 percentage points relative to centralized training. FedAvg largely preserved Grad-CAM behavior, while FedProx provided no measurable benefit.
comment: 26 pages. Includes 38-class crop disease classification experiments, federated learning evaluation under non-IID client distributions, and quantitative explainability analysis using Grad-CAM and SmoothGrad. Code and experimental results: https://github.com/Kriti2709/fedxcrp

title: Consistent Submodular Maximization with Full Foresight
summary:
Online algorithms with bounded recourse face three intertwined obstacles: uncertainty about the future, computational limits, and a limited budget for changes. We ask a fundamental question that separates consistency from the other two: what does solution stability cost when the entire future is known and computation is unlimited?
  We answer this question for monotone submodular maximization, where an algorithm must maintain a solution of at most $k$ arrived elements, with a constant number of changes per step. We determine the optimal approximation thresholds: $3/4$ for deterministic algorithms and $ξ^\star \approx 0.7942$ for randomized algorithms. For every $\varepsilon>0$, we get within $\varepsilon$ of these thresholds with worst-case recourse polynomial in $1/\varepsilon$, independent of $k$ and the stream length. We prove matching impossibility results even for coverage functions.
  We attain the sharp bounds by optimally balancing two opposing forces: preparing for future arrivals and protecting the current solution. For randomized algorithms, we use addition robustness against prefixes of the known future, which we analyze tightly via an interval-selection problem. For deterministic algorithms, we introduce certificates, paths in a fractional relaxation that maintain high value, which we round into an update schedule.

title: Explainable Anomaly Detection in 5G Networks through Continuous Time Graphs
summary: 5G networks increasingly resemble distributed systems in their design. It then becomes crucial to move beyond traditional network-based detection methods and to explore alternative approaches. In this work, we propose a formalization of 5G network exchanges as a dynamic graph, on which we apply techniques from the field of graph-based learning to detect anomalies effectively. This representation allows for fine-grained analysis of packet-level semantic content, while simultaneously capturing sequential and topological contexts, both of which are essential for identifying sophisticated and multi-stage attacks. To assess the effectiveness of this formalism, we evaluate it with the most popular dynamic graph models, demonstrating its potential for 5G anomaly detection.

title: Understanding the Perception of Transliterated Offensive Social Media Posts Among Banglish and Hinglish Users
summary: Effective content moderation depends on understanding not just what harmful content looks like, but how users perceive and respond to it. When offensive language is written in transliterated forms such as Banglish or Hinglish (Bangla or Hindi in Latin script), it may be interpreted very differently than in native scripts, with direct consequences for whether users report, ignore, or recognize it as harmful. Yet little is known about how script choice relates to user perception, or how these perceptions vary across demographic groups. To investigate these perceptions, we conducted a user study with $310$ participants ($193$ Hindi, $60$ Bangla, $57$ Bangla-Hindi bilingual speakers) who evaluated offensive posts in native scripts and transliterations. Participants provided offensiveness scores ($4.03$ for Banglish, $3.86$ for Hinglish) to transliterated posts, yet reporting fell from $20.9\%$ (native - Bangla, Hindi) to $18.2\%$ (transliterated - Banglish, Hinglish). Ignoring remained the dominant response (range $25.38\%-44\%$ overall). Women reported at higher probability than men for native-script ($23.6\%$ vs. $17.7\%$) and showed almost identical reporting probability in comparison to men for transliterated posts ($17.5\%$ vs. $17.9\%$), and younger participants ($<40$) rated Banglish content as more offensive than older participants ($\geq 40$), (Overall offensive score: $3.99$ vs. $3.78$). These findings identify transliteration as critical blind spot for moderation, underscoring the need for linguistically sensitive approaches to online safety.

title: Separation Is a Riesz Energy: How Many Environments Does ICA Need?
summary: Can independent components be recovered when all of them are Gaussian? Yes, if their variances change across environments; but how many environments, and how many samples as the number of components $d$ grows? We answer both for the joint diagonalization of $K$ covariances. Each component has a signature, its variances across the environments. Separating component $j$ costs the Riesz 2-energy $E_j$ of this signature, a sum, over the other components, of inverse pairwise Fisher informations. For Gaussian sources no estimator in $O(d)$ beats $cE_j/(n+E_j)$ at any $n$ and $d$, and above an explicit sample size a spectral estimator attains $E_j/n$ up to a constant, for every mixing and without the signatures (given a lower bound on the pairwise information). Since signatures live in $K-1$ dimensions, the rate obeys a dimension law: $d^2/n$, $d\log d/n$ and $d/n$ for $K=2$, $3$ and $K\ge4$ well-spread environments. What counts is the dimension the signatures span, not their number, and $\log d$ well-designed environments make $d\log d$ samples suffice. Projecting the covariances onto one linear combination pays $d^2/n$ at first order instead. In simulations up to $d=1000$ the predictions hold and joint diagonalization with $K\ge4$ attains the rate once $n/d$ is in the hundreds; on task fMRI the energy says which components are hard to separate.

title: Bug2Scenario: Root-Cause-Preserving Test Scenario Amplification for Autonomous Driving Software
comments: 11 pages, 3 figures, and 2 tables. Accepted at APSEC 2026. Yuchen Cao and Zhenyu Mao contributed equally. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/YgcCoder/Bug2Sce
summary: Simulation-based fuzzing exposes autonomous driving system (ADS) failures by repeatedly mutating and executing scenarios, but converting one failure into reusable regression scenarios remains difficult. Such variants test whether the mechanism persists after software changes, for example by varying weather or actor placement while retaining a collision's actor-route conflict. We present Bug2Scenario, a root-cause-guided post-fuzzing framework. From scenario data, traces, and oracle evidence, it extracts a root-cause pattern. An LLM proposes semantic variations over actors, missions, routes, and weather. Deterministic rules construct DriveFuzz-compatible scenarios. Execution evidence and manual review assess preservation. Separating these responsibilities prevents fluency, syntax, or recurring labels from masquerading as causal evidence. Under matched seeds, six LLM backbones, candidate budget, and execution pipeline, Bug2Scenario improves strict preservation by 6.7 percentage points (p=0.104; not significant) and boundary-inclusive preservation by 10.6 points (p=0.011). Feedback helps some initially unsuccessful seeds yield a strictly preserved candidate. Seed-level stopping then avoids further API calls and simulator runs. Remaining failures reflect actor-placement constraints, simulator instability, and incomplete or conflicting causal evidence. Bug2Scenario thus produces reliable ADS regression assets. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/YgcCoder/Bug2Sce.
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, and 2 tables. Accepted at APSEC 2026. Yuchen Cao and Zhenyu Mao contributed equally. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/YgcCoder/Bug2Sce

title: Homology Features for X-Ray Hyperspectral Images Segmentation
summary: Characterizing Multi-Energy X-ray Transmission (XRT) hyperspectral images presents significant challenges for traditional classification frameworks due to high-dimensional redundancy and non-linear spectral overlaps. Although manifold learning techniques such as UMAP enhance spectral representation by preserving non-linear correlations, they do not explicitly utilize the geometric structure of the embedded manifold for segmentation. This study introduces a hybrid architecture that integrates topological features derived from persistent homology with convolutional and graph neural networks. The approach computes Vietoris-Rips persistent homology on UMAP-projected superpixel point clouds to capture H 1 cyclic structures that encode spectral heterogeneity. These topological descriptors are combined with pixel-level CNN features through a broadcasting mechanism that propagates superpixel-level graph representations to full spatial resolution. Experimental results on XRT multi-energy imagery demonstrate that the proposed hybrid model significantly outperforms both CNN-only and superpixel-pooling fusion baselines, suggesting that topological features provide complementary discriminative information to local spectralspatial descriptors.

title: Exhaustive Search Is Hard to Beat in Constant Depth for Hyperclique and Orthogonal Vectors
summary:
A hyperclique in an $r$-uniform hypergraph is a set of vertices in which every $r$-subset is an edge. A simple exhaustive search algorithm detects a hyperclique on $\ell$ vertices in an $r$-uniform hypergraph on $m$ vertices by checking all $\binom{m}{\ell}$ sets of $\ell$ vertices. This algorithm can be expressed as a depth-two circuit with at most $m^\ell$ gates and wires. For hypercliques of *constant* size, Amano (2010) showed that this circuit is almost optimal: for large $r$, constant-depth circuits need $m^{\ell(1-O(\log r/r))}$ wires. We prove that this circuit remains hard to beat even for hypercliques of *polynomial* size. More precisely, circuits of depth $h$ need $m^{Ω(\ell)}$ gates for $\ell\leq m^{1/h-\varepsilon}$, and $m^{\ell(1-O(\log r/r))}$ gates for $\ell=m^{o(1)}$ that tends to infinity.
  Our hyperclique bound and the method behind it also lead to lower bounds for two central problems of fine-grained complexity. First, we extend the bound $n^{k/4}$ of Rossman (2008) for $k$-Clique from cliques of *constant* size to cliques of *polynomial* size: circuits of depth $h$ detecting a clique on $k$ vertices in an $n$-vertex graph need $n^{Ω(k)}$ gates for $k\leq n^{1/(h-1)-\varepsilon}$. Second, a reduction of Choudhury, Limaye, Sreenivasaiah, and Srinivasan (2026) turns our hyperclique bound into a lower bound of $n^{k-\varepsilon}$ gates for $k$-Orthogonal Vectors ($k$-OV) at every fixed depth for vectors of dimension $\log^{O(1)} n$; this proves the $k$-OV Conjecture for constant-depth circuits in polylogarithmic dimension.
  Finally, for $2$-OV in logarithmic dimension, we give a simple proof that depth-three circuits need $Ω(n^2)$ wires, which answers a question of Kane and Williams (2019).

title: A Dichotomy for Terminal Cyclability
summary: Given an undirected graph $G$ and a set $R \subseteq V(G)$ of terminals, Terminal Cyclability asks whether $G$ contains a simple cycle visiting every vertex of $R$. We establish a complexity dichotomy for this problem on red-minor-closed classes of annotated graphs. In particular, we show that Terminal Cyclability is polynomial-time solvable on every such class excluding any annotated planar graph. The problem is NP-complete whenever the class contains all annotated planar graphs. More precisely, we give an $|G|^{2^{\mathbf{poly}(b)}}$-time algorithm, where $b$ is the bidimensionality of $(G,R)$. Our main technical contribution is the introduction of a weak irrelevant vertex rule. Rather than removing irrelevant vertices until the treewidth becomes constant, we only remove irrelevant vertices until the treewidth is logarithmic in the graph size. Such a weakening is necessary as a parameter-only treewidth threshold for an irrelevant vertex rule in this setting is known to be impossible to realise. Combined with a single-exponential algorithm for Terminal Cyclability parameterized by treewidth, this yields the polynomial-time algorithm for our dichotomy.

title: Zuse: A Decision Model for European Languages
summary: Decision models read a document and return a probability for each of a fixed set of options instead of generating text. Several appeared in 2026, but none has published results outside English. We describe Zuse, three decision models (4B, 9B and 27B) that train a low-rank adapter and a pointer head on frozen open-weight bases, targeting 27 European languages, and use them to study how this design behaves across languages and tasks. On a broad European suite of 11 sources excluded from training, covering 9 task groups and 27 languages, a development set that also guided model selection, the 27B model reaches 87.5% accuracy with a pooled expected calibration error of 0.016, and 0.035 when weighted per source. Post-hoc analyses of these single-seed results give three findings. First, miscalibration is structured by task rather than language: on parallel reading and topic items in 26 languages the confidence gap varies about as much as sampling noise, while across sources it spans -0.07 to +0.09, with knowledge tasks overconfident and acceptability judgements underconfident at all three sizes, so one fitted temperature cannot correct both. Second, the share of decisions that can be automated at a 5% error budget follows chance-corrected skill (Spearman 0.97 over 33 source and model pairs) more closely than raw accuracy (0.91). Third, reach beyond the training languages is set by the base model: across 210 languages, changing the training run moved scores by at most about 2 points within a size, while languages outside the base's documented list trail by 23 to 28 points at every size. On English public suites Zuse is behind Jev and Kev, including Kev models on the same bases. We also report two pitfalls in building multi-source training data: label-word collision between topic schemes, and an injection augmentation that taught a shortcut. Zuse can be tried at https://bineric.com/zuse.

title: Rubric Curriculum RL: Exploiting the Generation-Verification Gap in Non-Verifiable Domains
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has led to significant gains in math and code generation. Extending these gains to open-ended domains remains challenging: ground-truth verification is unavailable, human annotation is expensive, and learned reward models are prone to reward hacking. The generation-verification gap, where judging good outputs is easier than producing them, offers a potential path to improvement. However, rubric-based judges are often imprecise and stationary, so policies can overfit or reward hack them. We introduce Rubric Curriculum RL (RcRL), which exploits this gap without new data, human annotations, or stronger teacher models. We combine pairwise preferences over rollouts with a curriculum over rubric criteria, yielding a more discriminative signal than absolute scoring and a non-stationary objective. Whereas baselines plateau within a few hundred steps, RcRL preserves output entropy and keeps improving past 1000 steps. On creative writing, RcRL achieves a 70.5% human win rate against the base model, with gains across benchmarks and judges. On HealthBench, RcRL improves over the base model by 14.6% (full set) and 25.4% (consensus subset), outperforming all training baselines, including instance-specific rubrics.

AI.title_translation: 评分标准课程RL：在不可验证领域中利用生成-验证差距
AI.tldr: Rubric Curriculum RL (RcRL) 是一种新的强化学习方法，通过结合对轨迹的成对偏好和评分标准课程，利用生成-验证差距，无需新数据、人工标注或更强的教师模型。它在创意写作和HealthBench上均取得了显著改进，超越了基线模型。
AI.motivation: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在数学和代码生成中取得了显著进展，但将其推广到开放式领域仍面临挑战：缺乏真实性验证、人工标注昂贵以及学习到的奖励模型容易出现奖励作弊。此外，现有的基于评分标准的评估器通常不精确且是静态的，导致策略可能过拟合或对评估器进行奖励作弊。
AI.method: 本文引入了Rubric Curriculum RL (RcRL) 方法。它通过结合对轨迹的成对偏好和评分标准课程来利用生成-验证差距。这种方法提供了比绝对评分更具判别力的信号和非静态的目标，无需新的数据、人工标注或更强的教师模型。
AI.result: 与基线模型在几百步内就停滞不前不同，RcRL在超过1000步后仍能保持输出熵并持续改进。在创意写作任务中，RcRL相对于基础模型取得了70.5%的人类胜率。在HealthBench上，RcRL相对于基础模型在完整数据集上改进了14.6%，在共识子集上改进了25.4%，优于所有训练基线，包括特定实例的评分标准。
AI.conclusion: RcRL通过结合成对偏好和评分标准课程，有效地利用了生成-验证差距，在无需额外数据或教师模型的情况下，显著提升了强化学习在不可验证的开放式领域中的性能和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在数学和代码生成方面取得了显著进展。将这些进展推广到开放式领域仍然具有挑战性：缺乏真实性验证，人工标注成本高昂，以及学习到的奖励模型容易出现奖励作弊。生成-验证差距（即判断良好输出比生成它们更容易）提供了一条潜在的改进途径。然而，基于评分标准的评估器通常不精确且是静态的，因此策略可能会过拟合或对它们进行奖励作弊。我们引入了Rubric Curriculum RL（RcRL），它在没有新数据、人工标注或更强教师模型的情况下利用了这一差距。我们将对轨迹的成对偏好与评分标准课程相结合，产生了比绝对评分更具判别力的信号和非静态的目标。基线模型在几百步内就停滞不前，而RcRL保持了输出熵并持续改进超过1000步。在创意写作方面，RcRL相对于基础模型取得了70.5%的人类胜率，并在各项基准和评估器上均有提升。在HealthBench上，RcRL相对于基础模型改进了14.6%（完整集）和25.4%（共识子集），优于所有训练基线，包括特定实例的评分标准。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Rubric Curriculum RL (RcRL)，旨在解决强化学习在开放式、不可验证领域中的挑战。RcRL利用了“生成-验证差距”——即判断输出质量比生成输出更容易的现象。该方法通过结合对模型输出轨迹的成对偏好与动态调整的评分标准课程，提供了一种比传统绝对评分更具判别力的奖励信号和非静态的学习目标。RcRL无需额外数据、人工标注或更强的教师模型，便能有效避免策略过拟合和奖励作弊问题。实验结果表明，RcRL在创意写作任务中实现了70.5%的人类胜率，并在HealthBench基准测试中取得了14.6%至25.4%的显著性能提升，显著优于现有基线方法，并能保持输出多样性并持续改进。
AI.keywords: 评分标准课程RL, 强化学习, 不可验证领域, 生成-验证差距, 成对偏好
AI.comments: RcRL的创新之处在于其无需额外数据、人工标注或更强教师模型，便能有效利用生成-验证差距来提升强化学习在非可验证领域中的表现。通过引入成对偏好和评分标准课程，它成功克服了静态评分标准易导致过拟合和奖励作弊的局限性，为开放式生成任务的RL训练提供了新的思路和强大的解决方案。其在保持输出熵和长期改进方面的表现尤其值得关注，表明了其在复杂任务中的鲁棒性。

title: CAPE-JEPA - Cross-modal Adversarial Probabilistic Embedding JEPA
comments: Accepted for publication at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2026)
summary: Cross-modal remote sensing image retrieval (RS-CMIR) requires representations that are simultaneously modality-invariant and semantically discriminative, despite the profound physical gap between heterogeneous sensors such as Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and multispectral imagery. Recent JEPA-based Predictive self-supervised approaches such as X-JEPA formulate cross-modal alignment as a deterministic latent forecasting task, implicitly assuming uniform patch predictability and leaving cross-modal distributional alignment unaddressed. We propose CAPE-JEPA, a probabilistic cross-modal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture with three contributions: (i) a cross-attentional Gaussian predictor outputting per-patch parameters (mu, sigma^2) conditioned on opposite-modality context, trained via negative log-likelihood to model inherent cross-sensor prediction uncertainty; (ii) adversarial distributional regularization combining unimodal isotropic Gaussian regularization with a novel cross-modal adversarial variant that aligns modality distributions via worst-case Epps-Pulley characteristic function tests without explicit sample pairing; and (iii) in-training contrastive learning with attention-pooled heads for scene-level discriminative grounding. Evaluated on BigEarthNet-14K (BEN-14K) and fMoW across SAR, multispectral, and RGB modalities, CAPE-JEPA surpasses X-JEPA by up to 13.74 points on BEN-14K and 15.59 points on fMoW, outperforming all baselines including SkySense and CROMA across both unimodal and cross-modal directions while using fewer parameters (407.30M vs. 432.72M).

AI.title_translation: CAPE-JEPA - 跨模态对抗概率嵌入JEPA
AI.tldr: CAPE-JEPA提出了一种概率跨模态联合嵌入预测架构，通过高斯预测器、对抗性分布正则化和对比学习，解决了遥感图像跨模态检索中的不确定性和分布对齐问题。它在BEN-14K和fMoW数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 跨模态遥感图像检索（RS-CMIR）需要模态不变且语义区分的表示，以应对合成孔径雷达（SAR）和多光谱图像等异构传感器之间深刻的物理鸿沟。现有的基于JEPA的预测自监督方法（如X-JEPA）将跨模态对齐视为确定性潜在预测任务，隐含地假设补丁的可预测性一致，并且未解决跨模态分布对齐问题。
AI.method: 本文提出了CAPE-JEPA，一种概率跨模态联合嵌入预测架构，包含三项贡献：(i) 一个交叉注意力高斯预测器，根据对侧模态上下文输出每个补丁的参数（均值、方差），并通过负对数似然进行训练，以模拟固有的跨传感器预测不确定性；(ii) 对抗性分布正则化，结合单模态各向同性高斯正则化和一种新颖的跨模态对抗变体，通过最坏情况的Epps-Pulley特征函数测试（无需显式样本配对）对齐模态分布；(iii) 训练中的对比学习，利用注意力池化头部进行场景级判别性接地。
AI.result: CAPE-JEPA在BigEarthNet-14K (BEN-14K) 数据集上比X-JEPA性能提高高达13.74点，在fMoW数据集上提高15.59点。它在SAR、多光谱和RGB模态的单模态和跨模态方向上均优于包括SkySense和CROMA在内的所有基线，同时使用的参数更少（407.30M vs. 432.72M）。
AI.conclusion: CAPE-JEPA通过其概率预测、对抗性分布正则化和对比学习机制，有效解决了跨模态遥感图像检索中的模态间隙和预测不确定性问题，并在多个数据集和模态上取得了显著优于现有SOTA方法的性能。
AI.translation: 跨模态遥感图像检索（RS-CMIR）需要同时具有模态不变性和语义区分性的表示，尽管合成孔径雷达（SAR）和多光谱图像等异构传感器之间存在深刻的物理鸿沟。近期基于JEPA的预测自监督方法，例如X-JEPA，将跨模态对齐表述为确定性潜在预测任务，隐含地假设补丁的可预测性一致，并且未解决跨模态分布对齐问题。我们提出了CAPE-JEPA，一种概率跨模态联合嵌入预测架构，具有三项贡献：(i) 一个交叉注意力高斯预测器，根据对侧模态上下文输出每个补丁的参数（均值、方差），通过负对数似然进行训练，以模拟固有的跨传感器预测不确定性；(ii) 对抗性分布正则化，结合单模态各向同性高斯正则化和一种新颖的跨模态对抗变体，通过最坏情况的Epps-Pulley特征函数测试（无需显式样本配对）对齐模态分布；(iii) 训练中的对比学习，利用注意力池化头部进行场景级判别性接地。在BigEarthNet-14K (BEN-14K) 和fMoW数据集上，对SAR、多光谱和RGB模态进行评估，CAPE-JEPA在BEN-14K上比X-JEPA性能提高高达13.74点，在fMoW上提高15.59点，优于包括SkySense和CROMA在内的所有基线，无论是在单模态还是跨模态方向，同时使用的参数更少（407.30M vs. 432.72M）。
AI.summary: 本文提出了CAPE-JEPA，一种新颖的概率跨模态联合嵌入预测架构，旨在解决遥感图像跨模态检索中的模态间隙和预测不确定性。它通过引入交叉注意力高斯预测器来建模跨传感器预测不确定性，利用对抗性分布正则化对齐模态分布，并结合对比学习进行场景级判别。实验结果表明，CAPE-JEPA在BigEarthNet-14K和fMoW数据集上显著优于现有SOTA方法，且参数量更少。
AI.keywords: 跨模态检索, 概率嵌入, 对抗学习, 自监督学习, 遥感图像
AI.comments: CAPE-JEPA的创新之处在于其将概率建模引入跨模态联合嵌入预测，明确解决了跨传感器预测的不确定性。通过结合对抗性分布正则化实现无样本配对的模态分布对齐，以及利用对比学习增强判别性，该方法在理论和实践上都取得了重要进展。其在多模态遥感数据上的卓越性能和更低的参数量凸显了其在遥感图像检索领域的潜力。

title: A Polynomial Erdős-Pósa bound for Eulerian digraphs
summary:
In [Combinatorica 1996], Reed, Robertson, Seymour and Thomas proved Younger's conjecture dating back to 1973 that states that directed cycles have the Erdős-Pósa property. Specifically, they showed that every directed graph $D$ contains either $k$ arc-disjoint cycles or a set of at most $f(k)$ arcs that intersect every directed cycle. The function $f$, depending only on $k$, is however notoriously large--in fact, not even elementary. The first improvement on this function was only very recently provided by Hatzel, Kreutzer, Milani, and Muzi [FOCS 2024] who showed that $f$ can be taken to be an exponential tower of height $8$.
  In this work, we improve this function to $O(k^4)$ in the case where the digraph is Eulerian. This also answers an open question by Wahlström [Springer Monographs in Mathematics 2018] who asked explicitly when Eulerian digraphs have a polynomial Erdős-Pósa property.
  The only other known result about Erdős-Pósa on Eulerian digraphs is a result from Seymour [Combinatorica 1996] who showed that $f(k)=k$ when the Eulerian digraph admits a linkless embedding in 3-space, and such an equality is not possible for general Eulerian digraphs. We also complement our positive result, by showing that the result of Seymour cannot be extended to give a linear bound ($O(k)$) on general Eulerian digraphs, by showing that even on Eulerian digraphs the lower bound for the Erdős-Pósa property is $Ω(k \log k)$.

AI.title_translation: 欧拉有向图的多项式Erdős-Pósa界
AI.tldr: 之前的有向环Erdős-Pósa界函数值巨大，本文将欧拉有向图的界提高到$O(k^4)$，并给出了$Ω(k 	ext{ log } k)$的下界。
AI.motivation: Reed, Robertson, Seymour和Thomas在1996年证明了有向环具有Erdős-Pósa性质，但其函数$f(k)$值非常大，甚至是不可初等的。最近Hatzel等人将其改进为高度为8的指数塔。本文的动机是进一步改进欧拉有向图的这一函数界，并回答Wahlström关于欧拉有向图何时具有多项式Erdős-Pósa性质的开放问题。
AI.method: 本文通过理论证明，在欧拉有向图的情况下，将Erdős-Pósa性质的函数$f(k)$的界从指数塔高度8显著改进为多项式$O(k^4)$。此外，还通过理论分析给出了欧拉有向图下Erdős-Pósa性质的下界。
AI.result: 本文将欧拉有向图的Erdős-Pósa性质的函数$f(k)$的界改进为$O(k^4)$。同时，证明了Erdős-Pósa性质在欧拉有向图上的下界是$Ω(k 	ext{ log } k)$，这表明Seymour的线性界限无法推广到一般的欧拉有向图。
AI.conclusion: 本文为欧拉有向图提供了多项式Erdős-Pósa界，具体为$O(k^4)$，成功回答了Wahlström提出的开放问题。此外，通过建立$Ω(k 	ext{ log } k)$的下界，补充了现有研究，并证明了Seymour的线性界无法推广到一般欧拉有向图。
AI.translation:
在[Combinatorica 1996]中，Reed、Robertson、Seymour和Thomas证明了Younger早在1973年提出的猜想，即有向环具有Erdős-Pósa性质。具体而言，他们证明了每个有向图$D$包含$k$个弧不相交的环，或者一个至多包含$f(k)$条弧的集合，该集合与每个有向环相交。然而，仅取决于$k$的函数$f$是出了名的大——事实上，甚至不是初等的。该函数的第一个改进直到最近才由Hatzel、Kreutzer、Milani和Muzi在[FOCS 2024]中提供，他们表明$f$可以取为高度为8的指数塔。
在这项工作中，我们将欧拉有向图的该函数改进为$O(k^4)$。这也回答了Wahlström在[Springer Monographs in Mathematics 2018]中明确提出的关于欧拉有向图何时具有多项式Erdős-Pósa性质的开放问题。
关于欧拉有向图上Erdős-Pósa性质的唯一其他已知结果是Seymour在[Combinatorica 1996]中的一个结果，他表明当欧拉有向图允许在三维空间中进行无链接嵌入时，$f(k)=k$，并且这种等式对于一般欧拉有向图是不可能的。我们还通过证明即使在欧拉有向图上，Erdős-Pósa性质的下界也是$Ω(k 	ext{ log } k)$，从而补充了我们的积极结果，表明Seymour的结果不能扩展到一般欧拉有向图的线性界（$O(k)$）。
AI.summary: 该论文解决了长期存在的关于有向环Erdős-Pósa性质界限巨大的问题。在Reed等人最初证明该性质后，其函数$f(k)$一直被认为非常大。最近的进展将$f(k)$改进为指数塔。本文在此基础上，专门针对欧拉有向图，将函数$f(k)$的界显著改进为多项式$O(k^4)$，从而回答了Wahlström的一个开放问题。此外，论文通过建立$Ω(k 	ext{ log } k)$的下界，进一步澄清了Erdős-Pósa性质在欧拉有向图上的行为，并指出Seymour的线性界无法推广。
AI.keywords: Erdős-Pósa性质, 欧拉有向图, 有向环, 多项式界, 下界
AI.comments: 这篇论文在图论领域具有重要的理论意义。它显著改进了有向环Erdős-Pósa性质的界限，特别是将欧拉有向图的界从指数塔级别降低到多项式级别，这是一个巨大的突破。同时，对Wahlström开放问题的回答以及对下界的精确刻画，都表明了其在理论上的创新性和重要性。

title: Transversal Passivity: Dissipation Relative to Input and Output Manifolds
summary: This paper introduces transversal passivity, a local dissipation property for regulating input and output signals to prescribed manifolds. Its supply rate is built from the transverse port errors induced by nearest-point projections, so that motion along the manifolds is not penalized. We give a necessary condition and a constructive sufficient condition for the property and relate it to existing passivity notions. For feedback interconnections through negative-adjoint linear channels, power conservation no longer cancels the transverse supply. The residual is governed by compatibility defects that depend only on the channels and the prescribed manifolds, so it can be assessed before any closed-loop analysis, and it falls into a hierarchy of exact compatibility, quadratic cancellation, and nonzero quadratic residuals. Since transversal storages are only positive semidefinite, port convergence is obtained by combining compact confinement, for instance by conserved quantities, with a dissipation margin, and we identify a geometric obstruction under which no quadratic margin is available near the feasible states. A federated learning case study with heterogeneous data shows that port convergence can be certified even though no server target is compatible with the interconnection, and that the obstruction arises for a natural choice of target.

AI.title_translation: 横向无源性：相对于输入和输出流形的耗散
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了横向无源性，一种用于将输入输出信号调节到预设流形的局部耗散特性，并提供了其条件、与现有概念的关系、在反馈互连中的行为，以及通过联邦学习案例展示了其应用和局限性。
AI.motivation: 引入一种新的局部耗散特性——横向无源性，以调节输入和输出信号到预设流形，并解决现有无源性概念在特定反馈互连中不适用的问题。
AI.method: 引入横向无源性概念，其供给率基于横向端口误差构建；给出了必要的和构造性的充分条件；将其与现有无源性概念联系起来；分析了其在负伴随线性通道反馈互连中的行为；通过结合紧凑限制和耗散裕度实现端口收敛；识别了几何障碍；并通过联邦学习案例研究验证。
AI.result:
1. 引入了横向无源性，一种针对输入输出信号到预设流形的局部耗散特性。
2. 提供了横向无源性的必要条件和构造性充分条件。
3. 将其与现有无源性概念联系起来。
4. 发现负伴随线性通道反馈互连中，功率守恒不再抵消横向供给，残余由兼容性缺陷决定。
5. 残余分为精确兼容性、二次抵消和非零二次残余的层次结构。
6. 通过结合紧凑限制和耗散裕度可以实现端口收敛。
7. 识别了在可行状态附近没有二次裕度的几何障碍。
8. 联邦学习案例研究表明，即使服务器目标与互连不兼容，端口收敛也能被证明，且在自然目标选择下会出现障碍。
AI.conclusion: 横向无源性提供了一种调节信号到预设流形的新方法，其在反馈互连中的行为和端口收敛条件已被分析和验证，尽管存在几何障碍，但在联邦学习等应用中仍能有效认证端口收敛。
AI.translation: 本文引入了横向无源性，这是一种用于将输入和输出信号调节到预定流形的局部耗散特性。其供给率是由最近点投影引起的横向端口误差构建的，因此不会惩罚沿流形的运动。我们给出了该特性的必要条件和构造性充分条件，并将其与现有的无源性概念联系起来。对于通过负伴随线性通道的反馈互连，功率守恒不再抵消横向供给。残余由仅取决于通道和预定流形的兼容性缺陷决定，因此可以在任何闭环分析之前进行评估，并且它属于精确兼容性、二次抵消和非零二次残余的层次结构。由于横向储能仅是半正定的，因此通过将紧凑限制（例如通过守恒量）与耗散裕度相结合来获得端口收敛，并且我们识别出一种几何障碍，在这种障碍下，在可行状态附近没有二次裕度可用。一个具有异构数据的联邦学习案例研究表明，即使服务器目标与互连不兼容，端口收敛也可以被证明，并且在自然目标选择下会出现这种障碍。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新的局部耗散特性——横向无源性，旨在将输入输出信号调节到预设流形。该特性通过横向端口误差构建供给率，并给出了其必要和充分条件，同时与现有无源性概念建立了联系。研究发现，在负伴随线性通道的反馈互连中，功率守恒不再完全抵消横向供给，其残余由兼容性缺陷决定，并形成一个层次结构。论文进一步探讨了端口收敛的条件，指出需要结合紧凑限制和耗散裕度，并识别了一个可能阻碍二次裕度获得的几何障碍。通过一个联邦学习的案例研究，作者展示了即使在目标不兼容的情况下，也能认证端口收敛，并验证了几何障碍的出现。
AI.keywords: 横向无源性, 局部耗散, 流形调节, 反馈互连, 端口收敛
AI.comments: 这篇论文引入了一个新颖的“横向无源性”概念，扩展了传统无源性的范畴，使其能够处理信号向预设流形调节的问题。其创新点在于供给率的构建方式，以及对反馈互连中残余耗散的深入分析和分类。识别几何障碍对于理解其局限性至关重要。联邦学习的案例研究展示了该理论在实际异构系统中的潜在应用价值，特别是在处理兼容性问题时。这为复杂系统的控制和分析提供了一个新的工具。

title: HarnessFlow: MCTS-Guided Harness Optimization for LLM Agents
summary: The performance of large language model (LLM) agents depends on both the underlying model and the harness that governs interaction with tools and the environment. Yet harness design remains largely manual, and automating it requires navigating an open-ended search space through costly end-to-end evaluations. We introduce HarnessFlow, a framework for optimizing complete executable harnesses under a limited candidate-evaluation budget, with the model and task environment held fixed. HarnessFlow organizes candidates and their evaluation histories in a refinement tree, using a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-based policy to balance exploitation and exploration. A coding agent refines selected harnesses using archived code, execution feedback, and a library of reusable harness mechanisms. With 15 refinement attempts per benchmark, HarnessFlow achieves the highest mean test scores among the compared methods on six benchmarks spanning agentic tasks, coding, and web interaction. The optimized harnesses achieve an average score of 69.48%, outperforming the initial harnesses and Meta-Harness by 10.89 and 3.95 percentage points, respectively, while incurring lower average per-task execution costs than hand-engineered baselines. These results suggest that structured harness search offers a promising route toward automating the design of capable and efficient LLM agents.

AI.tldr: HarnessFlow是一个利用MCTS和编码代理来自动化优化LLM代理缰绳的框架，在多个基准测试中取得了显著的性能提升和成本降低。
AI.motivation: LLM代理的性能受限于手动设计的缰绳，其优化是一个开放式的搜索空间，需要昂贵的端到端评估。自动化缰绳设计是提升LLM代理能力的关键挑战。
AI.method: HarnessFlow框架通过MCTS策略组织候选缰绳及其评估历史，平衡探索与利用。一个编码代理利用存档代码、执行反馈和可重用机制库来改进选定的缰绳。
AI.result: 在15次优化尝试下，HarnessFlow在六个基准测试（涵盖代理任务、编码和网络交互）中取得了最高的平均测试分数。优化后的缰绳平均得分69.48%，分别比初始缰绳和Meta-Harness高出10.89和3.95个百分点，同时任务执行成本低于手工设计的基线。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的缰绳搜索为自动化设计有能力且高效的LLM代理提供了一条有前景的途径。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理的性能取决于底层模型以及管理与工具和环境交互的缰绳。然而，缰绳设计在很大程度上仍然是手动的，自动化它需要通过昂贵的端到端评估来导航一个开放式的搜索空间。我们引入了HarnessFlow，这是一个在有限的候选评估预算下优化完整可执行缰绳的框架，其中模型和任务环境保持不变。HarnessFlow在一个细化树中组织候选缰绳及其评估历史，使用基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的策略来平衡利用和探索。一个编码代理利用存档代码、执行反馈和可重用缰绳机制库来改进选定的缰绳。在每个基准测试进行15次细化尝试后，HarnessFlow在涵盖代理任务、编码和网络交互的六个基准测试中，在所有比较方法中取得了最高的平均测试分数。优化后的缰绳平均得分69.48%，分别比初始缰绳和Meta-Harness高出10.89和3.95个百分点，同时比手工设计的基线产生更低的平均每任务执行成本。这些结果表明，结构化的缰绳搜索为自动化设计有能力且高效的LLM代理提供了一条有前景的途径。
AI.summary: HarnessFlow是一个用于自动化优化LLM代理缰绳的框架。它利用MCTS策略在有限预算下指导缰绳的探索和改进，并结合一个编码代理基于反馈进行细化。实验结果表明，HarnessFlow在多个基准测试中显著提升了LLM代理的性能，并降低了执行成本，证明了结构化缰绳搜索在自动化LLM代理设计中的潜力。
AI.keywords: LLM代理, 缰绳优化, MCTS, 自动化设计, HarnessFlow
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一种新颖的自动化LLM代理缰绳优化方法HarnessFlow，通过结合MCTS的搜索能力和编码代理的精炼能力，有效解决了手动设计缰绳的痛点。其创新性在于将LLM代理的“缰绳”视为可优化的代码实体，并引入了结构化的搜索策略。该方法在性能提升和成本降低方面表现出色，为未来LLM代理的自动化设计提供了重要思路。

title: Learning Noise Optimization for Reward Alignment in Few-Step Generative Models
summary: Reward alignment for diffusion- and flow-based generative models is often formulated over stochastic trajectories, making it less suitable for few-step deterministic generators. Initial noise optimization provides a trajectory-free alternative, but existing gradient-free methods require costly per-sample search at inference. We introduce LeNO (Learning Noise Optimization), which amortizes reward-guided initial noise optimization into a learned residual transport while keeping the pretrained generator frozen. LeNO learns an anchor-conditioned distribution over noise corrections using Local GRPO and scalar rewards, eliminating iterative test-time optimization. For Gaussian initial noise with norm-preserving projection, we derive a tractable upper bound on the KL divergence between the corrected noise distribution and the original prior, providing a principled regularization objective. We evaluate LeNO on few-step text-to-image and protein structure generation, including expensive black-box designability rewards. Across both domains, LeNO improves target rewards with a single noise correction at inference while largely preserving generation quality and diversity.

AI.title_translation: 学习噪声优化以实现少步生成模型中的奖励对齐
AI.tldr: LeNO通过学习噪声优化，在少步生成模型中实现奖励对齐，避免了昂贵的推理时搜索，并保持了生成质量和多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有针对扩散和流基生成模型的奖励对齐方法通常基于随机轨迹，不适用于少步确定性生成器。虽然初始噪声优化提供了一种无轨迹替代方案，但现有的无梯度方法在推理时需要昂贵的逐样本搜索。
AI.method: 本文提出了LeNO（学习噪声优化），它将奖励引导的初始噪声优化摊销为一个学习到的残差传输，同时保持预训练的生成器冻结。LeNO使用局部GRPO和标量奖励学习锚点条件下的噪声校正分布，从而消除了迭代的测试时优化。对于具有范数保持投影的高斯初始噪声，LeNO推导了校正噪声分布与原始先验之间KL散度的可处理上限，提供了一个有原则的正则化目标。
AI.result: LeNO在少步文本到图像生成和蛋白质结构生成（包括昂贵的黑盒可设计性奖励）上进行了评估。在两个领域中，LeNO在推理时通过单次噪声校正提高了目标奖励，同时在很大程度上保持了生成质量和多样性。
AI.conclusion: LeNO通过学习高效的噪声优化过程，成功解决了少步确定性生成模型中的奖励对齐挑战，在提高目标奖励的同时，有效地保持了生成质量和多样性。
AI.translation: 扩散和基于流的生成模型的奖励对齐通常是在随机轨迹上制定的，这使得它不太适合少步确定性生成器。初始噪声优化提供了一种无轨迹的替代方案，但现有的无梯度方法在推理时需要昂贵的逐样本搜索。我们引入了LeNO（学习噪声优化），它将奖励引导的初始噪声优化摊销为一个学习到的残差传输，同时保持预训练的生成器冻结。LeNO使用局部GRPO和标量奖励学习锚点条件下的噪声校正分布，从而消除了迭代的测试时优化。对于具有范数保持投影的高斯初始噪声，我们推导了校正噪声分布与原始先验之间KL散度的可处理上限，提供了一个有原则的正则化目标。我们在少步文本到图像和蛋白质结构生成（包括昂贵的黑盒可设计性奖励）上评估了LeNO。在这两个领域中，LeNO在推理时通过单次噪声校正提高了目标奖励，同时在很大程度上保持了生成质量和多样性。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了LeNO（学习噪声优化），一种用于少步确定性生成模型中奖励对齐的新方法。与以往基于随机轨迹或昂贵的无梯度初始噪声优化方法不同，LeNO通过学习噪声校正的残差传输来摊销优化过程。LeNO利用局部GRPO和标量奖励，消除了迭代的测试时搜索，从而在推理时实现高效的单步噪声校正。LeNO在文本到图像和蛋白质结构生成任务上的评估表明，它显著提高了目标奖励，同时基本保持了生成质量和多样性。
AI.keywords: 奖励对齐, 生成模型, 噪声优化, 少步生成, 残差传输
AI.comments: LeNO为少步生成模型中的奖励对齐问题提供了一个创新且实用的解决方案。它将迭代且昂贵的优化过程转化为高效的学习过程，并且能够与冻结的生成器和黑盒奖励协同工作，这使其具有高度的实用性。基于KL散度的有原则的正则化目标也增强了方法的理论基础。

title: Analysis of Local Open-Weight LLM Agents on Vulnerability-Reproduction Tasks
comments: 35 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Preprint of a manuscript under review at the Journal of Systems and Software (Elsevier). Artefact: https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/10888
summary: Open-weight language models that fit on a single consumer GPU are becoming capable on a growing range of tasks, and they matter because they can run locally without sending the code to a hosted service. Vulnerability reproduction, turning a vulnerability description into an input that crashes the vulnerable build, is a natural target for them, since it is an automated analysis task closer to test generation than to code comprehension and it runs against a build that must be executed rather than read. In order to assess whether current models can perform it, we evaluate twelve configurations of local models, spanning three generations, two architectures and three quantization levels, on ten CyberGym vulnerability-reproduction tasks, three runs each under one harness, and release the full artefact. We show that every configuration, down to the 4B model, solves most of the six easier tasks, and configurations separate only on the remaining four. For the harder tasks, the 27B model is required. Quantization did not change what the models solved in any matched pair, but it changed how fast they got there, and the mixture of experts reached the same scores in less wall clock. We also examine the agent trajectories. Almost every run we examined, including those that fail, names the vulnerable function and states the correct hypothesis, and what separates a solved task from an unsolved one is whether that hypothesis becomes a working input.
comment: 35 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Preprint of a manuscript under review at the Journal of Systems and Software (Elsevier). Artefact: https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/10888

AI.title_translation: 本地开源大模型代理在漏洞复现任务上的分析
AI.tldr: 本地开源大模型能够执行漏洞复现任务，其中4B及以上模型可解决简单任务，27B模型则是攻克复杂任务的关键，而量化仅影响速度不影响结果。
AI.motivation: 随着可在单张消费级GPU上运行的开源大模型能力不断提升，由于其本地运行无需将代码发送至托管服务的优势，研究其在漏洞复现这一自动化分析任务上的表现显得尤为重要。
AI.method: 评估了12种本地模型配置（涵盖3个世代、2种架构和3个量化水平）在10个CyberGym漏洞复现任务上的表现，并对代理的执行轨迹进行了详细分析。
AI.result: 所有配置（小至4B模型）都能解决6个较容易的任务中的大部分；27B模型则是解决较难任务所必需的；量化不影响模型解决问题的能力，但会影响速度；混合专家模型以更少的时间达到了相同的得分；几乎所有运行（包括失败的）都能正确识别漏洞函数并提出假设，成败关键在于假设是否能转化为有效输入。
AI.conclusion: 本地开源大模型具备执行漏洞复现的能力，其中4B模型可解决多数简单任务，而27B模型对于更复杂的任务是必不可少的；量化主要影响执行速度而非解决能力，而混合专家架构在墙钟时间上更具优势。
AI.translation: 适合在单张消费级 GPU 上运行的开源语言模型在越来越多的任务上正变得越来越有能力，它们之所以重要，是因为它们可以在本地运行，而无需将代码发送到托管服务。漏洞复现——将漏洞描述转化为导致易受攻击的版本崩溃的输入——是它们的一个自然目标，因为这是一项自动化分析任务，更接近测试生成而不是代码理解，并且它是针对必须执行而不是阅读的版本运行的。为了评估当前模型是否能够执行此任务，我们评估了 12 种本地模型配置（跨越三个世代、两种架构和三个量化级别）在 10 个 CyberGym 漏洞复现任务上的表现（在一个测试框架下每项任务运行三次），并发布了完整的工件。我们表明，每种配置（小至 4B 模型）都能解决六个较简单任务中的大部分，而配置仅在其余四个任务上拉开差距。对于较难的任务，需要 27B 模型。量化并未改变模型在任何匹配对中解决的问题，但它改变了它们达到该结果的速度，混合专家模型在更短的墙钟时间内达到了相同的分数。我们还检查了代理的轨迹。我们检查的几乎每一次运行（包括失败的运行）都命名了易受攻击的函数并陈述了正确的假设，区分已解决任务和未解决任务的是该假设是否变成了一个可工作的输入。
AI.summary: 本文评估了十二种本地开源大模型配置在漏洞复现任务上的表现，发现小至4B的模型可解决多数简单任务，而27B模型对复杂任务必不可少。研究还指出，量化会影响执行速度而非最终结果，且几乎所有模型都能定位漏洞，成败取决于能否将假设转化为有效输入。
AI.keywords: 开源大模型, 漏洞复现, 本地AI代理, 代理轨迹分析, 量化影响
AI.comments: 本研究评估了本地开源大模型在漏洞复现任务上的表现，揭示了模型规模、量化水平和架构对任务成功率的影响，为本地化安全自动化分析提供了宝贵的实证依据与基准。

title: CrossPressor: Scalable Cross-View Fusion for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D-GS) becomes increasingly difficult to scale to long multi-view sequences. Anchor-based compression methods such as ZPressor alleviate representation growth by decoding Gaussians only from a compact set of anchor feature maps, but keeping these anchors fixed forces each one to aggregate an increasing number of support views. We identify this representation--fusion mismatch and introduce \textbf{CrossPressor}, a training-free method for scalable anchor-based fusion. CrossPressor preserves all decoder-facing anchor queries while constraining the view-growing support sequence through coverage-cycled evidence routing, distributing retained spatial evidence across support views and fusion layers while keeping all support views represented. Routing before K/V projection, together with joint context packing, further reduces support-side fusion cost without retraining. CrossPressor maintains reconstruction quality close to dense fusion while achieving up to $26.12\times$ faster cross-view fusion and $1.43\times$ end-to-end acceleration on long input sequences. Our project page is at: https://yuhsihu.github.io/CrossPressor.

AI.title_translation: CrossPressor：用于前馈式3D高斯泼溅的可扩展跨视角融合
AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于前馈式3D高斯泼溅的无需训练跨视角融合方法CrossPressor，通过证据路由和上下文打包解决了长序列扩展瓶颈，大幅提升了处理速度。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于锚点的压缩方法在处理长多视角序列时，固定的锚点被迫聚合越来越多的支持视图，导致了表示与融合之间的不匹配，难以扩展。
AI.method: 提出CrossPressor方法，引入覆盖循环证据路由来约束视角增长的支持序列，在K/V投影前进行路由，并结合联合上下文打包技术，无需重新训练即可减少支持侧的融合成本。
AI.result: 在保持接近密集融合重建质量的同时，实现了高达26.12倍的跨视角加速和1.43倍的长输入序列端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: CrossPressor成功解决了前馈式3D高斯泼溅在长序列处理中的可扩展性瓶颈，实现了重建质量与计算效率的双赢。
AI.translation: 前馈式3D高斯泼溅（3D-GS）在扩展到长多视角序列时变得越来越困难。诸如ZPressor之类的基于锚点的压缩方法通过仅从一组紧凑的锚点特征图中解码高斯来缓解表示增长，但保持这些锚点固定迫使每个锚点聚合越来越多的支持视图。我们识别出了这种表示与融合的不匹配，并引入了CrossPressor，这是一种用于可扩展基于锚点融合的无训练方法。CrossPressor保留了所有面向解码器的锚点查询，同时通过覆盖循环证据路由约束视图增长的支持序列，在支持视图和融合层之间分布保留的空间证据，同时保持所有支持视图都被表示。在K/V投影之前进行路由，连同联合上下文打包，进一步降低了支持侧的融合成本而无需重新训练。CrossPressor在长输入序列上实现了接近密集融合的重建质量，同时达到了高达26.12倍的更快跨视角融合和1.43倍的端到端加速。
AI.summary: 本文提出了CrossPressor，一种用于前馈式3D高斯泼溅的可扩展、无需训练的跨视角融合方法。通过覆盖循环证据路由和联合上下文打包，该方法有效缓解了长多视角序列中的表示-融合不匹配问题，大幅提升了计算效率并保持了高重建质量。
AI.keywords: 3D高斯泼溅, 前馈式, 跨视角融合, 可扩展性, 锚点压缩
AI.comments: 本文针对前馈式3D高斯泼溅在处理长多媒体序列时面临的表示-融合不匹配问题，提出了一种无需训练的跨视角融合方法CrossPressor。其核心创新在于覆盖循环证据路由和联合上下文打包，在保持重建质量的同时大幅提升了计算效率，具有很高的实用价值。

title: A Systematic Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Personalized Reasoning of Vision-Language Models
summary: People often make decisions by holistically reasoning over heterogeneous forms of personal information. In this paper, we study the relatively underexplored capability of multimodal personalized reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). To this end, we introduce \texttt{MPRBench}, a novel and comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to evaluate personalized reasoning across a wide range of tasks and real-world challenges. \texttt{MPRBench} consists of 12 sub-tasks and additionally supports interpretable analysis of representative error cases. Through extensive experiments, we find that current personalized MLLMs still struggle with personalized reasoning due to several key challenges, including inaccurate recognition of personalized concepts and sensitivity to irrelevant personal information. We hope that MPRBench will stimulate further research on personalized reasoning in MLLMs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/kkdh15/MPRBench

AI.title_translation: 一个用于评估视觉-语言模型多模态个性化推理的系统基准
AI.tldr: 本文提出了MPRBench，一个新颖全面的基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在多模态个性化推理方面的能力。实验发现，当前MLLMs在此方面仍面临挑战。
AI.motivation: 人们经常通过对异构形式的个人信息进行整体推理来做出决策。本文研究了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中相对未被充分探索的多模态个性化推理能力。
AI.method: 研究人员引入了MPRBench，这是一个新颖且全面的基准，专门设计用于评估跨广泛任务和现实世界挑战的个性化推理。MPRBench包含12个子任务，并支持对代表性错误案例进行可解释的分析。
AI.result: 通过广泛的实验，研究发现当前个性化的MLLMs在个性化推理方面仍然存在困难，主要原因包括对个性化概念的识别不准确以及对不相关个人信息的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: MPRBench有望刺激MLLMs在个性化推理方面的进一步研究。
AI.translation: 人们通常通过对异构形式的个人信息进行整体推理来做出决策。在本文中，我们研究了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中相对未被充分探索的多模态个性化推理能力。为此，我们引入了MPRBench，这是一个新颖且全面的基准，专门设计用于评估跨广泛任务和现实世界挑战的个性化推理。MPRBench包含12个子任务，并额外支持对代表性错误案例进行可解释的分析。通过广泛的实验，我们发现当前个性化的MLLMs在个性化推理方面仍然存在困难，主要原因包括对个性化概念的识别不准确以及对不相关个人信息的敏感性。我们希望MPRBench能刺激MLLMs在个性化推理方面的进一步研究。代码和数据可在https://github.com/kkdh15/MPRBench获取。
AI.summary: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中未充分探索的多模态个性化推理能力，提出了一个名为MPRBench的新型系统基准。该基准包含12个子任务，旨在全面评估MLLMs在各种任务和实际场景中的个性化推理表现，并支持错误案例分析。实验结果表明，当前MLLMs在个性化概念识别不准确和对无关信息敏感性方面存在挑战。作者希望MPRBench能推动该领域的研究进展。
AI.keywords: 多模态个性化推理, 视觉-语言模型, 基准测试, MLLMs
AI.comments: 本文通过引入MPRBench，填补了评估多模态大语言模型个性化推理能力方面的空白，具有重要的研究价值。该基准的全面性和对错误案例的可解释分析有助于深入理解当前模型的局限性，并为未来研究指明方向。其创新性在于系统地构建了一个针对特定、复杂推理能力的评估工具。

title: SonoDyno: A Sonic Dynamometer for Engine Speed and Load Estimation from Audio
summary: Controllable engine sound synthesis, Active Sound Design and engine order analysis all build on the relationship between the sound of an engine and its momentary operating state: its speed and its load. Recordings of engine sound are abundant in archives, sample packs and online video, yet they rarely carry time-aligned annotations of that state, which limits their applicability to controllable engine sound generation. We present SonoDyno, which estimates the engine speed, the cylinder count and an engine-normalized load intensity from a microphone signal alone, with no tachometer, no bus access and no prior knowledge of the engine configuration. A convolutional scorer of 124,302 parameters reads the harmonic order energy of each frame at three time-frequency resolutions to jointly score cylinder count and speed, and a decoder imposes the rotational dynamics of the engine on the speed trajectory. A second head estimates the load intensity, the position of the torque between the engine's drag floor at 0 and its full-load ceiling at 1, from the order levels at the decoded speed. On recordings of engines it has never heard, with microphone position, engine type and cylinder count unknown, SonoDyno places 93 to 97% of the frames within 2% of the true speed, identifies the cylinder count with 80% accuracy and confuses the octave on fewer than 2% of the frames. On an unseen engine of a known type, the load intensity has a mean absolute error of 0.12, and the sign of the torque, driving or braking, is right on 91% of the frames. General pitch trackers fall behind even when the harmonic order of each engine is supplied: on our validation recordings and at a tolerance of 5%, the best of them places 62% of the frames within the tolerance, against 96% for SonoDyno.

AI.title_translation: SonoDyno：用于从音频中估计发动机转速和负载的声学测功机
AI.tldr: SonoDyno 是一种仅凭音频即可高精度估计未知发动机转速、气缸数和负载强度的深度学习模型。
AI.motivation: 尽管档案、采样包和在线视频中存在大量的发动机声音录音，但它们很少带有对发动机瞬时工作状态（转速和负载）的时间对齐标注，这限制了它们在可控发动机声音生成中的应用。为此需要开发一种仅通过音频即可估计转速和负载的方法。
AI.method: 利用具有 124,302 个参数的卷积评分器，在三个时频分辨率下读取每一帧的谐波阶数能量，联合评分气缸数和转速；通过解码器施加发动机旋转动力学来修正转速轨迹；第二个头部根据解码转速下的阶数水平估计负载强度。
AI.result: 在未见过的发动机录音上，SonoDyno 将 93% 到 97% 的帧的转速误差控制在 2% 以内，气缸数识别准确率达 80%，八度音阶混淆率低于 2%。在已知类型的未见发动机上，负载强度的平均绝对误差为 0.12，扭矩正负号判断准确率为 91%，性能远超传统音高追踪器。
AI.conclusion: SonoDyno 能够仅通过麦克风信号准确估计未见过发动机的转速、气缸数和负载强度，性能显著优于传统音高追踪器。
AI.translation: 可控发动机声音合成、主动声音设计和发动机阶次分析都建立在发动机声音与其瞬时工作状态（转速和负载）之间的关系之上。档案、采样包和在线视频中的发动机声音录音非常丰富，但它们很少带有该状态的时间对齐标注，这限制了它们在可控发动机声音生成中的应用。我们提出了 SonoDyno，它仅通过麦克风信号即可估计发动机转速、气缸数和发动机归一化负载强度，无需转速计、总线访问和发动机配置的先验知识。一个拥有 124,302 个参数的卷积评分器在三个时频分辨率下读取每一帧的谐波阶次能量，以联合评分气缸数和转速，解码器则将发动机的旋转动力学强加于转速轨迹上。第二个头部根据解码转速下的阶次水平估计负载强度（即介于 0 的拖曳底限和 1 的满载顶限之间的扭矩位置）。在它从未听过的发动机录音中，麦克风位置、发动机类型和气缸数均未知，SonoDyno 将 93% 到 97% 的帧置于真实转速的 2% 以内，以 80% 的准确率识别气缸数，并且在不到 2% 的帧上混淆了八度音阶。在已知类型的未见发动机上，负载强度的平均绝对误差为 0.12，且在 91% 的帧上扭矩（驱动或制动）的正负号是正确的。即使提供了每个发动机的谐波阶次，通用的音高追踪器也落后了：在我们的验证录音中，在 5% 的容差下，其中最好的追踪器将 62% 的帧置于容差范围内，而 SonoDyno 则达到了 96%。
AI.summary: SonoDyno 是一种基于音频的声学测功机，仅通过麦克风信号即可联合估计未知发动机的转速、气缸数和负载强度，且无需任何硬件总线访问或先验知识，显著优于传统音高追踪方法。
AI.keywords: 发动机声音合成, 转速估计, 负载估计, 主动声音设计, 声学测功机
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的方法 SonoDyno，仅凭音频即可实现对发动机转速、气缸数和负载强度的精确估计。无需转速计或总线访问，且对未见过的发动机具有很强的泛化能力，在主动声音设计和引擎声音合成领域具有重要的应用价值。

title: CLEAR: Structured Specifications for Controllable Long-Horizon ML Research Engineering
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly being used to automate machine learning (ML) research workflows, ranging from code development and experiment execution to research reproduction and scientific discovery. Recent systems demonstrate that LLMs can perform substantial portions of ML research engineering with limited human intervention. These advances suggest a shift from automating individual research tasks toward automating long-horizon workflows that transform research artifacts into executable ML systems. However, ML research engineering remains substantially more difficult than isolated code generation. A research artifact typically specifies a system only implicitly through a mixture of natural-language descriptions, equations, pseudo-code, implementation details, datasets, and evaluation protocols. An agent must first infer the intended computational structure, translate it into executable components, coordinate their dependencies, and repeatedly diagnose and repair failures during execution. Consequently, the quality of the final system depends not only on code generation, but also on whether the agent can maintain a consistent representation of what should be implemented throughout this long-horizon process.

AI.title_translation: CLEAR：可控长周期机器学习研究工程的结构化规范
AI.tldr: LLM代理在自动化ML研究工程中面临挑战，因为研究产物规范模糊，需要代理在长周期过程中保持一致的系统表示。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）代理在自动化机器学习（ML）研究工作流方面取得了进展，但ML研究工程比孤立的代码生成要困难得多。研究产物通常通过自然语言描述、方程、伪代码、实现细节等隐式地指定系统，这导致代理难以推断计算结构、协调依赖关系并诊断修复故障。因此，需要代理在整个长周期过程中保持一致的表示。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理正越来越多地用于自动化机器学习（ML）研究工作流，范围从代码开发和实验执行到研究复现和科学发现。最近的系统表明，LLM可以在有限的人工干预下完成ML研究工程的很大一部分。这些进展表明，自动化正从单个研究任务转向自动化将研究产物转化为可执行ML系统的长周期工作流。然而，ML研究工程仍然比孤立的代码生成困难得多。研究产物通常通过自然语言描述、方程、伪代码、实现细节、数据集和评估协议的混合形式，隐式地指定一个系统。代理必须首先推断预期的计算结构，将其转化为可执行组件，协调它们的依赖关系，并在执行过程中反复诊断和修复故障。因此，最终系统的质量不仅取决于代码生成，还取决于代理在整个长周期过程中是否能保持对“应实现什么”的一致表示。
AI.summary: 本文指出，尽管大型语言模型（LLM）代理在自动化机器学习（ML）研究工作流方面有所发展，但自动化长周期ML研究工程仍面临重大挑战。问题在于研究产物通常以隐式方式指定系统，包含多种形式的信息，使得LLM代理难以推断计算结构、协调依赖并处理执行中的故障。因此，代理在整个过程中保持一致的系统表示对于最终系统的质量至关重要。
AI.keywords: LLM代理, 机器学习研究工程, 长周期工作流, 结构化规范, 自动化
AI.comments: 这篇论文标题暗示将提出一个名为CLEAR的结构化规范，以解决LLM代理在自动化长周期ML研究工程中面临的挑战。抽象清晰地阐述了现有方法的局限性，即研究产物缺乏明确的、可供代理直接理解的计算结构规范。这揭示了在推动LLM代理实现更复杂、更自主的ML研究方面，规范化和一致性表示的关键作用。

title: Learning Pseudo-Riemannian Manifolds for Heterophilic Graphs via Graph Signature
comments: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 41 pages, including appendix
summary: Several widely used families of Graph Neural Networks carry a positive-definite geometric prior. Graph convolution read as heat diffusion needs a positive semi-definite operator, hyperbolic models place features on positive-definite Riemannian manifolds, and dot-product and GAT-style attention scores use positive-definite inner products. On heterophilic graphs, where edges often signify dissimilarity or structural repulsion, that prior is a mismatch: no positive-definite form can assign a negative squared distance to a direction the labels separate. To measure the mismatch, we introduce the Graph Signature Index ($s_{\mathcal{G}}$), the inertia of a class-compatibility matrix built from label topology alone, and we prove that no value of the edge or node homophily index in $(0,1)$ rules out a negative eigenvalue. We then propose the Pseudo-Riemannian Attention Network (PRAT), whose attention logit is a signed squared pseudo-distance under a learnable diagonal metric initialized from $s_{\mathcal{G}}$. The design is diagnose-then-learn: the signature supplies a sign structure that unconstrained training keeps outside near-zero directions, and the projection learns the rest of the metric around it. Across fifteen node-classification benchmarks PRAT outperforms or matches the strongest heterophily-adapted models. A controlled ablation ties that performance to the sign structure itself: with architecture and protocol fixed, forbidding the metric to be indefinite costs accuracy on the graphs $s_{\mathcal{G}}$ marks as indefinite and leaves the others unchanged.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 41 pages, including appendix

AI.title_translation: 通过图签名学习异质图的伪黎曼流形
AI.tldr: 现有GNNs在异质图上表现不佳，因为它们隐含正定几何先验。本文引入图签名指数($s_{\mathcal{G}}$)来量化这种不匹配，并提出伪黎曼注意力网络(PRAT)，通过学习伪黎曼度量来解决异质性问题，在多个基准测试中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有的图神经网络（GNNs）家族（如图卷积、双曲模型、GAT）普遍带有正定几何先验。然而，在异质图（边表示不相似或排斥）中，这种正定先验是不匹配的，因为正定形式无法为标签分离的方向分配负平方距离。因此，需要一种新的方法来处理异质图的几何结构。
AI.method: 1. 引入图签名指数($s_{\mathcal{G}}$)，它是仅根据标签拓扑构建的类兼容性矩阵的惯性，用于量化几何先验与异质图的不匹配程度。2. 证明了在同质性指数为(0,1)的情况下，负特征值出现的可能性。3. 提出伪黎曼注意力网络（PRAT），其注意力logit是在可学习对角度量下的有符号平方伪距离，该度量从$s_{\mathcal{G}}$初始化。4. PRAT的设计遵循“诊断-学习”范式：签名提供符号结构，然后训练学习其余度量。
AI.result: 1. 在十五个节点分类基准测试中，PRAT的性能优于或与最强的异质性适应模型相匹配。2. 对度量进行限制，使其不能是不定型的（即强制为正定），会导致在$s_{\mathcal{G}}$标记为不定型的图上准确性下降，而在其他图上保持不变，这表明性能与符号结构本身相关。
AI.conclusion: PRAT通过引入伪黎曼几何和图签名指数，有效解决了传统GNN在异质图上几何先验不匹配的问题，并在多个基准测试中取得了SOTA或相当的性能，证明了伪黎曼度量中符号结构的重要性。
AI.translation:
**论文题目：** 通过图签名学习异质图的伪黎曼流形
**摘要翻译：** 几种广泛使用的图神经网络家族带有正定几何先验。作为热扩散的图卷积需要一个半正定算子，双曲模型将特征置于正定黎曼流形上，而点积和GAT风格的注意力分数使用正定内积。在异质图上，边通常表示不相似性或结构排斥，这种先验是不匹配的：没有正定形式可以为标签分离的方向分配负平方距离。为了衡量这种不匹配，我们引入了图签名指数（$s_{\mathcal{G}}$），它是仅根据标签拓扑构建的类兼容性矩阵的惯性，并且我们证明了在(0,1)范围内的边或节点同质性指数值都不能排除负特征值。然后，我们提出了伪黎曼注意力网络（PRAT），其注意力logit是在可学习对角度量下的有符号平方伪距离，该度量从$s_{\mathcal{G}}$初始化。该设计是先诊断后学习：签名提供了一个符号结构，非受限训练将其保持在接近零的方向之外，并且投影学习其周围的其余度量。在十五个节点分类基准测试中，PRAT的性能优于或与最强的异质性适应模型相匹配。一项受控的消融实验将这种性能与符号结构本身联系起来：在架构和协议固定的情况下，禁止度量为不定型会导致$s_{\mathcal{G}}$标记为不定型的图上准确性下降，而其他图保持不变。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新方法来解决传统图神经网络（GNNs）在异质图上由于其隐含的正定几何先验而导致的性能不佳问题。作者引入了图签名指数($s_{\mathcal{G}}$)来量化这种不匹配，并据此设计了伪黎曼注意力网络（PRAT）。PRAT利用一个可学习的对角伪黎曼度量来计算注意力分数，该度量从图签名指数初始化，从而允许负平方距离的存在。实验结果表明，PRAT在多个节点分类基准测试中超越或达到了现有最强异质图模型的性能，并通过消融实验证实了伪黎曼度量中符号结构的关键作用。
AI.keywords: 异质图, 伪黎曼流形, 图神经网络, 图签名, 注意力网络
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于认识到传统GNNs的正定几何先验在异质图上的局限性，并引入了伪黎曼几何来解决这一问题。通过图签名指数($s_{\mathcal{G}}$)来诊断图的几何特性并初始化模型，这种“诊断-学习”范式非常新颖。实验结果强有力地支持了伪黎曼度量中符号结构的重要性，为异质图学习提供了新的视角和有效的解决方案。

title: Beyond Identity Creation: Bilinear Sybil Cost in Identities and Time
comments: 16 pages, 4 figures. Main paper followed by the supplementary material. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security
summary: Sybil defenses price the creation of an identity, yet influence goes, again and again, to active identities. We study the cost of maintaining influence. A defense has a bilinear Sybil cost with ratio $A$ if keeping $s$ identities active for $T$ periods costs at least $sT/A$ honest units: the average cost per identity-window is at least $1/A$ times an honest participant's cost. Recurrence alone does not guarantee this cost. The cost can be carried over from earlier periods, shared among many identities, or be negligible when fast hardware does the work of thousands of honest devices. We give four sufficient conditions for a defense that checks every identity each period to achieve bilinear Sybil cost: identity binding, freshness, a shared deadline, and sequential, non-batchable work. They yield two guarantees: a bilinear total cost, with $A$ the speed advantage of the adversary's fastest hardware, and, because the work must be fresh and finished by a common deadline, a bound on the identities active in a period by the processors running at that time. We prove that none of the four follows from the other three. A verifiable delay function on an identity-bound input meets all four without payments, with $A$ of 2 to 8 for CPUs and about 28 for a hypothetical ASIC, against $10^3$ to $10^7$ for hash puzzles. We measure one active identity per core per period against about 80,000 under a signed heartbeat, no gain from batching up to 1,000 identities, and rejection of all tested attacks.
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures. Main paper followed by the supplementary material. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security

AI.title_translation: 超越身份创建：身份与时间中的双线性女巫攻击成本
AI.tldr: 本文研究了维持在线身份影响力的成本，并提出了实现双线性女巫攻击成本的四个条件，通过可验证延迟函数实现了高效且抗攻击的Sybil防御。
AI.motivation: 现有的女巫攻击防御机制只关注身份的创建成本，但影响力却持续流向活跃身份。本文旨在研究维持活跃身份影响力的成本，以更有效地防御女巫攻击。
AI.method: 提出了“双线性女巫攻击成本”的概念，并识别了实现这种成本的四个充分条件：身份绑定、新鲜度、共享截止日期和顺序的、不可批处理的工作。通过可验证延迟函数（VDF）在身份绑定输入上实现了这四个条件，并进行了测量和攻击测试。
AI.result: 实现了双线性总成本，其中A为对手最快硬件的速度优势。由于工作必须是新鲜的并在共同截止日期前完成，因此活跃身份的数量受限于同时运行的处理器。证明了这四个条件是相互独立的。使用VDF实现了在CPU上A为2到8，ASIC上A约为28的效率，远优于哈希难题（$10^3$到$10^7$）。测量结果显示每个核心每个周期一个活跃身份，而签名心跳机制下约为80,000个；批处理1,000个身份无增益；所有测试攻击均被拒绝。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入双线性女巫攻击成本并满足其四个充分条件，可以有效提高女巫攻击的防御能力，尤其通过可验证延迟函数实现了一种无需支付且高效的防御机制，显著限制了攻击者的活跃身份数量。
AI.translation: 女巫攻击防御机制对身份的创建进行定价，然而影响力却一次又一次地流向活跃身份。我们研究了维持影响力的成本。如果防御机制具有比率为 $A$ 的双线性女巫攻击成本，那么保持 $s$ 个身份活跃 $T$ 个周期至少需要 $sT/A$ 个诚实单位：每个身份窗口的平均成本至少是诚实参与者成本的 $1/A$ 倍。仅仅重复性并不能保证这种成本。成本可以从早期周期结转，在许多身份之间共享，或者当快速硬件完成数千个诚实设备的工作时变得微不足道。我们提出了防御机制在每个周期检查每个身份以实现双线性女巫攻击成本的四个充分条件：身份绑定、新鲜度、共享截止日期和顺序的、不可批处理的工作。它们产生了两个保证：一个双线性总成本，其中 $A$ 是对手最快硬件的速度优势，并且由于工作必须是新鲜的并在共同截止日期前完成，活跃身份的数量受限于在那个时间运行的处理器。我们证明这四个条件中的任何一个都不能由其他三个推导出来。一个基于身份绑定输入的可验证延迟函数在无需支付的情况下满足所有四个条件，对于CPU， $A$ 为2到8，对于假设的ASIC， $A$ 约为28，而哈希难题的 $A$ 值在 $10^3$ 到 $10^7$ 之间。我们测量到每个核心每个周期一个活跃身份，而签名心跳机制下约为80,000个；批处理多达1,000个身份没有增益；所有测试攻击均被拒绝。
AI.summary: 本文研究了女巫攻击防御中维持活跃身份影响力的成本问题，超越了传统上只关注身份创建成本的防御机制。作者提出了“双线性女巫攻击成本”的概念，并定义了实现这种成本的四个充分条件：身份绑定、新鲜度、共享截止日期和顺序的、不可批处理的工作。通过将可验证延迟函数应用于身份绑定输入，他们实现了一种无需支付且高效的防御方案，其攻击者速度优势比（A值）远低于哈希难题，并且能够有效地限制攻击者在每个周期内活跃的身份数量，成功抵御了多种攻击。
AI.keywords: 女巫攻击防御, 双线性成本, 可验证延迟函数, 身份绑定, 活跃身份
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将女巫攻击防御的焦点从“身份创建成本”转移到“维持活跃身份影响力的成本”，提出了“双线性女巫攻击成本”这一新颖的概念。其提出的四个充分条件为设计更鲁棒的Sybil防御机制提供了清晰的指导原则。特别值得关注的是，通过结合可验证延迟函数，该方案在不依赖支付的情况下，实现了对攻击者效率的显著限制，并在实际测量中展现出强大的防御能力，对去中心化系统的安全性和公平性具有重要意义。

title: NextGAN: Towards Simple and Scalable GAN Training for Image and Video Generation
summary: Adversarial training enables one- and few-step image and video generation, but conventional adversarial losses supervise critic values without directly specifying the gradients used to update the generator. We present NEXTGAN, which trains a scalar critic by regressing its input gradient onto displacements between independently paired reference and generated features at interpolated locations in frozen representation spaces. For a fixed generator, this regression is equivalent to an adversarial objective with a gradient-energy penalty, while the generator retains the standard potential-based GAN update. The same objective adapts pre-trained image and video generators with up to 14B parameters, without auxiliary losses, online teacher scores, or trajectories. On ImageNet $256 \times 256$, NEXTGAN achieves one-step FIDs of 2.87 with pixel-space JiT-B and 1.54 with latent-space DiT-XL/1; its adversarial form further reaches 1.36. For text-to-video generation, a single trained Wan2.1-1.3B model supports one-, two-, and four-step sampling, achieving the highest VBench total scores among the compared 1.3B methods at one and two steps. At two steps, NEXTGAN scores 83.13, exceeding rCM and AnyFlow by 1.25 and 0.47 points, respectively. Code is available at https://github.com/LINs-lab/NextGAN.git.

AI.title_translation: NextGAN：面向图像和视频生成的简单且可扩展的GAN训练方法
AI.tldr: NextGAN提出了一种基于梯度回归的新型对抗训练方法，无需辅助损失即可高效适配高达14B参数的预训练图像和视频生成模型，实现业界领先的一步/少步生成性能。
AI.motivation: 常规的对抗性损失仅监督critic的值，而没有直接指定用于更新生成器的梯度，这限制了GAN在一步和少步生成中的简单性和可扩展性。
AI.method: 训练一个标量子critic，通过将其输入梯度回归到冻结表示空间中独立配对的参考特征与生成特征在插值位置上的位移来实现；同时保留标准基于势能的GAN更新用于生成器。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256x256上，NextGAN在一步生成中取得了2.87（pixel-space JiT-B）和1.54（latent-space DiT-XL/1）的FID，其对抗形式达到1.36；在文本到视频生成中，单个Wan2.1-1.3B模型支持1、2、4步采样，在1步和2步下取得了相比同类1.3B方法更高的VBench总分（2步下达到83.13）。
AI.conclusion: NextGAN提供了一种简单、可扩展且高效的对抗训练方法，能够成功将大规模预训练的图像和视频生成模型转化为高质量的一步或少步生成器，并在多个基准测试中展现出SOTA的性能。
AI.translation: 对抗训练能够实现一步和少步的图像与视频生成，但常规的对抗损失只监督critic的值，而没有直接指定用于更新生成器的梯度。我们提出了NEXTGAN，它通过将标量子critic的输入梯度回归到冻结表示空间中插值位置的独立配对参考特征与生成特征之间的位移，来训练一个标量子critic。对于固定的生成器，这种回归等价于带有梯度能量惩罚的对抗目标，而生成器则保留标准的基于势能的GAN更新。该目标无需辅助损失、在线教师分数或轨迹，即可适配具有高达14B参数的预训练图像和视频生成器。在ImageNet 256x256上，NEXTGAN使用像素空间的JiT-B实现了2.87的一步FID，使用潜空间的DiT-XL/1实现了1.54的FID；其对抗形式进一步达到了1.36。对于文本到视频生成，单个训练好的Wan2.1-1.3B模型支持一、二和四步采样，在一步和二步测试中达到了所比较的1.3B方法中最高的VBench总分。在两步测试中，NEXTGAN得分为83.13，分别比rCM和AnyFlow高出1.25和0.47分。代码开源于 https://github.com/LINs-lab/NextGAN.git。
AI.summary: NextGAN是一种简单且可扩展的GAN训练方法，它通过梯度回归重塑了对抗损失，能够直接对具有高达14B参数的预训练图像和视频生成模型进行微调，实现高质量的少步生成。
AI.keywords: NextGAN, 生成对抗网络, 图像生成, 视频生成, 梯度回归
AI.comments: NextGAN通过将标量子critic的输入梯度回归到冻结表示空间中插值位置的参考特征与生成特征之间的位移，提出了一种简单且可扩展的GAN训练方法。该方法无需辅助损失、在线教师分数或轨迹，就能适配高达14B参数的预训练图文生成模型，在图像和视频生成任务中均取得了优异的一步/多步生成效果。

title: Consistency Learning and Distillation for One-Step MIMO-OFDM Channel Estimation
summary: Iterative neural channel estimators can improve recovery under pilot contamination, but repeated network evaluations increase inference cost. This paper develops observation-anchored consistency and Consistency Mid-Training (CMT) estimators for one-step channel estimation in multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) systems. Both estimators refine pilot-derived least-squares channel estimates in the delay-beam domain. Consistency learning couples endpoint predictions along noisy-to-clean paths. CMT then refines a compact consistency-trained student to predict a flow-matching teacher's endpoint from intermediate trajectory states. Across the evaluated SNR range, the compact CMT student reduces uncoded symbol error rate (SER) by 9.6-20.2% relative to the one-step flow-matching baseline (0.44-0.98 dB in logarithmic SER reduction), while using 74.5% fewer parameters and 73.0% fewer network multiply-accumulates.

AI.title_translation: 一步式MIMO-OFDM信道估计的一致性学习与蒸馏
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于一致性学习和蒸馏（CMT）的单步MIMO-OFDM信道估计器，它显著降低了符号错误率，同时大幅减少了模型参数和计算量。
AI.motivation: 迭代神经网络信道估计器在导频污染下能改善恢复性能，但重复的网络评估会增加推理成本。
AI.method: 本文开发了观察锚定一致性（observation-anchored consistency）和一致性中训练（CMT）估计器，用于一步式MIMO-OFDM信道估计。这两种估计器都在延迟-波束域细化了导频导出的最小二乘信道估计。一致性学习将噪声到干净路径上的端点预测进行耦合。CMT随后精炼了一个紧凑的一致性训练学生模型，以从中间轨迹状态预测流匹配教师模型的端点。
AI.result: 在评估的信噪比范围内，紧凑的CMT学生模型相对于一步式流匹配基线，将未编码符号错误率（SER）降低了9.6-20.2%（对数SER降低0.44-0.98 dB），同时使用的参数减少了74.5%，网络乘加运算减少了73.0%。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的紧凑型CMT学生模型在MIMO-OFDM信道估计中实现了显著的性能提升，同时大幅降低了计算复杂度和模型规模，有效解决了迭代估计器推理成本高的问题。
AI.translation: 迭代神经网络信道估计器可以在导频污染下改善恢复性能，但重复的网络评估会增加推理成本。本文开发了用于多输入多输出正交频分复用（MIMO-OFDM）系统一步式信道估计的观察锚定一致性（observation-anchored consistency）和一致性中训练（CMT）估计器。这两种估计器都在延迟-波束域细化了导频导出的最小二乘信道估计。一致性学习将噪声到干净路径上的端点预测进行耦合。CMT随后精炼了一个紧凑的一致性训练学生模型，以从中间轨迹状态预测流匹配教师模型的端点。在评估的信噪比范围内，紧凑的CMT学生模型相对于一步式流匹配基线，将未编码符号错误率（SER）降低了9.6-20.2%（对数SER降低0.44-0.98 dB），同时使用的参数减少了74.5%，网络乘加运算减少了73.0%。
AI.summary: 本文针对迭代神经网络信道估计器推理成本高的问题，提出了一种用于MIMO-OFDM系统的一步式信道估计方法。该方法结合了观察锚定一致性学习和一致性中训练（CMT），在延迟-波束域对最小二乘信道估计进行细化。通过将一致性训练的紧凑学生模型蒸馏，使其预测流匹配教师模型的端点，实现了显著的性能提升。实验结果表明，CMT学生模型在大幅减少参数和计算量的同时，显著降低了符号错误率。
AI.keywords: 一致性学习, 信道估计, MIMO-OFDM, 模型蒸馏, 符号错误率
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入一致性学习和蒸馏技术，在不牺牲性能的前提下，大幅降低了MIMO-OFDM信道估计的计算复杂度和模型规模，具有重要的实际应用价值。其创新点在于将一致性概念应用于一步式信道估计，并通过学生-教师模型蒸馏实现了模型紧凑化，有效解决了实时通信系统中资源受限的问题。

title: Evaluating Human-LLM Alignment on Visualization Preference
summary: There are often multiple valid visualizations, spanning different chart types, visual encodings, and aesthetic choices, that can all support a user's goal of analyzing a dataset. Determining which of these candidate visualizations is most appropriate, however, remains challenging. Prior work has leveraged expert-curated taxonomies to guide visualization design and subsequent quality evaluation, a practical evaluation model must also account for human-centric factors. Latest visualization tools integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate and refine visualizations, using LLM-as-a-judge to provide design feedback. Without a deeper understanding of whether, and in what ways, human and LLM perceptions of visualizations align, there is a real risk of deploying low-quality agents that do not reflect human judgment. We study this question through a pilot experiment - we formulate the problem as a preference task over curated chart pairs and compare the judgments of state-of-the-art vision models with those of a panel of human annotators. We establish a cautionary tale: such judges risk filtering out informative, compelling displays. We find that frontier models collapse human subjectivity, a rich signal that reveals contrasting design choices, into near-deterministic verdicts.

AI.title_translation: 评估人机大模型在可视化偏好上的一致性
AI.tldr: 本研究发现当前的大模型在判断可视化图表偏好时无法很好地对齐人类，倾向于将人类丰富的主观选择简化为确定性结论，盲目使用LLM评估图表质量存在较大风险。
AI.motivation: 由于最新的可视化工具广泛集成大语言模型并采用LLM-as-a-judge机制提供设计反馈，但目前缺乏对人类与LLM在可视化感知上是否对齐以及如何对齐的深入理解，这可能导致部署无法反映人类判断的低质量智能体。
AI.method: 通过一项试点实验，将问题构建为精心挑选的图表对的偏好任务，并对比了最先进的视觉模型与人类注释者小组的判断结果。
AI.result: 实验表明，前沿视觉模型往往会将人类关于不同设计选择的丰富主观信号转化为近乎确定性的判定，存在过滤掉信息丰富且引人注目的图表的风险。
AI.conclusion: 前沿多模态大模型在可视化偏好判断上无法很好地对齐人类，它们倾向于将人类丰富的主观偏好简化为确定性结论，因此直接使用LLM-as-a-judge评估可视化质量存在风险，可能过滤掉优秀的设计。
AI.translation: 对于支持用户分析数据集的目标，通常存在多种有效的可视化方式，涵盖不同的图表类型、视觉编码和美学选择。然而，确定这些候选可视化中哪一种最合适仍然具有挑战性。先前的工作利用专家策划的分类法来指导可视化设计和随后的质量评估，但实际的评估模型还必须考虑以人为中心的因素。最新的可视化工具集成了大语言模型（LLMs）来生成和优化可视化，并使用LLM作为裁判来提供设计反馈。如果没有深入理解人类和LLM对可视化的感知是否以及在哪些方面保持一致，就会真正存在部署不反映人类判断的低质量智能体的风险。我们通过一项试点实验研究了这个问题——我们将该问题表述为策划图表对的偏好任务，并比较了最先进的视觉模型与一组人类注释者的判断。我们得出一个警示：此类裁判存在过滤掉信息丰富、引人注目的图表的风险。我们发现，前沿模型将人类的主观性（这是一种揭示对比设计选择的丰富信号）折叠为近乎确定性的裁决。
AI.summary: 本文研究了人类与大语言模型在数据可视化偏好上的对齐情况，通过对比最先进的视觉模型与人类注释者的偏好判断，发现LLM会将人类丰富的主观设计偏好消解为单一的确定性裁决，警示了盲目使用LLM评估可视化质量的潜在风险。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 人机对齐, 数据可视化, 偏好评估, 视觉模型
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了当前大语言模型在可视化偏好判断上与人类主观性的巨大差距，强调了在可视化设计中引入人类中心因素的重要性，对未来开发对齐人类价值观的AI智能体具有重要的警示作用。

title: Quo Vadis, Driving Scene Reconstruction? Occlusion-Aware Gaussian Densification
comments: Accepted at the Workshop on Computer Vision for Developing Countries (CV4DC), ACCV 2026 (Proceedings Track)
summary: While recent feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting methods enable efficient driving-scene reconstruction from surround-view images, their reliance on a single observation fundamentally hinders novel-view synthesis. Regions occluded in the input can become visible from novel viewpoints, leaving the reconstructed Gaussians under-constrained and incomplete. Moving beyond image-space inpainting for rendered views, we introduce OccSplat, a feed-forward framework whose core contribution is Occlusion-Aware Gaussian Densification, explicitly targeting missing scene geometry rather than missing pixels. By predicting new Gaussian primitives for unsupported regions, OccSplat completes the scene directly in the 3D representation. Specifically, OccSplat first identifies occluded regions that lack Gaussian support through Gaussian Occlusion Mapping. Gaussian Occlusion Completion then generates new primitives for these regions. The predicted primitives are integrated into the original representation to improve novel-view synthesis while retaining feed-forward inference without per-scene optimization. Experiments on the nuScenes benchmark demonstrate that OccSplat improves on the compared methods and yields particularly large gains in occluded regions, leading to more accurate and visually coherent driving-scene reconstruction.
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Computer Vision for Developing Countries (CV4DC), ACCV 2026 (Proceedings Track)

AI.title_translation: 自动驾驶场景重建何去何从？遮挡感知的高斯致密化
AI.tldr: 本文提出OccSplat，一种用于自动驾驶场景重建的遮挡感知高斯致密化前馈框架，通过直接在3D空间预测遮挡区域的高斯图元，显著提升了新视点合成的质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的前馈式3D高斯散射方法由于依赖单一观测，无法有效处理新视点下可见的遮挡区域，导致重建的高斯图元受约束不足且不完整，而图像空间修补无法根本解决3D几何缺失问题。
AI.method: 提出OccSplat前馈框架，核心包含高斯遮挡映射（Gaussian Occlusion Mapping）以识别缺乏高斯支持的遮挡区域，以及高斯遮挡Completion（Gaussian Occlusion Completion）为这些区域生成新的图元，将其整合到原始表知识中。
AI.result: 在nuScenes基准测试上的实验表明，OccSplat超越了对比方法，在遮挡区域取得了巨大提升，实现了更准确、视觉更连贯的驾驶场景重建。
AI.conclusion: OccSplat通过高斯遮挡映射与补全技术，有效解决驾驶场景重建中的遮挡问题，实现了高精度、视觉连贯的3D场景重构与新视点合成。
AI.translation: 尽管最近的前馈式3D高斯散射方法能够利用环视图像进行高效的驾驶场景重建，但它们对单一观测的依赖从根本上阻碍了新视点合成。输入中被遮挡的区域在新的视点下可能会变得可见，这使得重建的高斯图元受约束不足且不完整。超越渲染视图的图像空间修补，我们引入了OccSplat，这是一个前馈框架，其核心贡献是遮挡感知高斯致密化，明确针对缺失的场景几何体而非缺失的像素。通过为不受支持的区域预测新的高斯图元，OccSplat直接在3D表示中补全场景。具体而言，OccSplat首先通过高斯遮挡映射识别缺乏高斯支持的遮挡区域。然后，高斯遮挡补全为这些区域生成新的图元。预测的图元被整合到原始表示中，以改善新视点合成，同时保留无需每场景优化的前馈推理。在nuScenes基准测试上的实验表明，OccSplat改进了对比方法，并在遮挡区域取得了特别大的增益，从而实现了更准确、视觉更连贯的驾驶场景重建。
AI.summary: 本文提出了OccSplat，一个旨在解决驾驶场景重建中遮挡问题的前馈3D高斯散射框架。通过引入遮挡感知高斯致密化技术（包含高斯遮挡映射与补全），该方法直接在3D空间中为无支撑的遮挡区域预测新的高斯图元，在无需每场景优化的情况下显著提升了新视点合成的准确性与视觉连贯性。
AI.keywords: 3D高斯散射, 驾驶场景重建, 遮挡感知, 前馈框架, 新视点合成
AI.comments: 该论文针对前馈式3D高斯散射在自动驾驶场景重建中由于遮挡导致的3D几何缺失问题，创新性地提出了遮挡感知的高斯致密化方法（OccSplat），直接在3D空间中补全缺失的几何体，显著提升了新视点合成的质量，且保持了无需每场景优化的前馈推理优势。

title: DyPSI: Dynamic Physics Sensing via Joint Field and Sensor-Trajectory Generation
summary: Physics sensing in evolving environments requires reconstructing dense spatiotemporal fields from sparse observations while adapting where future observations should be collected. Existing reconstruction and sensor-placement methods have made substantial progress, but they typically rely on static sensing assumptions: they either use a single layout across all frames or optimize placements independently at each frame, which limits their ability to produce temporally coherent sensing trajectories. We introduce DyPSI, a dynamic physics sensing framework that formulates this problem as the joint generation of future fields and sensor trajectories conditioned on historical observations. DyPSI lifts discrete sensor coordinates into continuous Sensor Position Fields, encodes fields and sensing configurations with a shared Functional Tucker representation, and trains a joint diffusion model to generate future fields and sensing trajectories simultaneously in the resulting latent space. A Gaussian-process temporal kernel correlates the perturbation injected during diffusion training, biasing the denoiser toward temporally smooth recoveries, and we further provide an analysis linking the EDM training objective to a sequence-aggregated A-optimality criterion and a kernel-induced bound on discrete trajectory variation. Experiments on turbulent flow, GLORYS12 sea-surface temperature, and 3D car aerodynamics show that DyPSI consistently outperforms static and frame-wise placement strategies, with substantial error reduction under tight sensor budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/mengqi132/DyPSI.

AI.title_translation: DyPSI：通过联合场与传感器轨迹生成的动态物理传感
AI.tldr: DyPSI是一个利用扩散模型联合生成未来物理场和连续传感器轨迹的动态传感框架，有效解决了时空演化环境下的稀疏观测重建问题。
AI.motivation: 现有重建和传感器部署方法通常依赖静态传感假设，使用单一布局或独立优化每帧布局，无法产生具有时间连贯性的传感轨迹以适应不断演化的环境。
AI.method: 将离散传感器坐标提升为连续的传感器位置场，使用共享的函数型Tucker表示编码场和传感配置，训练联合扩散模型在潜在空间中同时生成未来场和传感器轨迹，并引入高斯过程时间核以确保时间平滑性。
AI.result: 在湍流、GLORYS12海面温度和3D汽车空气动力学等实验中，DyPSI在严格的传感器预算下表现优于静态和逐帧放置策略，显著降低了重建误差。
AI.conclusion: DyPSI框架通过联合生成未来场与传感器轨迹，有效克服了传统静态或独立帧优化方法的局限性，在多个复杂物理环境测试中取得了显著的误差降低和优异的性能。
AI.translation: 演化环境中的物理传感需要从稀疏观测中重建稠密的时空场，同时适应未来观测的采集位置。现有的重建和传感器放置方法取得了实质性进展，但它们通常依赖于静态传感假设：它们要么在所有帧中使用单一布局，要么在每一帧独立优化放置，这限制了它们产生具有时间连贯性的传感轨迹的能力。我们介绍了DyPSI，这是一个动态物理传感框架，它将该问题构想为以历史观测为条件的未来场和传感器轨迹的联合生成。DyPSI将离散传感器坐标提升为连续的传感器位置场，用共享的函数型Tucker表示对场和传感配置进行编码，并训练一个联合扩散模型，在所得的潜在空间中同时生成未来场和传感器轨迹。高斯过程时间核关联了扩散训练期间注入的扰动，使去噪器偏向于时间平滑的恢复，并且我们进一步提供了将EDM训练目标与序列聚合A-最优性准则以及核诱导的离散轨迹变分界限相联系的分析。在湍流、GLORYS12海面温度和3D汽车空气动力学上的实验表明，DyPSI在严格的传感器预算下，其性能始终优于静态和逐帧放置策略，并大幅降低了误差。代码可在https://github.com/mengqi132/DyPSI获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DyPSI，一个用于动态物理传感的新框架，通过联合生成未来场和基于连续传感器位置场的传感轨迹，解决了传统方法在时空连贯性方面的局限性。
AI.keywords: 动态物理传感, 传感器轨迹生成, 函数型Tucker表示, 扩散模型, 稀疏观测重建
AI.comments: DyPSI引入了一种创新的动态物理传感框架，将连续传感器位置场与函数型Tucker表示相结合，通过联合扩散模型同时生成未来场和传感器轨迹，在时空连续性和资源受限下表现出色。

title: Building a Method: Challenges and Lessons from Developing an Impact Evaluation Framework for Public Investment in Open Source Software
comments: Working paper presented at the Open Technology Research Symposium 2026
summary: Modern societies and institutions depend on an invisible layer of open digital infrastructure: foundational, openly accessible digital technologies that support a broad range of social and economic activities. Open source software is a core component of this infrastructure, underpinning everyday technologies and critical systems in various critical sectors. As open source software becomes increasingly recognised, funded, and governed as open digital infrastructure, policymakers face growing demands for accountability, transparency, and credible evidence of impact. However, methods for evaluating public investment in open source software remain underdeveloped, with no widely accepted methodological standard. This paper describes the Sovereign Tech Agency's transition from qualitative reporting and funding-recipient self-assessment towards a mixed-methods approach that incorporates quantitative, goal-oriented evaluation to inform funding decisions. Drawing on the development of this framework, it examines its initial design, the practical and structural challenges encountered, and the responses adopted. The work identifies three central challenges: evaluation indicators must reflect heterogeneous project goals and contexts; quantitative assessment relies on fragmented and fragile data infrastructure; and observed changes before, during, and after investment do not establish causal attribution without additional research designs. The paper argues that evaluating investment in open source software is not only a methodological task but also a governance practice, dependent on sustainable open research infrastructure, community knowledge, and ongoing methodological refinement.
comment: Working paper presented at the Open Technology Research Symposium 2026

AI.title_translation: 构建方法：开发公共投资开源软件影响力评估框架的挑战与经验教训
AI.tldr: 本文探讨了公共资金资助开源软件的影响力评估框架构建，分析了实践中的三大挑战（指标多样性、数据碎片化、因果关系确认），并强调评估是关乎社区与治理的重要实践。
AI.motivation: 随着开源软件被日益公认为核心数字基础设施，政策制定者面临着对问责制、透明度和可靠影响力证据的增长需求，然而目前评估公共投资的方法尚不成熟，缺乏广泛认可的方法论标准。
AI.method: 描述了主权科技基金会（Sovereign Tech Agency）从定性报告和资助对象自我评估向混合方法（结合定量、目标导向评估）的转变，并分析了其初始设计、实践挑战及应对措施。
AI.result: 识别了三大核心挑战：评估指标必须反映异质的项目目标和背景；定量评估依赖于碎片化且脆弱的数据基础设施；投资前、中、后观察到的变化在没有额外研究设计的情况下无法建立因果归因。
AI.conclusion: 评估开源软件的公共投资不仅是一项方法论任务，更是一种治理实践，依赖于可持续的开放研究基础设施、社区知识和持续的方法论改进。
AI.translation: 现代社会和机构依赖于一层不可见的开放数字基础设施：即支持广泛社会和经济活动的基础性、开放获取的数字技术。开源软件是该基础设施的核心组成部分，支撑着各个关键领域的日常技术和关键系统。随着开源软件作为开放数字基础设施越来越得到认可、资助和治理，政策制定者面临着对问责制、透明度和可靠影响力证据的不断增长的需求。然而，评估开源软件公共投资的方法仍不成熟，且没有广泛接受的方法论标准。本文描述了主权科技基金会（Sovereign Tech Agency）从定性报告和受资助者自我评估向混合方法（结合了量化的、目标导向的评估以指导资助决策）的过渡。结合该框架的发展，本文考察了其最初的设计、遇到的实际和结构性挑战以及采取的应对措施。这项工作确定了三个核心挑战：评估指标必须反映异质的项目目标和背景；定量评估依赖于碎片化且脆弱的数据基础设施；如果没有额外的研究设计，投资前、中、后观察到的变化无法建立因果归因。本文认为，评估对开源软件的投资不仅是一项方法论任务，也是一种治理实践，它依赖于可持续的开放研究基础设施、社区知识和持续的方法论完善。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了为公共投资开源软件开发影响力评估框架的挑战与经验。文章以主权科技基金会的实践为例，介绍了从定性评估向包含定量、目标导向评估的混合方法的转变，分析了设计中的三大核心挑战（指标异质性、数据碎片化及因果归因困难），并论证了评估不仅是方法论任务，更是依赖社区知识和可持续基础设施的治理实践。
AI.keywords: 开源软件, 影响力评估, 公共投资, 数字化基础设施, 方法论框架
AI.comments: 该论文深入探讨了公共资金资助开源软件的评估框架构建，指出了当前开源基础设施评估中缺乏统一标准的痛点，并总结了主权科技基金会（Sovereign Tech Agency）在实践中的经验与挑战，对于公共政策制定和开源生态治理具有重要的参考价值。

title: MonoLaDN: Language-Guided DeNoising for Monocular 3D Object Detection
summary: Monocular 3D object detection offers a low-cost route to 3D perception, but it remains fundamentally ill-posed, since depth must be inferred from a single view. Recent transformer-based detectors learn geometry purely from image features and 3D box annotations, lacking the high-level semantic priors that vision-language models (VLMs) acquire from large-scale pretraining. VLMs offer such priors, but deploying one directly as a detector is impractical due to its heavy inference cost. We propose MonoLaDN, a language-guided denoising framework that transfers the geometric reasoning of a VLM into a monocular 3D detector while keeping the deployed model purely vision-based. During training, a frozen VLM produces structured reasoning about each object's occlusion, depth, dimension, and angle from the image and its ground-truth boxes. We encode this reasoning into queries, perturb them with noise, and train the detector to reconstruct the clean reasoning. Reconstructing the corrupted reasoning forces the detector's depth-guided features to internalize the VLM's geometric priors, so this knowledge remains available even after the reasoning path is discarded at inference, adding no latency or parameters to the deployed model. Experiments on KITTI 3D and nuScenes show that MonoLaDN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art detectors and generalizes well to new domains.

AI.title_translation: MonoLaDN：用于单目3D目标检测的语言引导去噪方法
AI.tldr: 通过在训练时引入视觉语言模型的几何推理进行去噪学习，MonoLaDN在不增加推理成本的前提下显著提升了单目3D目标检测的准确度。
AI.motivation: 单目3D目标检测由于缺乏深度信息而本质上是一个不适定问题，当前的纯视觉Transformer检测器缺乏视觉语言模型（VLM）在大规模预训练中获得的丰富高级语义和几何先验，而直接部署VLM作为检测器又面临过高的推理成本。
AI.method: 提出MonoLaDN框架，在训练阶段利用冻结的VLM生成关于物体遮挡、深度、尺寸和角度的结构化推理，将其编码为查询并通过噪声扰动，训练单目检测器去重构这些干净的推理，从而将VLM的几何先验内化到检测器的特征中；推理阶段则丢弃该推理路径，保持纯视觉检测。
AI.result: 在KITTI 3D和nuScenes数据集上的实验表明，MonoLaDN持续超越当前的先进检测器，并具备良好的跨域泛化能力。
