AI.conclusion: MonoLaDN成功将VLM的几何推理能力迁移到单目3D检测器中，在不增加推理延迟和参数的情况下显著提升了检测精度和泛化能力。
AI.translation: 单目3D目标检测提供了一条低成本的3D感知途径，但由于必须从单视图推断深度，它仍然从根本上说是不适定的。最近基于Transformer的检测器纯粹从图像特征和3D边界框标注中学习几何图形，缺乏视觉语言模型（VLM）从大规模预训练中获得的高级语义先验。VLM提供了这些先验，但由于其高昂的推理成本，直接将其部署为检测器是不切实际的。我们提出了MonoLaDN，这是一个语言引导的去噪框架，它将VLM的几何推理能力迁移到单目3D检测器中，同时保持部署的模型纯粹基于视觉。在训练期间，冻结的VLM根据图像及其真实边界框产生关于每个物体的遮挡、深度、维度和角度的结构化推理。我们将这种推理编码为查询，用噪声对其进行扰动，并训练检测器来重建干净的推理。重建损坏的推理迫使检测器的深度引导特征内化VLM的几何先验，因此即使在推理时丢弃推理路径后，这些知识仍然可用，从而不会为部署的模型增加延迟或参数。在KITTI 3D和nuScenes上的实验表明，MonoLaDN consistently（持续地）优于最先进的检测器，并且很好地泛化到新域。
AI.summary: 论文提出了MonoLaDN，一种语言引导的去噪框架，用于单目3D目标检测。它在训练时利用视觉语言模型的几何推理对检测器进行去噪训练，使检测器内化VLM的几何先验，而在推理时丢弃该路径，从而在不增加任何延迟和参数的情况下提升了检测性能。
AI.keywords: 单目3D目标检测, 视觉语言模型, 语言引导去噪, 几何先验
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地利用视觉语言模型（VLM）的大规模预训练语义和几何先验来辅助单目3D目标检测，同时通过“训练时引导、推理时丢弃”的去噪框架避免了VLM高昂的推理成本，具有很高的实用价值和创新性。

title: Clear Human Web: Where a Person Vouches for Every Client
summary: The web cannot tell whether a request comes from a person or from a program. Sites have checked the network address and puzzles in its place, and both have given way: automated traffic exceeds human traffic, and puzzles are solved for pay and by agents. This paper proposes the Clear Human Web, the part of the public web that sites open only to clients a person vouches for. A person's wallet presents their person identification data (PID) to one issuer, the only party that registers as a relying party, and receives a bounded number of blind-signed tokens, proofs of personhood that carry no attribute. The browser spends one token at each site that runs the gate, and the site learns that a valid token of a trusted issuer was spent, and nothing else. No field is added to the PID, no protocol is introduced, no site registers, and the publisher of a site holds the same proof as its readers. We define the Clear Human Web through five properties and seven adversaries, and state which properties the construction satisfies against each adversary. The identities a person can hold on one site in an epoch are bounded to k. The bound holds once the wallet limits a person to one pseudonym at the issuer. In the optimum k = 1, and a zero-knowledge proof of PID possession and a pseudonym per site replace the tokens.

AI.title_translation: 清晰人类网络：每个人为每个客户端担保的地方
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为 Clear Human Web 的网络架构，利用盲签名代币和身份验证机制，在不侵犯隐私的前提下确保网络流量来自真人担保的客户端。
AI.motivation: 当前的互联网无法区分请求是来自人类还是自动化程序，传统的网络地址检查和验证码等机制已失效，自动化流量远超人类流量且验证码易被破解，因此需要一种新的架构来确保网络客户端由真人担保。
AI.method: 使用数字钱包向唯一发行方出示个人身份数据（PID），获取无属性的盲签名代币；浏览器在支持该机制的网站上消耗代币，网站仅能验证代币有效性而无法获取其他信息；或通过零知识证明和每个网站一个化名来实现最优的 $k=1$ 方案。
AI.result: 论文定义了 Clear Human Web 的五个属性和七个对抗者，并证明了该结构在对抗这些威胁时的有效性，同时将一个人在单个网站一个时期内的身份数量限制在 $k$ 个以内（最优时 $k=1$）。
AI.conclusion: Clear Human Web 通过限制每个人在特定时期的身份数量和使用盲签名代币，在保护用户隐私的前提下有效解决了公共网络中真人与自动化流量无法区分的问题。
AI.translation: 互联网无法区分请求是来自人类还是程序。网站曾检查网络地址和验证码，但两者都已失效：自动化流量超过了人类流量，验证码也通过付费和代理被破解。本文提出了“清晰人类网络”（Clear Human Web），即公共网络中只对由真人担保的客户端开放的部分。人的数字钱包向一个发行方（唯一注册为依赖方的实体）出示其个人身份数据（PID），并接收数量有限的、不携带任何属性的盲签名代币作为人格证明。浏览器在每个运行该网关的网站上消耗一个代币，网站得知消耗了来自受信任发行方的有效代币，除此之外别无所知。PID中未添加任何字段，未引入新协议，无需网站注册，网站发布者与读者持有相同的证明。我们通过五个属性和七个对抗者定义了清晰人类网络，并说明了该结构针对每个对抗者所满足的属性。一个人在一个时期内在某个网站上可以拥有的身份被限制在 $k$ 个。一旦钱包将每个人限制在发行方处只有一个化名，该界限即成立。在最优的 $k=1$ 情况下，PID拥有的零知识证明和每个网站一个化名取代了代币。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 Clear Human Web（清晰人类网络），这是一个只对有真人担保的客户端开放的网络部分。通过使用由唯一发行方提供的盲签名代币或零知识证明，该方案在不泄露用户隐私、不增加协议复杂度的前提下，有效解决了网络流量中人机难以辨别的问题。
AI.keywords: 人证机制, 盲签名, 隐私保护, 自动化流量, 零知识证明
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的“清晰人类网络”概念，通过盲签名代币和身份验证机制来区分真人与自动化程序，同时严格保护用户隐私，具有很高的实用价值和安全性。

title: Corridor-Based Monitoring and Emergency Braking Decision for Automated Vehicle Safety
comments: Submitted to a Springer Nature journal for peer review as an extended version of a paper presented at VEHITS, for consideration in the Special Issue
summary: This paper addresses emergency-braking decisions for a redundant safety channel in automated vehicles. The channel is responsible for identifying hazards from sensor data and determining whether braking is necessary, given the constrained computational resources of embedded hardware. We present an emergency-braking approach that uses a predicted motion corridor to filter \ac{lidar} measurements and then decide whether the ego vehicle must brake. \ac{pmcm} constructs a curvature-aware boundary from the planned path and vehicle geometry so that the monitored region contains the full swept body on both straight and curved paths. \ac{gdeta} then decides whether the ego vehicle must command an emergency brake for objects inside this boundary, scoring geometric occupancy and temporal urgency independently. Hard gates permit braking when either source is conclusive; soft-OR arbitration combines partial evidence when neither gate is active. Consecutive-scan confirmation reduces sensitivity to transient measurement noise. Corridor coverage is evaluated in controlled collision simulations and recorded campus driving. Braking decisions are evaluated in Monte Carlo simulations of lead-vehicle braking and transverse-crossing encounters.
comment: Submitted to a Springer Nature journal for peer review as an extended version of a paper presented at VEHITS, for consideration in the Special Issue

AI.title_translation: 自动驾驶安全基于走廊的监测与紧急制动决策
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对自动驾驶车辆冗余安全通道的走廊式激光雷达监测与双准则紧急制动决策方案，有效平衡了计算资源与安全性。
AI.motivation: 为了解决自动驾驶汽车中冗余安全通道在受嵌入式硬件计算资源约束下，如何准确识别危险并决定是否进行紧急制动的问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种使用预测运动走廊（PMCM）过滤激光雷达测量数据的方法，并利用几何深度与时间紧急度评估算法（GDETA）独立评分，通过硬门限和软OR仲裁机制结合证据，同时采用连续扫描确认来减少瞬态测量噪声。
AI.result: 走廊覆盖率在受控碰撞仿真和实际校园驾驶记录中得到了评估，制动决策则在前方车辆制动和横向穿行场景的蒙特卡洛仿真中进行了评估，结果验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过基于预测运动走廊的激光雷达数据过滤和双准则制动决策，有效提升了自动驾驶车辆在复杂场景下的安全性和冗余通道的可靠性。
AI.translation: 本文探讨了自动驾驶汽车中冗余安全通道的紧急制动决策问题。该通道负责在嵌入式硬件受限的计算资源下，从传感器数据中识别危险并决定是否有必要进行制动。我们提出了一种紧急制动方法，该方法使用预测的运动走廊来过滤激光雷达测量值，然后决定自车是否必须制动。PMCM从规划的路径和车辆几何形状构建一个考虑曲率的边界，以便监测区域在直道和弯道上都包含完整的扫过车体。随后，GDETA根据边界内的物体独立评分几何占用率和时间紧迫性，以决定自车是否必须发出紧急制动指令。硬门限允许在任一来源具有决定性时进行制动；当两个门限都不活跃时，软OR仲裁组合部分证据。连续扫描确认减少了对瞬态测量噪声的敏感性。走廊覆盖率在受控碰撞仿真和记录的校园驾驶中进行了评估。制动决策在领先车辆制动和横向穿行遭遇的蒙特卡洛仿真中进行了评估。
AI.summary: 本文针对自动驾驶汽车的冗余安全通道，提出了一种基于预测运动走廊（PMCM）和几何时间紧急度评估（GDETA）的紧急制动决策方法。该方法通过构建曲率感知边界过滤激光雷达数据，并独立评估几何占用和时间紧迫性进行制动仲裁，同时采用连续扫描确认来抑制噪声，从而在有限计算资源的嵌入式硬件上实现高效可靠的紧急制动。
AI.keywords: 自动驾驶, 紧急制动, 激光雷达, 运动走廊, 安全冗余通道
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种针对自动驾驶冗余安全通道的走廊式监测与紧急制动决策方法，创新点在于结合了几何占用率和时间紧迫性的独立评分与软硬门限仲裁机制，并通过连续扫描确认降低了噪声敏感性，对嵌入式硬件的有限计算资源具有很高的实用价值。

title: Optimal stability estimates and preasymptotic error analysis of the CIP-FEM for the Helmholtz equation with uniaxial perfectly matched layers
summary: We study the uniaxial perfectly matched layer (UPML) problem for the Helmholtz equation in two and three dimensions and establish wavenumber-explicit stability estimates at high wavenumbers. For the full-space UPML problem, we prove the optimal stability estimate with the inf-sup constant satisfying $μ_\infty\eqsim k^{-1}$ for sufficiently large $k$ if the absorption function $σ\in W^{1,\infty}$ is a piecewise-power function of order at least one for which $\|σ'\|_{L^\infty(\{t:0<σ(t)\leqδ_*\})}\leq \varepsilon_*$, where $\varepsilon_*$ and $δ_*$ depend only on the PML parameters. Using this stability estimate, we obtain the optimal inf-sup estimate $μ_L\eqsim k^{-1}$ for the truncated UPML problem. These estimates further yield preasymptotic error estimates for a linear continuous interior penalty finite element method (CIP-FEM). Numerical simulations confirmed the theoretical predictions and demonstrated the effectiveness of CIP-FEM under high-wavenumber conditions.

AI.title_translation: 带有单轴完美匹配层的亥姆霍兹方程CIP-FEM的最优稳定性估计与预渐近误差分析
AI.tldr: 本文研究了高频亥姆霍兹方程UPML问题的最优稳定性，并证明了CIP-FEM方法的有效性与预渐近误差估计。
AI.motivation: 为了解决高频亥姆霍兹方程在无界区域求解时的波传播模拟问题，特别是在采用单轴完美匹配层（UPML）截断时的数值稳定性和误差分析问题。
AI.method: 通过理论分析建立全空间及截断UPML问题的波数显式稳定性估计（inf-sup估计），并在此基础上进行线性连续内部罚有限元法（CIP-FEM）的预渐近误差分析。
AI.result: 证明了全空间及截断UPML问题在足够大波数下具有最优的inf-sup常数 $\mu \eqsim k^{-1}$，并得出了CIP-FEM的预渐近误差估计，数值模拟验证了理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功建立了高频亥姆霍兹方程UPML问题的最优稳定性估计，并证明了CIP-FEM方法在高波数条件下的有效性。
AI.translation: 我们研究了二维和三维空间中亥姆霍兹方程的单轴完美匹配层（UPML）问题，并在高波数下建立了波数显式的稳定性估计。对于全空间UPML问题，如果吸收函数 $\sigma \in W^{1,\infty}$ 是至少一阶的分段幂函数，且满足一定条件，我们证明了当波数 $k$ 足够大时，inf-sup常数满足 $\mu_\infty \eqsim k^{-1}$ 的最优稳定性估计。利用此稳定性估计，我们得到了截断UPML问题的最优inf-sup估计 $\mu_L \eqsim k^{-1}$。这些估计进一步给出了线性连续内部罚有限元法（CIP-FEM）的预渐近误差估计。数值模拟证实了理论预测，并展示了CIP-FEM在高波数条件下的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文研究了二维和三维空间中带有单轴完美匹配层（UPML）的亥姆霍兹方程，建立了高波数下的显式稳定性估计。通过对全空间和截断UPML问题的分析，获得了最优的inf-sup估计，进而导出了连续内部罚有限元法（CIP-FEM）的预渐近误差估计，并通过数值模拟验证了理论结果的高效性。
AI.keywords: Helmholtz equation, UPML, CIP-FEM, stability estimates, high wavenumber
AI.comments: 本文针对带有单轴完美匹配层（UPML）的高频亥姆霍兹方程，建立了波数显式的最优稳定性估计，并进一步推导了连续内部罚有限元法（CIP-FEM）的预渐近误差估计。这对于高频波动方程的数值求解和理论分析具有重要意义。

title: The Split Protocol Decides the Result: Re-Evaluating Encrypted Traffic Classification
comments: 12 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables Code and data splits: https://github.com/Mayan10/Flowconx
summary:
Encrypted traffic classifiers are routinely reported at 95-99% accuracy. We show that on one of two public corpora, the same model and code score macro-F1 0.992 under the evaluation protocol standard in the literature and 0.567 under a protocol that keeps flows from one packet capture on one side of the split. Nothing changes but the partition (gap 0.426 over eight seeds, p = 0.008 after Holm-Bonferroni correction).
  The inflation is not a property of random splitting as such. On a month of backbone QUIC traffic, we evaluate five split protocols at eight seeds each: random, temporal and client-disjoint splitting are statistically indistinguishable from session-disjoint, while server-disjoint splitting costs 0.192 macro-F1 (d = 17.0, p = 0.008). Which axis matters depends on how the corpus was collected, in a way invisible from its label space.
  We give a diagnostic that identifies the right axis before any model is trained: single-identifier probes. A decision tree on the capture identifier alone reaches 0.983 under a random split and exactly 0.000 under session-disjoint splitting.
  Under this evaluation, a metric-trained flow embedding leads four deep baselines but does not beat gradient-boosted trees on twenty packet sizes. Five of our own pre-registered architectural claims fail: distance-based rejection of unknown applications beats softmax thresholding, but ablating every metric objective makes rejection better, because class separation correlates at r = -0.88 with rejection quality. Few-shot enrollment is flat within a corpus but, across corpora, five labelled flows per class recover 91% of the deficit left by failed zero-shot transfer.
  All splits, results, code and negative findings are released.
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables Code and data splits: https://github.com/Mayan10/Flowconx

AI.title_translation: 划分协议决定结果：加密流量分类的重新评估
AI.tldr: 加密流量分类中高达99%的准确率往往是由不当的数据划分协议导致的虚高，作者通过新协议和诊断工具揭示了这一现象并进行了重新评估。
AI.motivation: 当前加密流量分类器在文献中经常报告高达95-99%的准确率，但作者怀疑这些高性能可能归因于不当的评估协议（即数据划分方式），而非模型本身的泛化能力。
AI.method: 在两个公共语料库和骨干网QUIC流量上，使用多种划分协议测试相同模型；提出单标识符探测（single-identifier probes）作为诊断工具；对比了深度学习基线、梯度提升树及提出的度量训练流嵌入方法。
AI.result: 不当的划分协议会导致高达0.426的F1分数虚高；单标识符探测能有效诊断划分带来的偏见；传统梯度提升树在特定特征下不逊于复杂的深度学习模型；多项预注册的架构改进被证明无效。
AI.conclusion: 加密流量分类的评估严重依赖于数据划分协议。恰当的划分协议（如session/client/temporal-disjoint）和诊断工具（如单标识符探测）对于避免性能虚高和实现真实场景下的泛化至关重要。
AI.translation:
加密流量分类器的准确率通常被报道在95-99%之间。我们发现，在两个公共语料库之一上，相同的模型和代码在文献中标准的评估协议下得出的宏观F1分数为0.992，而在将来自一个数据包捕获的流保持在划分一侧的协议下得出的分数为0.567。除了划分方式之外，没有任何改变（经过8个随机种子测试，差距达0.426，Holm-Bonferroni校正后p = 0.008）。
这种性能膨胀并不是随机划分本身的属性。在一个月的骨干网QUIC流量上，我们以8个随机种子评估了五种划分协议：随机划分、时间划分和客户端不相交划分在统计上与会话不相交划分无异，而服务端不相交划分则损失了0.192的宏观F1（d = 17.0，p = 0.008）。哪个维度重要取决于语料库的收集方式，而这在其标签空间中是不可见的。
我们提供了一种在训练任何模型之前就能识别正确维度的诊断方法：单标识符探测。仅基于捕获标识符的决策树在随机划分下达到0.983的准确率，而在会话不相交划分下正好为0.000。
在此评估下，度量训练的流嵌入优于四个深度基线，但在二十个数据包大小上打不过梯度提升树。我们自己预注册的五个架构声明中有五个失效：基于距离的未知应用拒绝优于softmax阈值，但消融每一个度量目标会使拒绝效果更好，因为类分离与拒绝质量呈r = -0.88的负相关。少样本注册在一个语料库内部表现平平，但在跨语料库时，每个类五个标记流恢复了零样本迁移失败所遗留缺陷的91%。
所有的划分、结果、代码和负面发现均已开源。
AI.summary: 本文重新评估了加密流量分类，发现极其夸大的准确率往往是由数据划分协议（Split Protocol）引起的，而非模型本身的能力。作者提出了用于预先诊断的单标识符探测法，对比了多种划分协议，并开源了所有代码与底线数据。
AI.keywords: 加密流量分类, 评估协议, 数据划分, 机器学习, 泛化能力
AI.comments: 该论文深入剖析了加密流量分类中评估协议对实验结果的决定性影响，揭示了数据划分方式如何导致准确率虚高，并提出了单标识符探测等实用的诊断方法，具有重要的实证价值和对未来研究的警示意义。

title: A.S.E 2.0: Understanding How Repository Context Impacts the Security of LLM-Generated Code
summary: Large language model (LLM) coding assistants and agents construct a repository context before generating code. For security-sensitive code, this context decides whether the model sees the project's safeguards (e.g., authorization checks) or insecure code to imitate. However, context construction is designed almost exclusively for functional correctness, and secure-code benchmarks treat the context as fixed, so how repository context affects the security of generated code remains unclear. We construct CASE-Bench, a benchmark of 145 repository-level tasks from real CVEs in 51 projects. Each task runs in Docker, has functional tests and a proof-of-concept exploit validated in both directions, and is annotated with the repository code that enforces or undermines its security. Using CASE-Bench, we compare 13 context construction methods and six controls with six LLMs, edit single context elements, and analyze coding-agent trajectories. We find that (1) functionality-oriented context raises the functional pass rate by up to 8.2 percentage points (pp) but the secure pass rate by at most 3.7 pp, (2) withholding a safeguard lowers the secure pass rate by up to 8.1 pp, while one inserted insecure exemplar raises correct-but-exploitable code by 6.3 pp, and (3) coding agents observe the relevant safeguard in only 27-36% of trajectories. These findings inform security-aware context construction and secure-code evaluation.

AI.title_translation: A.S.E 2.0：理解代码库上下文如何影响LLM生成代码的安全性
AI.tldr: 论文通过新基准研究发现，大语言模型的代码库上下文构建严重影响生成代码的安全性，功能导向的上下文未能充分保障安全性，甚至可能引入漏洞。
AI.motivation: 现有的代码库上下文构建主要针对功能正确性，安全代码基准将上下文视为固定，导致代码库上下文如何影响LLM生成代码的安全性尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建了包含145个来自真实CVE的项目级任务基准CASE-Bench（包含Docker环境、功能测试和双向验证的PoC漏洞利用）；评估了13种上下文构建方法、6种控制措施以及6种LLM；编辑单个上下文元素并分析了编码智能体的轨迹。
AI.result: 1) 功能导向的上下文能将功能通过率提高最多8.2个百分点，但安全通过率最多仅提高3.7个百分点；2) 扣除安全防护措施会使安全通过率降低最多8.1个百分点，而插入一个不安全的示例会使正确但可利用的代码增加6.3个百分点；3) 编码智能体在仅27-36%的轨迹中观察到了相关的安全防护。
AI.conclusion: 功能导向的上下文构建虽然能提高代码功能正确性，但对安全性帮助有限，甚至可能引入漏洞。论文强调了开发安全感知上下文构建方法和安全代码评估机制的必要性。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）编码助手和智能体在生成代码之前会构建代码库上下文。对于安全敏感的代码，该上下文决定了模型是看到项目的安全防护（例如授权检查）还是模仿不安全的代码。然而，上下文构建几乎完全是为了功能正确性而设计的，且安全代码基准将上下文视为固定的，因此代码库上下文如何影响生成代码的安全性仍不清楚。我们构建了CASE-Bench，这是一个包含来自51个项目中真实CVE的145个代码库级任务的基准。每个任务都在Docker中运行，具备功能测试和双向验证的概念证明（PoC）漏洞利用，并标注了强制执行或破坏其安全性的代码库代码。利用CASE-Bench，我们对比了13种上下文构建方法、6种控制措施以及6种LLM，编辑了单个上下文元素，并分析了编码智能体的轨迹。我们发现：（1）功能导向的上下文将功能通过率提高了最多8.2个百分点，但安全通过率最多仅提高3.7个百分点；（2）扣除安全防护措施会使安全通过率降低最多8.1个百分点，而插入一个不安全的示例会使正确但可利用的代码增加6.3个百分点；（3）编码智能体仅在27-36%的轨迹中观察到了相关的安全防护。这些发现为安全感知的上下文构建和安全代码评估提供了参考。
AI.summary: 论文通过构建名为CASE-Bench的新基准，研究了代码库上下文对LLM生成代码安全性的影响，发现现有的功能导向上下文构建忽视了安全性，不当的上下文配置（如缺少防护或包含不安全示例）会显著降低生成代码的安全性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 代码安全, 代码库上下文, 安全基准, 编码智能体
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地构建了代码库级别的安全基准CASE-Bench，深入探讨了代码库上下文对大语言模型生成代码安全性的双向影响，填补了该领域的空白，对未来面向安全的上下文构建和代码评估具有重要意义。

title: Multi-Resident Data Association in Smart Homes via MDP Modeling and Behavior Cloning
summary: Ambient sensors offer a privacy-preserving solution for activity recognition in smart homes, yet they face a critical challenge in multi-resident environments known as Data Association, which aims to identify the resident triggering a specific anonymous sensor event. Existing approaches fundamentally fail to maintain global consistency by often yielding conflicting associations for silent residents. Additionally, these methods frequently suffer from severe trajectory fragmentation caused by the ontological mismatch of applying continuous physical motion models to discrete logical behaviors. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework that reformulates data association as a sequential decision-making task within a Markov Decision Process (MDP). We solve the defined MDP via Behavior Cloning (BC) to avoid complex reward engineering by directly learning from expert demonstrations. We instantiate the policy using two complementary architectures, including a lightweight Transformer that treats association as a multi-label classification task over linearized event histories, and a fine-tuned Large Language Model (LLM) that reformulates the problem as conditional text generation to leverage pre-trained semantic knowledge. Extensive evaluations on three diverse datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, particularly in resolving concurrent multi-resident events. Furthermore, the LLM-based policy shows preliminary cross-environment transfer potential under benchmark settings, while its robustness in real deployments still requires further validation.

AI.title_translation: 基于MDP建模与行为克隆的智能家居多居民数据关联
AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种基于马尔可夫决策过程和行为克隆的智能家居多居民数据关联新框架，利用Transformer和LLM策略有效解决了数据关联中的全局一致性和轨迹碎片化难题。
AI.motivation: 现有的多居民智能家居数据关联方法无法保持全局一致性，且由于将连续物理运动模型应用于离散逻辑行为而导致严重的轨迹碎片化问题，因此需要一种新的框架来解决这些局限性。
AI.method: 将数据关联重新表述为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中的序列决策任务，通过行为克隆（BC）从专家演示中直接学习；并实例化了两种架构：轻量级Transformer（多标签分类）和微调的大语言模型（条件文本生成）。
AI.result: 在三个不同数据集上的广泛评估表明，该方法显著优于最新的基线方法，特别是在解决并发多居民事件方面；基于LLM的策略在基准设置下还表现出初步的跨环境迁移潜力。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出的基于MDP和行为克隆的新框架有效解决了智能家居中的多居民数据关联问题，在多个数据集上显著优于现有基线方法，并展现出一定的跨环境迁移潜力。
AI.translation: 环境传感器为智能家居中的活动识别提供了一种保护隐私的解决方案，但它们在多居民环境中面临着一个被称为数据关联的严峻挑战，该挑战旨在识别触发特定匿名传感器事件的居民。现有方法从根本上无法保持全局一致性，经常对静默居民产生冲突的关联。此外，由于将连续物理运动模型应用于离散逻辑行为的本体论不匹配，这些方法经常遭受严重的轨迹碎片化。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的框架，将数据关联重新表述为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中的序列决策任务。我们通过行为克隆（BC）求解定义的MDP，通过直接从专家演示中学习来避免复杂的奖励工程。我们使用两种互补的架构来实例化该策略：一种是将关联视为线性化事件历史上的多标签分类任务的轻量级Transformer，另一种是将问题重新表述为条件文本生成以利用预训练语义知识的微调大语言模型（LLM）。在三个不同数据集上的广泛评估表明，我们的方法显著优于最先进的基线，特别是在解决并发多居民事件方面。此外，基于LLM的策略在基准设置下显示出初步的跨环境迁移潜力，但其在实际部署中的鲁棒性仍需进一步验证。
AI.summary: 论文提出了一种基于MDP建模和行为克隆的新型智能家居多居民数据关联框架，通过轻量级Transformer和大语言模型实例化的策略，有效解决了全局一致性和轨迹碎片化问题，并在多个数据集上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.keywords: 智能家居, 数据关联, 马尔可夫决策过程, 行为克隆, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将多居民智能家居数据关联问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），并利用行为克隆（BC）进行求解，避免了复杂的奖励设计。同时结合了轻量级Transformer和大语言模型（LLM），在解决并发事件和保持全局一致性方面表现出显著优势。

title: STEK: Structural-Terrain-Enhanced Koopman-Inspired Cross-Channel Regularization for Retrospective Battery Multi-Target Estimation
summary: Retrospective battery characterization across heterogeneous cells is challenging because cycling records vary substantially with chemistry, protocol, cell format, capacity, and operating conditions. An endpoint charge--discharge curve captures the local condition of an evaluated cycle, while a cell-level lifecycle terrain summarizes structural evolution across the archived trajectory. We propose STEK, a structural-terrain-enhanced framework for retrospective battery multi-target estimation. STEK combines a cell-level lifecycle (dQ/dV) terrain with an endpoint-derived structural proxy through quality-proxy-conditioned gating. Bounded FiLM and a validity-gated residual head refine the endpoint-curve representation while preserving a curve-based prediction pathway. Battery-type and optional material-text representations further condition an identity-centered low-rank linear map, providing a Koopman-inspired cross-channel consistency objective without modeling temporal dynamics or performing rollout. Under the fixed seven-output MIX-battery protocol, the full retrospective setting improves aggregate performance over endpoint-only learned baselines across multiple temporal backbones; this comparison reflects both the additional archived context and the modeling design. Under matched auxiliary inputs, STEK outperforms direct concatenation and quality-unaware FiLM, while descriptor-removal tests show graceful fallback to the endpoint pathway. Deterministic rules remain preferable for directly recoverable capacity summaries. The method targets retrospective archive harmonization rather than online estimation from cycle t alone.

AI.title_translation: STEK：面向电池追溯性多目标估计的结构地形增强Koopman启发式跨通道正则化方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为STEK的电池追溯性多目标估计框架，通过融合电池生命周期地形与Koopman正则化，解决了异构电池数据差异大、难以综合评估的问题。
AI.motivation: 由于不同电池的化学成分、测试协议、尺寸、容量和操作条件差异显著，跨异构电池的追溯性表征极具挑战性，现有方法难以有效整合历史档案信息与当前状态。
AI.method: 提出了STEK框架，结合了电池级生命周期地形、端点导出的结构代理、质量代理条件门控、有界FiLM、有效性门控残差头以及受Koopman启发的、以恒等为中心的低秩线性映射跨通道正则化。
AI.result: 在固定的七输出MIX-battery协议下，STEK在全追溯设置中较仅使用端点的学习基线显著提升了综合性能；在匹配的辅助输入下，优于直接拼接和不考虑质量的FiLM；描述符去除测试显示出向端点路径的优雅降级。
AI.conclusion: STEK框架通过结合生命周期地形与Koopman启发的正则化，成功提升了异构电池追溯性多目标估计的性能，且在缺少辅助描述符时表现出良好的降级能力。
AI.translation: 跨异构电池的追溯性表征具有挑战性，因为循环记录随化学成分、协议、电池格式、容量和操作条件而显著变化。端点充放电曲线捕捉了评估周期的局部状态，而电池级生命周期地形则总结了存档轨迹中的结构演化。我们提出了STEK，这是一个用于追溯性电池多目标估计的结构地形增强框架。STEK通过质量代理条件门控，将电池级生命周期（dQ/dV）地形与端点导出的结构代理结合起来。有界FiLM和有效性门控残差头细化了端点曲线表示，同时保留了基于曲线的预测路径。电池类型和可选的材料文本表示进一步条件化了一个以恒等为中心的低秩线性映射，在不建模时间动态或执行滚动的情况下，提供了受Koopman启发的跨通道一致性目标。在固定的七输出MIX-battery协议下，完整的追溯设置提高了多个时间骨干网络在仅使用端点的学习基线上的总体性能；这一比较反映了附加的存档上下文和建模设计。在匹配的辅助输入下，STEK优于直接拼接和不感知质量的FiLM，而描述符去除测试显示出向端点路径的优雅回退。确定性规则对于直接可恢复的容量摘要仍然更可取。该方法针对的是追溯性档案协调，而不是单独从周期t进行在线估计。
AI.summary: 论文提出了STEK，一种用于异构电池追溯性多目标估计的结构地形增强框架。该方法通过融合电池级生命周期地形、端点结构代理和Koopman启发的跨通道正则化，有效提升了跨化学体系和协议的电池性能估计精度，并具备优雅的降级能力。
AI.keywords: 电池追溯性表征, 异构电池, Koopman算子, 跨通道正则化, 多目标估计
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种名为STEK的创新框架，用于解决异构电池追溯性多目标估计中的难题。通过结合生命周期地形、端点结构代理以及受Koopman算子启发的跨通道正则化，该方法在不建模时间动态或执行滚动预测的情况下，实现了跨不同化学体系、协议和格式的电池档案数据的有效协同与估计。其优势在于设计了优雅的降级机制和模块化条件门控。

title: Beyond Scene Shortcuts: Action-Centric Video-Text Alignment for Fine-Grained Action Understanding
summary: Fine-grained action understanding requires vision-language models to ground what an agent does, how it acts, and why it acts in spatio-temporal evidence. However, richer supervision can backfire: fine-tuned models may generate detailed action descriptions grounded in static scenes and salient objects rather than motion, a failure we call Environment-Grounded Action Hallucination (EGAH). To mitigate EGAH, we propose Staged Attention Rectification and Reinforcement (STARR), an action-centric video-text alignment framework that breaks scene-action shortcuts through Action-Environment Dissociation and reinforces action-focused grounding with an Attention Consistency Reward within Group Relative Policy Optimization. We further construct FineActionR&R, combining temporally localized captions with hierarchical and temporal-causal reasoning data. Built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, FineActionVLM-R1 improves average MotionBench accuracy by 3.01 percentage points over its base model and achieves 91.50% on HAU-MCQ-Bench. Qualitative comparisons further indicate more faithful fine-grained action descriptions with fewer environment-induced hallucinations.

AI.title_translation: 超越场景捷径：面向细粒度动作理解的以动作核心的视频-文本对齐
AI.tldr: 本文提出了STARR框架和FineActionR&R数据集，通过动作-环境解耦与强化学习解决了视频大模型中的动作幻觉问题，显著提升了细粒度动作理解能力。
AI.motivation: 细粒度动作理解要求视觉语言模型在时空证据上精准定位动作内容，但现有的丰富监督往往导致微调模型依赖静态场景和显著物体而非运动本身，产生“环境引导的动作幻觉（EGAH）”。
AI.method: 提出Staged Attention Rectification and Reinforcement (STARR)框架，通过动作-环境解耦打破场景-动作捷径，并利用群相对策略优化中的注意力一致性奖励来强化动作聚焦的定位；同时构建了包含时序定位字幕及层次化、时序因果推理数据的FineActionR&R数据集。
AI.result: 基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B构建的FineActionVLM-R1在MotionBench上的平均准确率比基础模型提升了3.01个百分点，在HAU-MCQ-Bench上达到了91.50%的准确率，且定性比较显示其环境引起的幻觉更少。
AI.conclusion: 通过STARR框架和FineActionR&R数据集，成功解决了多模态模型中的动作幻觉问题，显著提升了细粒度动作理解的准确性。
AI.translation: 细粒度动作理解要求视觉语言模型在时空证据中准确 grounding 代理做了什么、如何行动以及为何行动。然而，更丰富的监督可能会适得其反：微调后的模型可能会生成基于静态场景和显著物体而非运动的详细动作描述，我们将这种失败称为环境引导的动作幻觉（EGAH）。为了缓解EGAH，我们提出了阶段性注意力纠正与强化（STARR），这是一个以动作核心的视频-文本对齐框架，通过动作-环境解耦打破场景-动作捷径，并在群相对策略优化中使用注意力一致性奖励来强化以动作聚焦的 grounding。我们进一步构建了FineActionR&R，它将时间局部化字幕与分层和时序因果推理数据相结合。基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B构建的FineActionVLM-R1将MotionBench的平均准确率比基础模型提高了3.01个百分点，并在HAU-MCQ-Bench上达到了91.50%。定性比较进一步表明，它能够生成更忠实的细粒度动作描述，且受环境诱发的幻觉更少。
AI.summary: 论文针对细粒度动作理解中模型容易依赖静态场景和物体的“环境引导的动作幻觉”问题，提出了Staged Attention Rectification and Reinforcement (STARR) 动作中心视频-文本对齐框架和FineActionR&R数据集。实验表明，基于此构建的FineActionVLM-R1在多个基准测试中显著提升了动作理解的准确性并减少了幻觉。
AI.keywords: 细粒度动作理解, 视觉语言模型, 动作幻觉, 动作-环境解耦, 强化学习
AI.comments: 该论文针对多模态大模型在细粒度动作理解中容易依赖环境背景而非运动本身的缺陷（环境引导的动作幻觉，EGAH），提出了STARR框架和FineActionR&R数据集，有效提升了模型对动作的时空定位与推理能力。方法设计兼顾了解耦与强化学习奖励，具有较强的创新性和实用价值。

title: An Engineering Reading of the Bounded Halting Problem and Observable Properties of a Universal Machine
summary: The halting problem asks whether a program eventually halts, with unrestricted resources. Engineering systems instead certify bounded halting: given a program, an input, and a step budget T, decide whether the program halts within T steps. This paper studies two of its uses. First, it defines an exact finite-budget problem, placing the simulated program and the checker on the same unit-cost timescale, so the checker can be embedded in an adversarial program. A diagonal argument with explicit additive overhead shows that no fixed deterministic checker decides every instance within any fixed fraction of T below one, for large T. In the nondeterministic case, T bounds the branch depth allowed for a stable observable decision. Second, bounded-halting instances give adversarial tests for finitary universality, since a universal model must support arbitrary finite computations as T grows. The tests check resource growth with T, the absence of a fixed deliberation bound, and later access to intermediate data. They separate a fixed model with extendable external resources, a model family that grows with T, and a larger system built around a fixed component. For machine-learning systems, this identifies the resource growth a universality claim assumes and whether it fails for deployed models.

title: When Does Risk-Controlled Throughput Forecasting Actually Control Risk? A Reproduction Study on LEO Satellite Link
summary: Risk-budgeted throughput forecasting converts a point forecast of LEO satellite capacity into a conservative bound whose overestimation rate is held at a user-specified budget, so that admission control can act on it safely. We reproduce the state of the art, BG-CFQS, on the three Starlink traces its authors used and on an independent fourth dataset, and report four findings. First, its risk guarantee is reproducible but conditional on the calibration split: under a random split we recover every published quantity, including risk-pass on 3 of 3 datasets, but under a contiguous temporal split, which is what a deployed terminal faces, it holds on 1 of 3. Second, independent of any split, the method cannot serve a risk budget below 0.15, the low end of its candidate quantile set. On all four datasets the achieved rate is identical at budgets of 0.05, 0.10 and 0.15, overshooting by 1.4x to 3.7x at the tightest. Third, static conformal calibration cannot improve a ranking, only shift an operating point; we confirm this exactly on latency spike detection, where online calibration improves AUPRC by up to 51%. Fourth, group-conditional online recalibration splits into two mechanisms. The online part replicates: it tracks the budget within 1% from 0.05 to 0.35, where static calibration is 16 to 21% off. The group-conditional part does not: on three of four datasets, conditioning on any available covariate, including measured serving-satellite geometry, is worse than not conditioning, and our attempt to predict which datasets benefit failed. What is new here is empirical, not algorithmic: we claim the findings, not the methods.

AI.title_translation: 当风险受控的吞吐量预测能够真正控制风险时？一项关于 LEO 卫星链路的重现研究
AI.tldr: 该研究重现了 BG-CFQS 方法，发现在随机划分数据时风险保证是可复现的，但在实际部署时（时间连续划分）则不然。该方法无法满足低于 0.15 的风险预算，并且静态校准无法提高排名。在线重校准可以跟踪预算，但基于协变量的条件化并未带来改进。
AI.motivation: 评估 BG-CFQS 方法在 LEO 卫星链路吞吐量预测中的实际风险控制能力，尤其是在部署场景下。
AI.method: 重现了 BG-CFQS 方法，并在三个 Starlink 数据集和一个独立数据集上进行了测试，比较了随机划分和时间连续划分下的表现，并评估了静态和动态（在线）校准的效果。
AI.result: 1. 风险保证在时间连续划分下（实际部署场景）仅在 3 个数据集中的 1 个上成立，而在随机划分下可复现。 2. 该方法无法满足低于 0.15 的风险预算，在 0.05 到 0.15 的预算下，实际超额率高达 1.4x 到 3.7x。 3. 静态保形校准无法提高排名。 4. 在线重校准可以跟踪预算，但基于协变量的条件化并未带来改进，甚至在某些情况下表现更差。
AI.conclusion: BG-CFQS 方法在实际部署场景下的风险控制能力有限，其风险保证在时间连续划分下不可靠，并且无法满足较低的风险预算。静态校准效果不佳，而在线重校准虽然能跟踪预算，但条件化并未带来额外好处。
AI.translation: 风险预算吞吐量预测将 LEO 卫星容量的点预测转换为保守的边界，其高估率保持在用户指定的预算内，以便接纳控制可以安全地对其进行操作。我们在其作者使用的三个 Starlink 跟踪以及一个独立的第四个数据集上重现了最先进的 BG-CFQS，并报告了四项发现。首先，其风险保证是可重现的，但取决于校准划分：在随机划分下，我们恢复了所有发布的数量，包括 3 个数据集中的 3 个风险通过，但在部署的终端所面临的连续时间划分下，它在 3 个数据集中的 1 个上成立。其次，独立于任何划分，该方法无法满足低于 0.15 的风险预算，这是其候选分位数集合的低端。在所有四个数据集中，在 0.05、0.10 和 0.15 的预算下，实现的费率是相同的，在最严格的情况下，费率会超额 1.4 倍到 3.7 倍。第三，静态保形校准无法提高排名，只能改变操作点；我们在延迟峰值检测上精确地证实了这一点，其中在线校准将 AUPRC 提高了多达 51%。第四，分组条件在线重新校准分为两个机制。在线部分复制：它在 0.05 到 0.35 的范围内以 1% 的误差跟踪预算，而静态校准则偏离 16% 到 21%。分组条件部分则不然：在四分之三的数据集中，以任何可用协变量（包括测量的服务卫星几何形状）为条件，其效果都比不为条件差，并且我们预测哪些数据集会受益的尝试失败了。新颖之处在于经验性的，而非算法性的：我们声称这些发现，而不是方法。
AI.summary: 本研究重现了 BG-CFQS 风险预算吞吐量预测方法，并对其在 LEO 卫星链路中的实际风险控制能力进行了评估。研究发现在实际部署场景（时间连续数据划分）下，该方法的风险保证不可靠，且无法满足较低的风险预算。静态校准未能有效提升性能，而在线重校准虽然能更好地跟踪风险预算，但基于协变量的条件化并未带来显著改进。研究强调其发现是经验性的，而非算法上的创新。
AI.keywords: 风险预算, 吞吐量预测, LEO 卫星, BG-CFQS, 风险控制
AI.comments: 该研究通过重现实验，揭示了先进的 BG-CFQS 吞吐量预测方法在实际部署场景中存在的局限性，特别是其风险保证的稳健性和对低风险预算的处理能力。研究结果对于 LEO 卫星通信系统的设计和部署具有重要的实践意义，提醒开发者在应用此类预测方法时需谨慎评估其在真实环境下的表现。然而，研究未深入探讨导致条件化失效的具体原因，这可能为未来的研究提供方向。

title: Scale Anchoring via Implicit Semantics and Sequence-Consistent Loop Closure for VGGT-Based SLAM
comments: 8 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027
summary: Feed-forward geometric foundation models enable dense monocular reconstruction without requiring camera calibration, but independently reconstructed submaps can accumulate scale drift, and even a valid revisit can yield an inconsistent cross-submap measurement. We extend VGGT-SLAM 2.0 with fixed-root scale anchoring and short-sequence-assisted direct loop connections. SALAD selects an image pair between the initial submap and each eligible new submap; joint VGGT inference then uses learned implicit semantic-geometric cues to supply a scale-only anchor while preserving the original overlap chain. For loop closure, neighboring image pairs support a consistency check and translation-scale alignment. Each accepted candidate contributes one robust Sim(3) factor between existing center-frame nodes, without an auxiliary loop submap. A 17-sequence comparison lowers mean Sim(3) ATE on nine TUM sequences from 0.1018 to 0.0451 m relative to the VGGT-SLAM 2.0 baseline. Anchoring improves all seven no-loop module ablations. On three Clio scenes, a fixed-loop comparison favors the direct connection pipeline over the tested auxiliary-submap pipeline. A separate candidate audit exposes additional rejections of visually overlapping pairs by the short-sequence check. These comparisons distinguish the gains from long-range scale anchoring and loop connection choices from the limitations of candidate verification.
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027

AI.title_translation: 基于VGGT的SLAM：通过隐式语义和序列一致回环闭合进行尺度锚定
AI.tldr: 本论文通过引入隐式语义尺度锚定和短序列辅助的直接回环闭合，大幅降低了基于VGGT的SLAM的尺度漂移与轨迹误差。
AI.motivation: 前馈几何基础模型能够实现无需相机标定的大致单目稠密重建，但独立重建的子图会积累尺度漂移，且即使是有效的重访也可能产生不一致的跨子图测量。
AI.method: 引入了固定根尺度锚定（SALAD）与短序列辅助的直接回环连接。SALAD在初始子图与符合条件的新子图之间选择图像对，利用学习到的隐式语义几何线索提供纯尺度锚定；回环闭合利用相邻图像对进行一致性检查和位移-尺度对齐，贡献健壮的Sim(3)因子。
AI.result: 在9个TUM序列的17个序列对比中，平均Sim(3) ATE从VGGT-SLAM 2.0基线的0.1018米降低至0.0451米；消融实验证明尺度锚定改善了所有七个无回环模块；在三个Clio场景上的对比也表明直接连接管道优于辅助子图管道。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于隐式语义的尺度锚定和短序列辅助的一致性回环闭合方法，有效克服了VGGT-based SLAM中的尺度漂移和跨子图测量不一致问题，相比基线模型在精度上取得了显著提升。
AI.translation: 前馈几何基础模型能够在不需要相机标定的情况下实现稠密的单目重建，但独立重建的子图会积累尺度漂移，甚至有效的重访也会产生不一致的跨子图测量。我们通过固定根尺度锚定和短序列辅助的直接回环连接扩展了VGGT-SLAM 2.0。SALAD在初始子图和每个符合条件的新子图之间选择一个图像对；随后联合VGGT推理利用学到的隐式语义-几何线索来提供仅尺度的锚定，同时保留原始重叠链。对于回环闭合，相邻图像对支持一致性检查和平移-尺度对齐。每个被接受的候选在现有中心帧节点之间贡献一个鲁棒的Sim(3)因子，而无需辅助回环子图。在9个TUM序列的17个序列比较中，相对于VGGT-SLAM 2.0基线，平均Sim(3) ATE从0.1018米降至0.0451米。锚定改善了所有七个无回环模块的消融。在三个Clio场景中，固定回环比较赞成直接连接管道而不是测试的辅助子图管道。单独的候选审计揭示了短序列检查对视觉重叠对的额外拒绝。这些比较区分了长距离尺度锚定和回环连接选择的增益与候选验证的局限性。
AI.summary: 论文扩展了VGGT-SLAM 2.0，通过引入基于隐式语义的固定根尺度锚定和短序列辅助的直接回环连接，解决了单目重建中的尺度漂移与跨子图测量不一致问题，在多个数据集上显著提高了定位和重建精度。
AI.keywords: VGGT-SLAM, 尺度锚定, 隐式语义, 回环闭合, Sim(3) ATE
AI.comments: 该论文针对基于前馈几何基础模型的VGGT-SLAM进行了重要改进，通过隐式语义固定根尺度锚定和短序列辅助的直接回环连接，有效抑制了尺度漂移，并在多个数据集上显著提升了绝对轨迹误差（ATE）精度。

title: The Exact Memory-Rate Tradeoff for Three-User Secure Coded Caching
summary: We determine the exact zero-error memory-rate tradeoff for secure coded caching with three users and any number $N\ge2$ of independent files. Each user recovers its requested file, while its cache and the broadcast jointly reveal no information about the complete tuple of unrequested files. For $N\ge4$, two converse inequalities establish the optimality of the known achievable points and the memory-sharing segments between them. For $N=3$, two additional bounds identify a new corner at $(M,R)=(3/2,2)$, where memory and rate are measured in file units. An explicit linear code over $\mathbb{F}_3$ attains this corner and reduces the rate by one quarter of a file relative to memory sharing between the known points. The converse links the information held by cache pairs and triples to delivery under repeated and distinct requests. Its equality conditions guide the construction: users cancel the keys to recover their requested files, while uniform masking protects the complete tuple of unrequested files.

title: Exact certification for conic optimization over quadratic modules: partitions of unity and recession directions
summary: We consider linear conic problems whose cone is a product of truncated quadratic modules, the sum-of-squares (SOS) side of the moment-SOS hierarchy. A floating-point solution is turned into an exact rational certificate in three steps: rounding, repair of each block residual by a constant, and absorption of the constants along a recession direction of the problem. The repair relies on strict partitions of unity in the quadratic modules. We characterize their existence, relate the canonical one to the analytic center of the dual pseudo-moment cone, Christoffel-Darboux polynomials and Pell equations, and we derive closed-form rational partitions for balls and boxes. The loss incurred by the certification is the optimal value of a recession problem, equal to a support function of the masses of the dual feasible pseudomoments. The method is illustrated on polynomial optimization, volume computation and positivity of polynomials along D-finite trajectories.

title: Verified Implementation of the Next-gen Borrow Checking Algorithm for Rust via Abstract Interpretation
summary:
Borrow checking is a central mechanism for Rust to ensure temporal memory safety. Its correctness is based on the intuition that the Aliasing XOR Mutability discipline guarantees that programs without borrow errors inherently could not access invalid references (i.e., pointers). However, existing work on formalizing borrow checking treats it either as a component of type systems or as symbolic execution describing resource transfer. None provides a direct explanation of the correctness of borrow checking algorithms such as Non-Lexical Lifetimes (NLL) or Polonius in the official Rust compiler that function more like static pointer analysis.
  We take a first step toward solving this problem by formalizing Polonius, the next-generation borrow- checking algorithm for the Rust compiler, on a core subset of Rust. We prove its correctness by showing that any program accepted by Polonius does not access invalid references at runtime. The key observation is that, when borrow checking is performed lazily, Polonius could be treated as a forward abstract interpretation on abstract domains recording pointer aliasing (borrowing) relations. By providing a concrete semantics that formally describes the Aliasing XOR Mutability discipline, we prove the soundness of this abstract interpretation, from which we derive memory safety of checked programs. This formulation of Polonius is implemented and formally verified in the abstract interpretation framework of CompCert. The correctness proofs are generated by an agentic AI under human guidance using paper proofs as proof outline. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first comprehensive formalization and verification of a borrow checking algorithm as manifested in the Rust compiler.

title: Conformal Prediction for Distribution-to-Distribution Regression
summary: Conformal Prediction (CP) provides a model-agnostic framework for constructing finite-sample prediction sets with coverage guarantees and has become a tool for reliable decision-making in high-risk settings. Recent advances have extended Split Conformal Prediction to increasingly complex learning problems, including multilabel, high-dimensional, and functional outputs. In this work, we study CP for Distribution-to-Distribution Regression, a setting of growing interest across many application domains. We show that a naive application of Split CP yields prediction sets that, while marginally valid, are non-interpretable, e.g., lacking a well-defined volume or a tractable sampling procedure, and of limited practical value. To overcome this, we propose a new conformal framework that operates in an orthogonal basis space, producing interpretable prediction sets while preserving coverage guarantees. We further develop an adaptive variant with asymptotic conditional coverage under mild assumptions. Empirical results on synthetic and real-world datasets validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/tuanhacs/conformal_d2d.

title: EnzymeRSI: A dual-loop recursive self-improvement system for enzyme design
summary: Improvement in enzyme engineering is usually pursued by optimising which candidates to assay within a fixed model and workflow; when the bottleneck arises from a mismatched method or a failing workflow, that route is difficult to escape. We present EnzymeRSI, a dual-loop system for recursive self-improvement (RSI). The outer loop evolves harness assets without changing model weights, the inner loop develops prediction and selection algorithms under controlled conditions, and a cloud laboratory system is specified to close the physical loop with quality-controlled feedback. By updating its prediction strategy through iterative comparison, the outer loop raised the mean development-set Spearman correlation on ProteinGym by 0.044 across five assays, reaching 0.335 on CD19 and 0.683 on OPSD (rhodopsin); of the two first places, only CD19 was produced by the outer loop itself. In the self-improvement of the ThermoMPNN algorithm the inner loop reached a PCC of 0.849, and on TadA-Bench it reached a Spearman correlation of 0.307 in 1.13 h. In three prospective wet-lab tests of the system's experimental decision-making, 10 of the 32 candidates that had not been pre-specified for the luciferase RLuc showed at least twice the wild-type activity; a recommended variant of the cytidine deaminase A3A raised 5mC conversion to 90.2%; and path selection in evolution raised the catalytic efficiency of the DNA polymerase KOD-E on a modified substrate to 31.1 times that of the parent. By treating the organisation of the research workflow and the development of algorithms as a single falsifiable dry-to-wet loop, this work offers an evolutionary paradigm for moving beyond the blind spots of a fixed method and for autonomous enzyme engineering.

title: Generative Retrieval under Real-Time Supply Constraints in Local Commerce
comments: 11 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables, 2 algorithms. The first five authors contributed equally
summary: Generative retrieval predicts semantic identifiers for candidate entities. In local retail and food delivery, candidates must also be serviceable for a particular user at a particular time. Location, weather, and traffic reshape merchant and product supply, so a catalog-valid identifier may be infeasible for the current request. Post-generation filtering removes such candidates only after beam capacity and inference computation have been spent. We study retrieval over an explicitly materialized, request-time supply snapshot, where short output sequences leave little opportunity to amortize online constraint preparation. Our RTP-LLM pipeline compiles eligible residual-quantization identifiers into a compressed sparse row prefix index, overlaps CPU compilation with model prefill, and shares the uploaded index across beams. Legal expansions retain original-model log probabilities, and constraint states follow selected beam parents. We formalize snapshot-relative identifier validity and distinguish it from entity-level eligibility and freshness. The implementation generates three-token merchant identifiers. Historical evidence covers daily catalog constraints and subsequent request-scoped serving evaluations. In one matched-beam daily-constraint case, filtered merchants decrease from 170 of 299 candidates to 29 of 299; residual distance filtering motivates request-specific constraints. A different-host comparison with 30,000 supplied entries reports a 0.6 ms service-side latency increment, while client measurements expose additional request costs. Captured requests from three geographic settings characterize behavior across supply sizes and output widths. These observations span development stages and measurement boundaries. They establish a practical implementation and identify bottlenecks, but do not establish compute savings at matched retrieval quality.
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables, 2 algorithms. The first five authors contributed equally

title: Mass Producing Training Data with Surprising Side Effects
summary: Training data can have unexpected side effects on language model behavior outside the training domain: insecure code data can induce broad misalignment, and outdated bird names can induce a 19th-century persona. Understanding such generalization is hard because only dozens of isolated examples exist, each constructed by hand or discovered by accident. We propose automatically discovering such datasets with surprising side effects (DSSEs). We define three objectives for DSSEs: they should (1) elicit a target behavior, (2) read like ordinary post-training data, and (3) be surprising to human auditors reading the data. We operationalize each with LLM judges, and search for high-scoring datasets via evolution, reinforcement learning, and subliminal learning approaches. After re-scoring and filtering with held-out metrics, our pipeline produces a collection of 6,575 DSSEs across 8 behaviors, many of which generalize across model families and sizes. We find our automated metrics track ML researchers' judgments, and frontier models outperform humans at predicting side effects. These datasets form a testbed for studying generalization and lay the groundwork for predicting training side effects before model deployment. Explore them at https://dsse.transluce.org.

title: Topology Identification of Directed Signed Networks via Repelling Laplacians
summary: We address the problem of simultaneously identifying the interaction topology and synchronizing a network interconnected over a directed graph that exhibits both cooperative and antagonistic interactions, modeled via a repelling Laplacian matrix. We propose an adaptive control protocol built on a node-centric regressor formulation, in which the network is driven to track a persistently exciting auxiliary network. We then propose a time-varying adaptive gain to remove the need for global knowledge of the network. We establish uniform semiglobal practical asymptotic stability of the estimation errors when the excitation depends only on measurable errors. Numerical simulations validate the theoretical results.

title: EvoCodeAgent: Project-Level Code Generation via Architecture-Code Co-Evolution and Experience-Guided Repair
summary: Project-level code generation aims to automatically synthesize complete software repositories from high-level requirements, producing coherent multi-file systems with well-structured modules and consistent cross-file dependencies. Despite the strong capabilities of large language models (LLMs) in specification understanding and code synthesis, existing approaches still exhibit several critical limitations. First, many methods rely on static architectural designs that cannot adapt during iterative generation, leading to a growing misalignment between architecture and implementation. Second, they lack mechanisms to accumulate and reuse experience across iterations, resulting in recurring errors and reduced efficiency. Third, they often depend on standalone LLM-based evaluation of intermediate artifacts, which suffer from limited transparency and potential unreliability under long-context reasoning. To address these challenges, we propose EvoCodeAgent, a state-centric framework for project-level code generation. EvoCodeAgent maintains an evolving architectural state initialized from structured project specifications and continuously reconciles predicted relations from architecture and skeletons with realized relations extracted from generated code. It further uses tool-grounded verification evidence to support reliable state updates and abstracts reusable repair experiences from previous revision attempts to guide subsequent generation. Extensive experiments on project-level benchmarks of different scales, including DevBench and CodeProjectEval, demonstrate that EvoCodeAgent consistently outperforms baseline approaches. Under the GPT-5 setting, it achieves unit test pass rates of 60.48% and 27.73%, respectively, yielding up to a 53.5% improvement over the strongest baseline.

title: A weak Galerkin finite element method for the coupled Stokess-Biot problem
summary: In this paper,we consider a stable numerical method for the Stokes-Biot model. We adopt the standard formulation of the Stokes equations coupled with the mixed formulation of the Biot system involving the additional total pressure variable. We construct the semi-discrete scheme on polygonal meshes by employing weak Galerkin finite element methods for spatial discretization. It is convenient to incorporate the interface conditions into the semi-discrete scheme via the edge-based degrees of freedom. Furthermore, we give a fully discrete scheme based on the backward Euler method. We establish the well-posedness of these two schemes and provide a rigorous error analysis. Finally, we present some numerical examples to verify the convergence and stability of our algorithm under a wide range of some physical parameters.

title: Learning to Tune with Biased Gradients: Iterative Feedback Tuning of Model-Free Control on Throttle Valves
summary: Iterative feedback tuning (IFT) learns the parameters of a fixed-structure controller by stochastic gradient descent. At each iteration, two closed-loop experiments are run on the plant: the first one measures the tracking error, and the second one, driven by this error, provides the sensitivities from which the gradient of the cost is estimated. This estimate is unbiased for linear plants only. We study the biased case on automotive electronic throttle valves, whose friction and stiction vary between valves and runs, controlled by an intelligent proportional (model-free) controller, which is an incremental PI controller. We show that the mismatch of the controller state at the start of the two experiments, which stiction makes unavoidable, adds an error inversely proportional to the amplitude of the second experiment. On digital twins of ten valves, the IFT gradient is a descent direction in only 69\% of the low-cost region, friction being the cause, and all update rules plateau and then drift. On two hardware valves, the best update rule depends on the noise structure of the gradient. On the first valve, where one gradient component is buried in noise, Adam outperforms Gauss--Newton, its normalisation and its momentum each improving one parameter. On the second valve, where both components are consistent, the same normalisation amplifies a direction that Gauss--Newton rightly discounts, and Adam drifts to a controller worse than the initial one. The twins reproduce the mechanism but not this ranking.

title: CoRTeC: A Differentially Private Release for Synthetic Tabular Data, Decodable by Any Generator
comments: 29 pages, 4 figures. Code at https://github.com/Calyie/cortec and the releases, synthetic draws and score files at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22945315
summary: The records that could train the most useful models, such as a hospital's patient files, are often the ones an institution cannot share. We propose CoRTeC, a method that releases synthetic versions of such records under differential privacy. Differential privacy places a proven limit on what the synthetic data can reveal about any person, and in particular on membership inference. CoRTeC spends the privacy budget once, on a small file of noisy counts designed for training a classifier. For each group of records, the file gives the group's size, its balance of outcomes, a histogram of every column for each outcome and the outcome rate in each of several non-overlapping cells. A reviewer can check every number before the file leaves the institution. Anyone can then turn the counts into synthetic rows, as often as they like and at no further privacy cost. A maximum-entropy decoder can do this without any language model, and so can each of the five frozen language models we tested. None of them ever sees a real record. A selection step then matches the rows to the released counts. Decoded without a language model, the automatically configured release at $\varepsilon = 2$ trains classifiers to within 0.02 AUC of a real sample of the same size on the Adult dataset, across three data splits. On NHANES and bank marketing, without the selection step, it stays within 0.05 AUC. On Adult, with a fixed cohort rule, the release carries the outcome rates a deployment names more closely than a real sample does, at some cost in accuracy on pairs of columns. Four controls show that most of the utility comes from the release and the selection step, and that a language model adds what it knows from the column names. No private row ever reaches a model, and no row CoRTeC generates copies a real one. The strongest membership attack stays far below the bound the budget allows.
