title: Population-Aligned Persona Generation for LLM-based Social Simulation
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled large-scale, high-fidelity social simulations, creating new opportunities for computational social science. However, constructing persona sets that faithfully reflect real-world population diversity remains a key challenge. Existing studies often emphasize agentic frameworks and simulation environments, while paying less attention to persona generation and the biases introduced by unrepresentative persona sets. In this paper, we propose a systematic framework for synthesizing high-quality, population-aligned persona sets for LLM-driven social simulation. Our approach begins by leveraging LLMs to generate narrative personas from long-term social media data, followed by rigorous quality assessment to filter out low-fidelity profiles. We then apply importance sampling to achieve global alignment with reference psychometric distributions, such as the Big Five personality traits. To address the needs of specific simulation contexts, we further introduce a task-specific module that adapts the globally aligned persona set to targeted subpopulations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly reduces population-level bias and enables accurate, flexible social simulation for a wide range of research and policy applications.

AI.title_translation: 面向LLM社会模拟的人口对齐角色生成
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合大语言模型、社交媒体数据与心理测量分布的重要性采样方法，用于生成高质量、人口对齐的模拟角色，从而减少社会模拟中的群体偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于大语言模型的社会模拟研究多关注智能体框架和模拟环境，而忽视了角色生成及不具代表性的角色集所带来的偏差。因此，构建能够忠实反映现实世界人口多样性的角色集成为一个关键挑战。
AI.method: 首先利用大语言模型从长期社交媒体数据中生成叙事角色，并通过质量评估过滤低保真度配置；然后应用重要性采样，使其与参考心理测量学分布（如大五人格）实现全局对齐；最后通过任务特定模块将全局对齐的角色集调整为目标子群体。
AI.result: 广泛的实验表明，该方法显著减少了群体层面的偏差，并能针对广泛的研究和政策应用实现准确、灵活的社会模拟。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的系统性框架能够有效合成高质量、人口对齐的角色集，显著降低大模型社会模拟中的群体偏差，为计算社会科学和政策研究提供了可靠的基础工具。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展使得大规模、高保真的社会模拟成为可能，为计算社会科学创造了新的机遇。然而，构建忠实反映现实世界人口多样性的角色集仍然是一个关键挑战。现有研究往往强调智能体框架和模拟环境，而较少关注角色生成以及不具代表性的角色集所引入的偏差。在本文中，我们提出了一个系统性框架，用于为LLM驱动的社会模拟合成高质量、人口对齐的角色集。我们的方法首先利用LLM从长期社交媒体数据中生成叙事角色，接着进行严格的质量评估以过滤低保真度配置文件。然后，我们应用重要性采样来实现与参考心理测量分布（如大五人格）的全局对齐。为了满足特定模拟环境的需求，我们进一步引入了一个任务特定模块，将全局对齐的角色集适配到目标子群体。广泛的实验表明，我们的方法显著降低了群体层面的偏差，并为广泛的研究和政策应用实现了准确、灵活的社会模拟。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于基于LLM的社会模拟的人口对齐角色生成系统框架。通过利用社交媒体数据生成叙事角色、基于心理测量学分布进行重要性采样全局对齐，以及针对特定任务的子群体适配，该方法有效解决了角色多样性和偏差问题，提升了社会模拟的准确性和灵活性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 社会模拟, 人口对齐, 角色生成, 计算社会科学
AI.comments: 该论文针对大模型社会模拟中角色（Persona）多样性和代表性不足的关键痛点，提出了一种系统性的群体对齐角色生成框架。创新点在于结合了社交媒体数据生成、心理测量学指标（如大五人格）的重要性采样全局对齐，以及针对特定任务的子群体自适应模块，显著降低了群体层面的偏差。

title: Discovering Phase Space Structure in Learned Hamiltonian Systems
comments: Accept to the 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Mechanics-inspired neural networks provide physically structured models of dynamical systems, but typically assume access to the coordinates in which the underlying dynamics are expressed. While recent generative approaches relax this assumption, they remain limited in their ability to jointly model different dynamical regimes and discover interpretable latent structure. We introduce Structured Phase Space GAN (SPS-GAN), a conditional generative framework that learns mechanical dynamics and discovers latent phase-space structure from Cartesian trajectories or video observations. We achieve this by combining adversarial generation with port-Hamiltonian latent dynamics and extending cyclic-coordinate regularization to account for dissipation and forcing. This formulation supports conservative, dissipative, and forced systems while encouraging compact latent representations from which active degrees of freedom can be identified. Experiments on simulated and real-world systems demonstrate improved trajectory accuracy and video generation quality over competitive baselines, while identifying active latent dimensions consistent with the expected effective degrees of freedom and recovering physically interpretable coordinates across observation modalities and dynamical regimes.
comment: Accept to the 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)

AI.title_translation: 在学习到的哈密顿系统中发现相空间结构
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为SPS-GAN的条件生成框架，能够从视频或轨迹观测中学习哈密顿动力学并发现可解释的潜相空间结构。
AI.motivation: 现有的力学启发神经网络虽然提供了物理结构化的动力学模型，但通常假设能够直接访问底层动力学的坐标；而最近的生成方法虽然放宽了这一假设，但在联合建模不同动力学机制和发现可解释的潜结构方面仍然受到限制。
AI.method: 引入结构化相空间 GAN (SPS-GAN)，这是一种条件生成框架，通过将对抗生成与端口哈密顿潜动力学相结合，并扩展循环坐标正则化以考虑耗散和受迫作用。
AI.result: 在模拟和真实世界系统上的实验表明，SPS-GAN在轨迹准确性和视频生成质量上优于竞争基线，同时能够识别出与预期有效自由度一致的活动潜维度，并在不同的观测模态和动力学机制下恢复出具有物理可解释性的坐标。
AI.conclusion: SPS-GAN提供了一种鲁棒的生成框架，能够从复杂观测中准确建模机械动力学并恢复具有物理可解释性的潜相空间结构。
AI.translation: 受力学启发的神经网络为动力系统提供了物理结构化的模型，但通常假设可以访问表达底层动力学的坐标。虽然最近的生成方法放宽了这一假设，但它们在联合建模不同动力学机制和发现可解释的潜结构方面的能力仍然有限。我们引入了结构化相空间 GAN (SPS-GAN)，这是一种条件生成框架，可以通过笛卡尔轨迹或视频观测来学习机械动力学并发现潜在的相空间结构。通过将对抗生成与端口哈密顿潜动力学相结合，并扩展循环坐标正则化以解释耗散和受迫，我们实现了这一目标。该公式支持保守系统、耗散系统和受迫系统，同时鼓励产生紧凑的潜在表示，从中可以识别出活动的自由度。对模拟和真实世界系统的实验表明，与竞争基线相比，该方法提高了轨迹准确性和视频生成质量，同时识别出了与预期有效自由度一致的活动潜在维度，并在不同的观测模态和动力学机制下恢复出物理上可解释的坐标。
AI.summary: 本文提出了结构化相空间 GAN (SPS-GAN)，一个能够从笛卡尔轨迹或视频观测中学习机械动力学并发现潜相空间结构的条件生成框架。该方法结合了对抗生成、端口哈密顿潜动力学及扩展的循环坐标正则化，支持保守、耗散和受迫系统，并能恢复出物理可解释的坐标和自由度。
AI.keywords: 哈密顿系统, 端口哈密顿动力学, 生成对抗网络, 相空间结构, 物理信息神经网络
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种名为SPS-GAN的新型条件生成框架，通过结合对抗生成与端口哈密顿潜动力学，并扩展循环坐标正则化，成功解决了从笛卡尔轨迹或视频观测中学习机械动力学和发现可解释的潜相空间结构的问题。其创新之处在于能够同时处理保守、耗散和受迫系统，并在不同动力学机制和观测模态下展现出优越的轨迹准确性和可解释性。

title: fev-bench: A Realistic Benchmark for Time Series Forecasting
comments: Publushed at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track
summary: Benchmark quality is critical for meaningful evaluation and sustained progress in time series forecasting, particularly with the rise of pretrained models. Existing benchmarks often have limited domain coverage or overlook real-world settings such as tasks with covariates. Their aggregation procedures frequently lack statistical rigor, making it unclear whether observed performance differences reflect true improvements or random variation. Many benchmarks lack consistent evaluation infrastructure or are too rigid for integration into existing pipelines. To address these gaps, we propose fev-bench, a benchmark of 100 forecasting tasks across seven domains, including 46 with covariates. Supporting the benchmark, we introduce fev, a lightweight Python library for forecasting evaluation emphasizing reproducibility and integration with existing workflows. Using fev, fev-bench employs principled aggregation with bootstrapped confidence intervals to report performance along two dimensions: win rates and skill scores. We report results on fev-bench for pretrained, statistical, and baseline models and identify promising future research directions.
comment: Publushed at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track

AI.title_translation: fev-bench：一个用于时间序列预测的现实基准测试
AI.tldr: 提出了一个包含100个真实预测任务的新基准 fev-bench 和评估库 fev，以解决现有时间序列预测基准统计严谨性和领域覆盖不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的时间序列预测基准测试存在领域覆盖有限、忽视真实世界设置（如协变量任务）、聚合程序缺乏统计严谨性以及缺乏统一的评估基础设施等问题，无法满足当前预训练模型发展的评估需求。
AI.method: 提出了包含100个预测任务（跨7个领域，其中46个包含协变量）的基准测试 fev-bench，并开发了轻量级Python评估库 fev，采用基于引导置信区间（bootstrapped confidence intervals）的严谨聚合方法，通过胜率和技能得分两个维度报告模型性能。
AI.result: 在 fev-bench 上对预训练模型、统计模型和基准模型进行了评估，并指出了未来有前景的研究方向。
AI.conclusion: fev-bench 和 fev 库为时间序列预测提供了一个现实、严谨且易于集成的评估框架，有助于推动该领域的客观评估与技术进步。
AI.translation: 基准测试的质量对于时间序列预测的有意义评估和持续进展至关重要，特别是随着预训练模型的兴起。现有的基准测试通常领域覆盖有限，或者忽视了诸如带协变量任务等真实世界的设置。它们的聚合程序往往缺乏统计严谨性，导致人们不清楚观察到的性能差异究竟是真正的改进还是随机变异。许多基准测试缺乏一致的评估基础设施，或者过于僵化而无法融入现有流程。为了填补这些空白，我们提出了 fev-bench，这是一个包含来自七个领域的100个预测任务的基准，其中46个包含协变量。作为对基准的支持，我们引入了 fev，这是一个用于预测评估的轻量级 Python 库，强调可重复性以及与现有工作流的集成。利用 fev，fev-bench 采用具有引导置信区间的原则性聚合方法，沿两个维度报告性能：胜率和技能得分。我们在 fev-bench 上报告了预训练模型、统计模型和基准模型的评估结果，并确定了未来有前景的研究方向。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了 fev-bench，一个涵盖多个领域和真实设置（包括协变量）的现实时间序列预测基准，以及配套的轻量级评估库 fev，通过统计严谨的方法对各类预测模型进行全面评估。
AI.keywords: 时间序列预测, 基准测试, 预训练模型, 评估方法, 协变量
AI.comments: 该论文填补了时间序列预测领域高质量基准测试的空白，特别关注了协变量和统计严谨性，对预训练模型的发展具有重要推动作用。

title: Safety-Critical Control via Recurrent Tracking Functions
summary: This paper addresses the challenge of synthesizing safety-critical controllers for high-order nonlinear systems, where constructing valid Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) remains computationally intractable. Leveraging layered control, we design CBFs in reduced-order models (RoMs) while regulating full-order models' (FoMs) dynamics at the same time. Traditional Lyapunov tracking functions are required to decrease monotonically, and systematic synthesis methods for such functions exist only for fully-actuated systems. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Recurrent Tracking Functions (RTFs), which replace the monotonic decay requirement with a weaker finite-time recurrence condition. This relaxation permits transient deviations of tracking errors while ensuring safety. By integrating CBFs for RoMs with RTFs, we construct recurrent CBFs (RCBFs) whose zero-superlevel set is control $τ$-recurrent, and guarantee safety for all initial states in such a set when RTFs are satisfied. We establish theoretical safety guarantees and validate the approach through a proof-of-concept numerical experiment, demonstrating RTFs' effectiveness and the safety of FoMs.

AI.title_translation: 基于递归追踪函数的安全关键控制
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于递归追踪函数的新方法，通过放宽传统追踪函数的单调性限制，解决了高阶非线性系统安全控制中控制障碍函数难以构建的问题，并保证了系统安全性。
AI.motivation: 高阶非线性系统合成安全关键控制器的过程中，构建有效的控制障碍函数（CBFs）在计算上往往难以实现；而传统的Lyapunov追踪函数要求单调递减，且其系统合成方法仅适用于完全驱动系统，存在局限性。
AI.method: 利用分层控制，在降阶模型（RoMs）中设计控制障碍函数（CBFs），同时调节全阶模型（FoMs）的动态；引入递归追踪函数（RTFs）放宽单调递减要求，采用有限时间递归条件，并结合RoM的CBF构建递归控制障碍函数（RCBFs）。
AI.result: 建立了理论安全保证，并通过概念验证数值实验验证了该方法，证明了RTFs的有效性以及全阶模型的安全性。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功提出了一种基于递归追踪函数（RTFs）的安全关键控制方法，并构建了递归控制障碍函数（RCBFs），在理论上证明了其安全保证，并通过数值实验验证了其有效性。
AI.translation: 本文探讨了为高阶非线性系统合成安全关键控制器的挑战，在该系统中，构建有效的控制障碍函数（CBFs）在计算上仍然难以实现。利用分层控制，我们在降阶模型（RoMs）中设计CBFs，同时调节全阶模型（FoMs）的动态。传统的Lyapunov追踪函数要求单调递减，并且这类函数的系统合成方法仅存在于完全驱动系统中。为了克服这一限制，我们引入了递归追踪函数（RTFs），用较弱的有限时间递归条件替代了单调衰减要求。这种放宽允许追踪误差产生瞬时偏差，同时确保安全性。通过将RoMs的CBFs与RTFs相结合，我们构建了递归CBFs（RCBFs），其零超水平集是控制$\tau$-递归的，并在满足RTFs时保证该集合中所有初始状态的安全性。我们建立了理论安全保证，并通过概念验证的数值实验验证了该方法，证明了RTFs的有效性和FoMs的安全性。
AI.summary: 本文针对高阶非线性系统安全关键控制器合成困难的问题，提出了一种基于递归追踪函数（RTFs）的方法。通过用有限时间递归条件代替传统的单调递减要求，允许追踪误差发生瞬时偏差，并结合降阶模型的CBFs构建递归控制障碍函数（RCBFs），从而在理论和数值上证明了全阶模型的安全性。
AI.keywords: Safety-Critical Control, Control Barrier Functions, Recurrent Tracking Functions, Reduced-Order Models, Nonlinear Systems
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地引入了递归追踪函数（RTFs），打破了传统Lyapunov追踪函数必须单调递减的限制，允许瞬时追踪误差，从而有效解决了高阶非线性系统中控制障碍函数（CBFs）构建困难的问题。这为复杂系统的安全关键控制提供了一条新途径。

title: EvoWorld: Evolving Panoramic World Generation with Explicit 3D Memory
summary: Humans possess a remarkable ability to mentally explore and replay 3D environments they have previously experienced. Inspired by this mental process, we present EvoWorld: a world model that bridges panoramic video generation with evolving 3D memory to enable spatially consistent long-horizon exploration. Given a single panoramic image as input, EvoWorld first generates future video frames by leveraging a video generator with fine-grained view control, then evolves the scene's 3D reconstruction using a feedforward plug-and-play transformer, and finally synthesizes futures by conditioning on geometric reprojections from this evolving explicit 3D memory. Unlike prior state-of-the-arts that synthesize videos only, our key insight lies in exploiting this evolving 3D reconstruction as explicit spatial guidance for the video generation process, projecting the reconstructed geometry onto target viewpoints to provide rich spatial cues that significantly enhance both visual realism and geometric consistency. To evaluate long-range exploration capabilities, we introduce the first comprehensive benchmark spanning synthetic outdoor environments, Habitat indoor scenes, and challenging real-world scenarios, with particular emphasis on loop-closure detection and spatial coherence over extended trajectories. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our evolving 3D memory substantially improves visual fidelity and maintains spatial scene coherence compared to existing approaches, representing a significant advance toward long-horizon spatially consistent world modeling.

AI.title_translation: EvoWorld：基于显式3D记忆的演化全景世界生成
AI.tldr: EvoWorld通过融合演化的显式3D记忆与全景视频生成，实现了具有空间一致性的长程环境探索。
AI.motivation: 受人类能够心理探索和重放3D环境能力的启发，旨在解决现有视频生成模型在长程空间探索中缺乏空间一致性和几何真实感的问题。
AI.method: 给定单张全景图，首先利用带细粒度视点控制的视频生成器生成未来帧，接着通过前馈式即插即用Transformer演化场景的3D重建，最后通过该显式3D记忆的几何重投影条件来合成未来帧。
AI.result: 实验表明，EvoWorld的演式3D记忆显著提升了视觉保真度，并在扩展轨迹上保持了空间场景的一致性，优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: EvoWorld通过结合全景视频生成与演化的显式3D记忆，有效解决了长程视频生成中的空间一致性难题，在合成及真实场景中均表现出优异的性能。
AI.translation: 人类拥有一种非凡的能力，能够在脑海中探索和重放他们以前经历过的3D环境。受这一心理过程的启发，我们提出了EvoWorld：一个将全景视频生成与演化的3D记忆相结合的世界模型，以实现空间一致的长程探索。给定单张全景图像作为输入，EvoWorld首先利用具有细粒度视点控制的视频生成器生成未来的视频帧，然后通过前馈式的即插即用Transformer演化场景的3D重建，最后通过对这个演化的显式3D记忆进行几何重投影来合成未来帧。与以往仅合成视频的先进方法不同，我们的核心洞察在于利用这种演化的3D重建作为视频生成过程的显式空间引导，将重建的几何体投影到目标视点上，以提供丰富的空间线索，从而显著增强视觉真实感和几何一致性。为了评估长程探索能力，我们引入了第一个涵盖合成室外环境、Habitat室内场景和具有挑战性的真实世界场景的综合基准，特别强调闭环检测和长轨迹上的空间相干性。大量实验表明，与现有方法相比，我们的演化3D记忆显著提高了视觉保真度并保持了空间场景的相干性，代表着向长程空间一致世界模型迈出的重要一步。
AI.summary: 本文提出了EvoWorld，一个将全景视频生成与演化的显式3D记忆相结合的世界模型，用于实现空间一致的长程探索。它利用演化的3D重建作为显式空间引导，显著提升了视觉真实感和几何一致性，并引入了一个全新的综合基准进行评估。
AI.keywords: 世界模型, 3D记忆, 全景视频生成, 空间一致性, 长程探索
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将全景视频生成与显式3D记忆相结合，通过不断演化的3D重建结果来引导视频生成，从而在长程空间探索中保持了几何一致性和视觉真实感。这对具身智能和世界模型的发展具有重要意义。

title: UpSafe$^\circ$C: Upcycling for Controllable Safety in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across a wide range of tasks, but remain vulnerable to safety risks such as harmful content generation and jailbreak attacks. Existing safety techniques---including external guardrails, inference-time guidance, and post-training alignment---each face limitations in balancing safety, utility, and controllability. In this work, we propose UpSafe$^\circ$C, a unified framework for enhancing LLM safety through safety-aware upcycling. Our approach first identifies safety-critical layers and upcycles them into a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) structure, where the router acts as a soft guardrail that selectively activates original MLPs and added safety experts. We further introduce a two-stage SFT strategy to strengthen safety discrimination while preserving general capabilities. To enable flexible control at inference time, we introduce a safety temperature mechanism, allowing dynamic adjustment of the trade-off between safety and utility. Experiments across multiple benchmarks, base model, and model scales demonstrate that UpSafe$^\circ$C achieves robust safety improvements against harmful and jailbreak inputs, while maintaining competitive performance on general tasks. Moreover, analysis shows that safety temperature provides fine-grained inference-time control that achieves controllable trade-off between utility and safety. Our results highlight a new direction for LLM safety: moving from static alignment toward dynamic, modular, and inference-aware control. Code: https://github.com/HansSunY/UpSafe.

AI.title_translation: UpSafe°C：用于大语言模型中可控安全性的上循环技术
AI.tldr: UpSafe°C 是一种通过稀疏 MoE 结构和推理时安全温度控制来增强大模型安全性的统一框架，能有效平衡安全性和通用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的大模型安全技术（如外部护栏、推理时引导和后训练对齐）在平衡安全性、实用性和可控性方面存在局限性，为此需要一种统一的框架来实现动态、模块化和推理感知的安全控制。
AI.method: 提出 UpSafe°C 框架：首先识别安全关键层并将其上循环为稀疏混合专家（MoE）结构（引入路由器作为软护栏），接着通过两阶段有监督微调（SFT）策略增强安全判别力并保留通用能力，最后引入安全温度机制在推理时动态调整安全与效用的权衡。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试、基础模型和模型规模上的实验表明，UpSafe°C 在抵御有害输入和越狱攻击方面实现了稳健的安全提升，同时在通用任务上保持了具有竞争力的性能；安全温度机制也实现了细粒度的推理时控制。
AI.conclusion: UpSafe°C 提供了一种统一、动态且模块化的方法来增强大模型安全性，通过安全感知上循环和推理时安全温度控制，有效平衡了模型的安全性和通用效用，代表了LLM安全技术的一个新方向。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）在广泛的任务中取得了显著进展，但仍然容易受到有害内容生成和越狱攻击等安全风险的影响。现有的安全技术——包括外部护栏、推理时引导和后训练对齐——在平衡安全性、实用性和可控性方面都面临局限性。在这项工作中，我们提出了 UpSafe°C，这是一个通过安全感知上循环增强 LLM 安全性的统一框架。我们的方法首先识别安全关键层，并将其上循环为稀疏混合专家（MoE）结构，其中的路由器充当软护栏，选择性地激活原始 MLP 和新添加的安全专家。我们进一步引入了两阶段 SFT 策略，以增强安全鉴别能力，同时保留通用能力。为了在推理时实现灵活控制，我们引入了安全温度机制，允许动态调整安全与实用性之间的权衡。在多个基准测试、基础模型和模型规模上的实验表明，UpSafe°C 针对有害和越狱输入实现了稳健的安全改进，同时在通用任务上保持了具有竞争力的性能。此外，分析表明安全温度提供了细粒度的推理时控制，实现了效用和安全性之间可控的权衡。我们的结果突出了 LLM 安全性的一个新方向：从静态对齐转向动态、模块化和推理感知的控制。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 UpSafe°C 框架，通过将大模型的安全关键层上循环为稀疏 MoE 结构，结合两阶段 SFT 和推理时的“安全温度”动态调控机制，在确保模型抵抗有害和越狱攻击的同时，维持了通用任务的性能。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 模型安全, 混合专家模型（MoE）, 上循环, 对齐技术
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的大模型安全上循环（Upcycling）与稀疏MoE架构，通过动态的“安全温度”机制在推理时灵活控制安全性与通用能力的平衡，具有很高的实用价值和学术启发性。

title: ESS-Flow: Training-free guidance as Bayesian inference in source space
summary: Guiding pretrained flow-based generative models for conditional generation or to produce samples with desired target properties enables solving diverse tasks without retraining on paired data. We present ESS-Flow, a gradient-free method that leverages the Gaussian prior of the source distribution in flow-based models to perform Bayesian inference directly in the source space using elliptical slice sampling. ESS-Flow only requires forward passes through the generative model and observation process, making it applicable even when gradients are unavailable, such as with non-differentiable simulation-based observations or quantization in the generation process. We demonstrate its effectiveness on scientific applications including generating materials with target properties, protein backbone structures with improved designability, and synthesizable, drug-like molecules.

AI.title_translation: ESS-Flow：作为源空间贝叶斯推理的无需训练引导方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需梯度的ESS-Flow方法，通过在源空间进行贝叶斯推理来引导流模型，适用于非可微的科学应用任务。
AI.motivation: 现有的预训练流生成模型条件引导方法通常需要梯度信息，但在许多实际应用（如非可微的基于模拟的观测或量化过程）中梯度往往不可用，因此需要一种无需重新训练且无需梯度的引导方法。
AI.method: 利用流模型中源分布的高斯先验，使用椭圆切片采样（elliptical slice sampling）直接在源空间中进行贝叶斯推理，且仅需通过生成模型和观测过程的前向传递。
AI.result: 在科学应用中展示了有效性，包括生成具有目标特性的材料、具有更高可设计性的蛋白质骨架结构以及可合成的类药分子。
AI.conclusion: ESS-Flow成功将椭圆切片采样应用于流模型的源空间，实现了无需微调和梯度的条件生成，拓展了流生成模型在复杂科学任务中的应用。
AI.translation: 引导预训练的基于流的生成模型进行条件生成，或生成具有所需目标属性的样本，能够在无需在成对数据上重新训练的情况下解决多样化的任务。我们提出了ESS-Flow，这是一种无需梯度的方法，它利用流模型中源分布的高斯先验，使用椭圆切片采样直接在源空间中进行贝叶斯推理。ESS-Flow仅需要通过生成模型和观测过程进行前向传递，这使得它即使在梯度不可用时（例如具有不可微的基于模拟的观测或生成过程中的量化）也适用。我们在科学应用中证明了其有效性，包括生成具有目标特性的材料、具有提高可设计性的蛋白质骨架结构以及可合成的类药分子。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了ESS-Flow，一种无需梯度的方法，它通过在流模型的源空间中使用椭圆切片采样进行贝叶斯推理，从而在不需要重新训练的情况下引导预训练流模型进行条件生成。该方法仅需前向传递，适用于非可微观测，并在材料、蛋白质和药物设计等科学应用中证明了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 流生成模型, 贝叶斯推理, 椭圆切片采样, 引导生成, 科学应用
AI.comments: ESS-Flow提出了一种无梯度、基于源空间贝叶斯推理的方法来引导流模型，避免了传统方法对可微性的依赖，在科学发现领域（如材料设计、蛋白质骨架生成和药物设计）展现了很高的应用价值。

title: Rethinking Reasoning: A Survey on Reasoning-based Backdoors in LLMs
summary: With the rise of advanced reasoning capabilities, large language models (LLMs) are receiving increasing attention. However, although reasoning improves LLMs' performance on downstream tasks, it also introduces new security risks, as adversaries can exploit these capabilities to conduct backdoor attacks. Existing surveys on backdoor attacks and reasoning security offer comprehensive overviews but lack in-depth analysis of backdoor attacks and defenses targeting LLMs' reasoning abilities. In this paper, we take the first step toward providing a comprehensive review of reasoning-based backdoor attacks in LLMs by analyzing their underlying mechanisms, methodological frameworks, and unresolved challenges. Specifically, we introduce a new taxonomy that offers a unified perspective for summarizing existing approaches, categorizing reasoning-based backdoor attacks into associative, passive, and active. We also present defense strategies against such attacks and discuss current challenges alongside potential directions for future research. This work offers a novel perspective, paving the way for further exploration of secure and trustworthy LLM communities.

AI.title_translation: 重新思考推理：大语言模型中基于推理的后门攻击综述
AI.tldr: 本文首次全面综述了大语言模型中利用推理能力的后门攻击，提出了新的分类法并探讨了防御策略与未来挑战。
AI.motivation: 尽管推理能力提升了大语言模型在下游任务中的性能，但也引入了新的安全风险。现有综述缺乏对针对LLM推理能力的后门攻击和防御的深入分析，因此需要进行系统的综述研究。
AI.method: 通过分析底层机制、方法论框架和未解决的挑战，提出了一种新的分类法，将基于推理的后门攻击分为关联式、被动式和主动式，并总结了相应的防御策略。
AI.result: 建立了一个统一的分类体系，涵盖了关联式、被动式和主动式推理后门攻击，系统梳理了现有的防御策略，并指出了该领域面临的挑战和未来研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 本文对大语言模型中基于推理的后门攻击进行了系统性回顾，提出了统一的分类标准和防御策略，并指出了未来的研究方向，为实现更安全可信的LLM社区奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 随着高级推理能力的崛起，大语言模型（LLM）正受到越来越多的关注。然而，尽管推理提高了LLM在下游任务中的性能，但也引入了新的安全风险，因为攻击者可以利用这些能力进行后门攻击。现有的关于后门攻击和推理安全的综述提供了全面的概述，但缺乏对针对LLM推理能力的后门攻击和防御的深入分析。在本文中，我们迈出了全面回顾LLM中基于推理的后门攻击的第一步，通过分析其底层机制、方法论框架和未解决的挑战。具体而言，我们引入了一种新的分类法，为总结现有方法提供了统一的视角，将基于推理的后门攻击分类为关联式、被动式和主动式。我们还提出了针对此类攻击的防御策略，并讨论了当前的挑战以及未来研究的潜在方向。这项工作提供了一个新颖的视角，为进一步探索安全和可信的LLM社区铺平了道路。
AI.summary: 本文首次对大语言模型（LLM）中基于推理的后门攻击进行了全面综述。文章分析了其底层机制与方法框架，提出了一种将攻击分为关联式、被动式和主动式的新分类法，总结了相关的防御策略，并探讨了未来的研究方向与开放性挑战。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 推理能力, 后门攻击, 安全与防御, 综述
AI.comments: 该论文首次对大语言模型中基于推理的后门攻击进行了全面综述，填补了该领域的空白。其提出的新分类法（关联式、被动式、主动式）为理解和防范此类安全威胁提供了清晰的理论框架，对构建安全可靠的LLM具有重要意义。

title: Learning Soft Robotic Dynamics with Active Exploration
summary: Soft robots offer adaptability and safety in unstructured environments, yet their compliant, high-dimensional, and nonlinear dynamics make modeling for control difficult. Existing data-driven approaches often fail to generalize, constrained by narrowly focused task demonstrations or inefficient random exploration. We introduce an uncertainty-aware active exploration framework that autonomously learns task-agnostic and generalizable dynamics models of soft robotic systems. We evaluate this framework on three simulated platforms---a continuum arm, an articulated fish in fluid, and a musculoskeletal leg---and on a real-world pneumatically actuated continuum arm. Compared with random exploration and task-specific baseline, our method achieves higher modeling accuracy by actively collecting informative data. This improved model quality yields higher returns in zero-shot control on unseen tasks and robust performance under sensing noise, actuation delays, and material nonlinearities. These results demonstrate that uncertainty-driven active exploration enables data-efficient dynamics learning across soft robotic morphologies, supporting autonomous and adaptable control for compliant robots.

title: On Spectral Clustering in Algebraic Multigrid Methods
summary: We introduce a new direct multilevel method for solving general nonsingular complex square linear systems admitting a suitable block partition, using a regular smoother and an arbitrary but equal number of pre- and post-smoothings. Through careful analysis of the error propagation operator, we cluster the spectrum of this operator. This allows us to write a direct K-cycle version of the method.

title: Game-theoretic Regulated Decentralized Coordination for Airspace Sector Overload Mitigation
summary: Decentralized air traffic management systems offer a scalable alternative to centralized control, but often assume high levels of cooperation. In practice, such assumptions frequently break down since agents, each representing an airspace sector, may operate independently and prioritize local objectives. We address the problem of sector overload in decentralized air traffic management by proposing a regulated decentralized protocol that models self-interested behaviors based on best response dynamics. Each agent adjusts the departure times of its assigned flights to reduce its own congestion, without requiring centralized joint optimization. A tunable cooperativeness factor models the degree to which each agent accounts for overload in other sectors, while a minimal admissibility rule prevents local updates from creating new overloads. We show that this regulatory restriction is sufficient to guarantee finite-time convergence of best response dynamics to a pure Nash equilibrium under partial cooperation. In addition, we identify a sufficient condition under which an overload-free solution corresponds to a global minimizer of the potential function. Numerical experiments using one month of European flight data demonstrate that the proposed algorithm substantially reduces overload even with only minimal cooperation, achieving performance close to a centralized global mixed-integer optimizer and exceeding a centralized first-come-first-served baseline while requiring substantially less computation than centralized optimization. We further evaluate departure delay and fairness to quantify the operational cost of overload mitigation.

title: Counterfactual World Models via Digital Twin-conditioned Video Diffusion
summary: World models learn to predict the temporal evolution of visual observations given a control signal, potentially enabling agents to reason about environments through forward simulation. Because of the focus on forward simulation, current world models generate predictions based on factual observations. For many emerging applications, such as comprehensive evaluations of physical AI behavior under varying conditions, the ability of world models to answer counterfactual queries -- such as "what would happen if this object was removed?" -- is of increasing importance. We formalize counterfactual world models that additionally take interventions as explicit inputs, predicting temporal sequences under hypothetical modifications to observed scene properties. Traditional world models operate directly on entangled pixel-space representations where object properties and relationships cannot be selectively modified. This modeling choice prevents targeted interventions on specific scene properties. We introduce CWMDT, a framework to overcome those limitations, turning standard video diffusion models into effective counterfactual world models. First, CWMDT constructs digital twins of observed scenes to explicitly encode objects and their relationships, represented as structured text. Second, CWMDT applies large language models to reason over these representations and predict how a counterfactual intervention propagates through time to alter the observed scene. Third, CWMDT conditions a video diffusion model with the modified representation to generate counterfactual visual sequences. Evaluations on two benchmarks show that the CWMDT approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, suggesting that alternative representations of videos, such as the digital twins considered here, offer powerful control signals for video forward simulation-based world models.

title: AEGIS: Preserving Privacy of 3D Facial Avatars with Adversarial Perturbations
comments: Accepted to WACV 2027. Source code at: https://github.com/Woleek/AEGIS
summary: The growing adoption of photorealistic 3D facial avatars, particularly those utilizing efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting representations, introduces new risks of online identity theft, especially in systems that rely on biometric authentication. While effective adversarial masking methods have been developed for 2D images, a significant gap remains in achieving robust, viewpoint-consistent identity protection for dynamic 3D avatars. To address this, we present AEGIS, the first privacy-preserving identity masking framework for 3D Gaussian avatars, concealing identity from automated face recognition while preserving the avatar's perceptual realism and animation usability. AEGIS applies adversarial perturbations to the base (DC) color coefficients of the Gaussian primitives, guided by an ensemble of pre-trained face verification networks, embedding the protection directly in the 3D representation so that it applies across viewpoints and animations, without retraining or modifying the avatar's geometry. Evaluated against black-box recognizers, AEGIS reduces face retrieval and verification accuracy to near-zero while maintaining high perceptual fidelity. It also preserves key facial attributes such as age, gender, and emotion, demonstrating strong privacy protection with minimal visual distortion. We further introduce a viewpoint-robust leakage metric that quantifies residual identity leakage across an avatar's rendered viewpoints, which single-view evaluation cannot capture.
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. Source code at: https://github.com/Woleek/AEGIS

title: TokenScale: Timely and Accurate Autoscaling for Disaggregated LLM Serving with Token Velocity
summary: The architectural shift to prefill/decode (PD) disaggregation in LLM serving improves resource utilization but struggles with the bursty nature of modern workloads. Existing autoscaling policies, often retrofitted from monolithic systems like those in AIBrix and DistServe, rely on lagging indicators such as GPU utilization or coarse-grained request counts. This results in slow reactions to load spikes, leading to significant Time-to First-Token (TTFT) and Time-Per-Output-Token (TPOT) SLO violations and costly over-provisioning. We introduce TokenScale, an autoscaling framework that resolves this performance mismatch through two innovations. First, we propose Token Velocity, a novel metric that unifies the prefill, network, and decode stages by quantifying their rate of work. As a leading indicator of system backpressure, it enables proactive scaling. Second, Convertible Decoders allow decoder GPUs to dynamically execute prefill tasks during traffic spikes, creating a rapid-response buffer that absorbs bursts and eliminates the initialization latency of new prefillers. Our evaluation on a GPU cluster with production traces shows TokenScale improves SLO attainment from 50-88% to 80-96% and reduces costs by 4-14% over state-of-the-art systems, including DistServe, BlitzScale, and AIBrix. By uniting a predictive metric with a flexible system design, TokenScale significantly boosts the performance and efficiency of disaggregated LLM serving infrastructure.

title: ZeBROD: Zero-Retraining Based Recognition and Object Detection Framework
summary: Object detection constitutes the primary task within the domain of computer vision. It is utilized in numerous domains. Nonetheless, object detection continues to encounter the issue of catastrophic forgetting. The model must be retrained whenever new products are introduced, utilizing not only the new products dataset but also the entirety of the previous dataset. The outcome is obvious: increasing model training expenses and significant time consumption. In numerous sectors, particularly retail checkout, the frequent introduction of new products presents a great challenge. This study introduces Zero-Retraining Based Recognition and Object Detection (ZeBROD), a methodology designed to address the issue of catastrophic forgetting by integrating YOLO11n for object localization with DeIT and Proxy Anchor Loss for feature extraction and metric learning. For classification, we utilize cosine similarity between the embedding features of the target product and those in the Qdrant vector database. In a case study conducted in a retail store with 140 products, the experimental results demonstrate that our proposed framework achieves encouraging accuracy, whether for detecting new or existing products. Furthermore, without retraining, the training duration difference is significant. We achieve almost 3 times the training time efficiency compared to classical object detection approaches. This efficiency escalates as additional new products are added to the product database. The average inference time is 580 ms per image containing multiple products, on an edge device, validating the proposed framework's feasibility for practical use.

title: Embedding User Comments into Long-Form Reading: Design and Evaluation of Contextual Comment Presentation
summary: Online comments offer perspectives on long-form articles but are often separated from the passages they discuss, requiring readers to navigate back and forth and mentally reconstruct comment-text relationships. To preserve these relationships while maintaining reading continuity, we explored contextual comment presentation that makes comments locally accessible at the passages they address. We compared Text-End, Sentence-End, Between-Line, and Click-to-Show in a within-subject study with 24 participants using constructed comments and fixed sentence-level anchors. All three local layouts reduced initial-reading scrolling, with no significant condition effects on accuracy or elapsed task time. Sentence-End and Between-Line received higher comment-accessibility ratings than Text-End, while Click-to-Show received higher physical-demand ratings than Text-End and Sentence-End. Preferences remained distributed across all four layouts.

title: Space efficient implementation of hypergraph dualization in the D-basis algorithm
comments: 17 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to Discrete Applied Mathematics. Results were presented at the AMS 2025 Fall Western Sectional Meeting at the University of Denver
summary: We present a new implementation of the $D$-basis algorithm called the Small Space which considerably reduces the algorithm's memory usage for data analysis applications. The previous implementation delivers the complete set of implications that hold on the set of attributes of an input binary table. In the new version, the only output is the frequencies of attributes that appear in the antecedents of implications from the $D$-basis, with a fixed consequent attribute. Such frequencies, rather than the implications themselves, became the primary focus in analysis of datasets where the $D$-basis has been applied over the last decade. The $D$-basis employs a hypergraph dualization algorithm, and a dualization implementation known as Reverse Search allows for the gradual computation of frequencies without the need for storing all discovered implications. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the Small Space implementation by comparing the runtimes and maximum memory usage of this new version with the current implementation.
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to Discrete Applied Mathematics. Results were presented at the AMS 2025 Fall Western Sectional Meeting at the University of Denver

title: A Granular Framework for Construction Material Price Forecasting: Econometric and Machine-Learning Approaches
summary: The persistent volatility of construction material prices poses significant risks to cost estimation, budgeting, and project delivery, underscoring the urgent need for granular and scalable forecasting methods. This study develops a forecasting framework that leverages the Construction Specifications Institute (CSI) MasterFormat as the target data structure, enabling predictions at the six-digit Section level and supporting detailed cost projections across a wide spectrum of building materials. To enhance predictive accuracy, the framework integrates explanatory variables such as raw material prices, commodity indexes, and macroeconomic indicators. Five time-series models, long short-term memory (LSTM), autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA), vector error correction model (VECM), vanilla Transformer, and Chronos-Bolt, were evaluated under both baseline configurations (using CSI data only) and extended versions with explanatory variables. Results demonstrate that incorporating explanatory variables significantly improves predictive performance across all models. Among the tested approaches, the LSTM model consistently achieved the highest accuracy, with root mean squared error (RMSE) values as low as 4.19 and mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) values of 1.60 based on Division 06 as a representative demonstration, representing improvements of up to 59% over the traditional statistical time-series model, ARIMA. Validation across multiple CSI Divisions within the residential-material confirmed the framework's scalability, while Division 06 (Wood, Plastics, and Composites) is presented in detail as a demonstration case. This research offers a robust methodology that enables owners and contractors to improve budgeting practices and achieve more reliable cost estimation at the definitive level.

title: From Lab to Reality: A Practical Evaluation of Deep Learning Models and LLMs for Vulnerability Detection
comments: Accepted for publication in Journal of Systems and Software (JSS)
summary: Vulnerability detection methods based on deep learning (DL) have shown strong performance on benchmark datasets, yet their real-world effectiveness remains underexplored. Recent work suggests that graph neural network-based and transformer-based models, including large language models (LLMs), yield promising results when evaluated on curated benchmark datasets. These datasets are typically characterized by similar data distributions and may contain synthetic samples, heuristic labels, or labeling noise. In this study, we systematically evaluate four representative DL models---Devign, ReVeal, LineVul, and VulBERTa---across four representative datasets: Juliet, Devign, BigVul, and ICVul. Each model is trained independently on each dataset, and the graph-based and CodeBERT representations adopted by these models are analyzed using t-SNE and centroid distance to examine vulnerability-related patterns. To assess realistic applicability, we further evaluate trained ReVeal and LineVul models, along with four open-weight LLMs, on VentiVul, our newly constructed temporally separated out-of-distribution (OOD) dataset comprising 200 recent vulnerabilities from Linux and Chromium. Our experiments reveal that current representation methods struggle to distinguish vulnerable from non-vulnerable code and that trained models generalize poorly across datasets with differing distributions and characteristics. When evaluated on VentiVul, performance drops sharply, with most models failing to detect vulnerabilities reliably or distinguish vulnerable functions from their patched counterparts. These results expose a persistent gap between academic benchmarks and real-world deployment, emphasizing the value of our deployment-oriented evaluation framework and the need for more robust code representations, higher-quality datasets, and evaluation methods that account for vulnerability-fixing changes.
comment: Accepted for publication in Journal of Systems and Software (JSS)

title: PubTables-v2: A new large-scale dataset for full-page and multi-page table extraction
summary: Table extraction (TE) is a key challenge in document understanding. Traditional approaches detect tables first, then recognize their structure. Recently, interest has surged in developing methods, such as vision-language models (VLMs), to extract tables directly in their full page or document context. However, a lack of annotated data has made progress difficult to demonstrate. To address this, we create a new large-scale dataset, PubTables-v2. PubTables-v2 unifies TE across various levels of surrounding context and, notably, is the first benchmark for multi-page TE. Our evaluations reveal that while current frontier models strongly outperform ($+0.354\ \textrm{GriTS}_\textrm{Con}$) small models on the most complex task (full-document multi-page TE), this gap can be closed or even reversed ($-0.056\ \textrm{GriTS}_\textrm{Con}$) on narrower tasks (cropped table extraction) with targeted training. Data is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/kensho/PubTables-v2.

title: SUPER - Sensitivity-based Uncertainty-aware Performance and Risk Assessment in Visual Inertial Odometry
comments: 6 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. v2: substantially revised. The Schur-complement risk indicator of v1 is replaced by a closed-loop controller adapting visual information from multi-view track dispersion, with a new action-verification protocol. ISO risk mapping and the prediction/stop-policy results of v1 are removed. v2 claims no general accuracy improvement
summary: This paper presents SUPER (Sensitivity-based Uncertainty-aware PErformance and Risk assessment), a bounded controller that adapts visual measurement information in visual-inertial odometry at runtime. Building on multi-view landmark dispersion from stereo observations, SUPER projects track consistency into pixel space and combines it with the reprojection residual to gate a temporally smoothed, bounded information update. Because the controller operates inside nondeterministic optimizers, we additionally propose an action-verification protocol based on factor-level logs, inactive-instrumented controls, and same-linearization replay. We evaluate SUPER in Ceres and g2o backends on EuRoC, TUM-VI, UMA-VI, and TartanAir under controlled visual corruptions, with a frozen policy and prospective confirmation. SUPER is computationally efficient and selectively active, but does not establish a general accuracy improvement: all 13 split-level confidence intervals cross zero, and effects are heterogeneous across corruption families. The action-verification protocol reliably distinguishes controller-induced state changes from solver variability.

The Schur-complement risk indicator of v1 is replaced by a closed-loop controller adapting visual information from multi-view track dispersion, with a new action-verification protocol.
