title: Second-Order Image Characterization with Distortion and Secrecy
summary: Image characterization relates coding budgets to the probability carried by source cells and their output images. At second order, refining a cell can reveal unavailable information, while a change of reference measure can alter the relevant likelihood fluctuations. We establish image bounds that account for both effects. A finite-block partition theorem bounds the cost of merging component images by the joint conditional information spectrum of their label. It preserves continuous second-order profiles when that cost is negligible on the square-root blocklength scale. For reconstruction constraints, cell-dependent reference measures retain the actual distortion deficits in a single likelihood. A Gaussian evaluation gives matching second-order rates for Heegard--Berger coding with one uninformed decoder in the strict both-active regime, common reconstruction under a joint agreement and distortion criterion, and two-stage refinement with side information absent at the first decoder. A structured binary source illustrates partition stability even when its global density and conditional-divergence deficits are linear in blocklength. Posterior-mass images also sharpen extraction after a public refinement by charging its residual information rather than its alphabet size. These results preserve the joint constraints and the observations available for choosing the local coding experiment.

title: Multi-Agent Coordination via Support-Preserving Distillation
summary: Offline MARL increasingly relies on generative policies to model multimodal joint behavior, typically by distilling a centralized teacher into decentralized one-step actors under the CTDE. We identify a failure mode at the teacher training stage: standard flow-based teachers pair noise with replay targets independently, so nearby noise samples can be routed toward conflicting coordination modes. The teacher then produces samples between valid modes, and because the distillation loss regresses each local actor onto the conditional mean of the teacher's output given local input, this error is not absorbed but propagated to the student. To remove this teacher-side artifact, we propose Mode-Support Semi-Discrete Optimal Transport (MoSDOT), which summarizes multimodal replay into a finite mode support with prescribed capacities and uses conditional semi-discrete optimal transport to assign each noise sample to a single mode before teacher training. We additionally study a shared-randomness variant that uses a shared noise component at execution to expose the residual gap intrinsic to strict-product execution. On controlled diagnostics and offline MARL benchmarks, MoSDOT improves endpoint quality and routing consistency, particularly on datasets exhibiting multimodal joint behavior.

title: Language Models as AI Research World Models
summary: AI research agents automate the cycle of proposing, implementing, and evaluating experiments, opening a path toward recursive self-improvement. Yet their ability to propose experiments outpaces their capacity to execute them in real environments, making outcome prediction a key capability for sustained self-improvement under limited experimental budgets. We investigate language models as Research World Models (RWMs), which predict the outcomes of candidate interventions across research environments. Our evaluation draws on over 2,600 experimental records from nine research environments spanning pretraining, post-training, and inference, representing more than 171,000 H100 GPU-hours of experimentation. Research knowledge acquired from real experimental experience improves RWM predictions of unseen interventions within the same environment (Spearman +0.27), and can be reused across environments. For example, using only pretraining experience from OLMo3, Marin, and Nanochat, an RWM reduces selection regret in the Qwen3 environment by 78% compared with zero-experience setting. These benefits extend to multi-round Autoresearch under a fixed selection budget: RWMs with in-env and cross-env research knowledge increase the best gain achieved by 15.8% and 11.6%, respectively. Ablations across 13 language models used as RWMs show that adding research knowledge can improve intervention ranking more than changing models or increasing reasoning effort alone. These findings support language models as RWMs and motivate accumulating experimental data for future RWM training.

title: Parallel Edge Ranking of Trees
summary:
In this work, we prove that computing the edge ranking of a tree in parallel is P-Complete, and complement this hardness with new algorithmic results for both PRAM and the MPC model. An optimal tree edge ranking assigns positive integer ranks to the edges such that any two edges with the same rank are separated by an edge of higher rank, while minimizing the highest rank. Although an optimal edge ranking, which minimizes the maximum rank, can be computed in polynomial time sequentially, its parallel complexity has remained open for almost 35 years [de la Torre, Greenlaw, Schäffer, SODA'93] and was listed as an open problem in Limits to Parallel Computation [Greenlaw, Hoover, Ruzzo, 1995]. Specifically, we show that deciding whether a tree has edge ranking at most $K$ is P-complete, already for trees of diameter at most six. Our reduction encodes monotone circuit evaluation into a greedy allocation procedure underlying known sequential algorithms. Using a rooted product of trees, we further prove that computing an edge ranking within constant additive error remains P-hard.
  On the algorithmic side, we break the long-standing 2-approximation barrier by designing a deterministic NC algorithm that computes an $(1+o(1))$-approximate edge ranking. Second, we show that P-completeness can be bypassed in Massively Parallel Computation (MPC) with strongly sublinear local memory: we give a deterministic algorithm that computes an optimal edge ranking of an $n$-vertex, diameter-$D$ tree in $O(\log D + \frac{n^{3/4}D^{1/4}}{S})$ rounds with $S = Θ(n^{3/4+δ})$ local memory, for $δ\in (0, 1/4)$, requiring only $O(1)$ rounds on the hard diameter-six instances. This result reinforces the separation between $\mathsf{NC}$ and what can be computed efficiently in MPC.

title: PriMoRetarget: Humanoid Motion Transfer Through Prioritized Motion Retargeting
summary: Motion retargeting is a critical preprocessing step for transferring human motion data to humanoid robots. While existing methods are effective for single-character motions, interactions involving multiple characters and objects introduce additional contacts and spatial relationships that must be preserved. Retargeting is commonly formulated as a weighted multi-objective optimization problem, where conflicting objectives can require careful tuning of relative weights and can still compromise important motion characteristics. We introduce PriMoRetarget, a prioritized motion-retargeting framework that replaces relative objective weighting with an explicit priority hierarchy. Lower-priority updates are constrained to preserve higher-priority objectives, allowing critical characteristics such as foot placement and interaction contacts to take precedence over lower-priority pose objectives. The method is evaluated on four datasets spanning single-character motion, character-object manipulation, and character-character interactions. The resulting motions better preserve task-relevant interactions and provide reference trajectories that can be tracked more reliably than those produced by widely used retargeting methods.

title: Anechoic: Onsager-Corrected Parallel Annealing for Sub-0.1 ms Dense Max-Cut on an FPGA
summary: Ising machines solve combinatorial optimization problems by annealing a network of spins. On dense problems, the least expensive hardware step updates all spins at once: stochastic cellular automata (SCA) decide every spin in parallel and read couplings only for the spins that flip. Such synchronous updates create an echo: the previous state of each spin returns to it through its neighbors. On K2000, a Max-Cut benchmark on a 2,000-node complete graph, two-thirds of all flips undo the same spin's flip one step earlier. This paper presents Anechoic, an FPGA Ising machine that subtracts this echo from every decision. Dynamical mean-field theory identifies the echo as an Onsager reaction; its one-step strength is the number of spins whose flip probability is strictly between 0 and 1, divided by twice the temperature. The decision logic already flags these spins, so the correction costs one population count per step; a temperature-scaled form needs none. An RTL engine executes a dense 2,000-spin step in 18.1 cycles plus 0.14 per flip, so every saved step and flip saves time. Both forms find better K2000 cuts at every step budget than five published binary-spin algorithms at their papers' settings. Twelve engines at 250 MHz on an AMD Alveo V80 reach a cut of at least 33,000 with 99% probability in 0.05 ms, 5.2 times faster than the fastest published hardware, at 5.4 mJ per solution; with 2-bit couplings, the temperature-scaled form is also faster than uncorrected SCA on 49 of 51 G-set graphs. On an NVIDIA GH200 GPU, the same engine is 2.3 times slower and needs 8.0 times more energy per solution, though its 240 concurrent anneals give 2.3 times the throughput. As a GlobalFoundries 22 nm ASIC at 1.25 GHz, twelve engines would reach the target in about 10 microseconds, 26 times faster than the fastest published hardware. The code is available at https://github.com/skethz/anechoic.

title: SpikCTU: A Compact Spiking Network with Adaptive Recurrent Computation for Speech Command Recognition
summary: Spiking Neural Networks offer event-driven, energy-efficient computation for speech command recognition, yet most existing methods follow fixed computation paths, allocating redundant computation to easy samples while providing limited insight into how evidence evolves during inference. To address these challenges, we introduce SpikCTU, a compact spiking network with adaptive recurrent computation for speech command recognition. Specifically, a hybrid spiking embedding module preserves continuous input information alongside spike features to construct a fixed temporal memory. A shared Continuous Thinking Unit (CTU) repeatedly reads this memory using keys derived from spikes and continuous values, and updates a binary recurrent state with lightweight stage adapters. Furthermore, combining a fixed base prediction with accumulated corrections at each step enables learned aggregation over all steps or confidence-based early exit using only the predictions available so far. Experiments on three speech command recognition benchmarks show that SpikCTU achieves competitive accuracy with only 0.16--0.17M parameters, and the early exit strategy can substantially further reduce computational cost without compromising accuracy. In addition, trajectory and attention analyses reveal that recurrent steps enable error correction and progressively refine predictions. Code is available at https://github.com/Rivflyyy/spikctu.

title: RetryBench: Separating Retry Permission from Recovery Outcomes in GPT Tool Use
comments: LLM agents, tool use, idempotency, retry, failure recovery, evaluation, prompt sensitivity, position bias, reliability
summary: LLM agents that call external tools must decide what to do when a tool call times out: retrying risks duplicate side effects, while not retrying can leave the task incomplete. We present RetryBench, an evaluation protocol for retry decisions and failure recovery in tool-using LLM agents. Each decision is scored on retry permission (is the retry justified by an idempotency-key guarantee or proof of non-execution?), settled effects (duplicates and omissions), and completion, by replaying it across all hidden execution worlds consistent with the observation. On four synthetic software-engineering tasks, we run two controlled prompt-sensitivity studies (1,728 decisions). Study 1 (idempotency-key descriptions): with the contract fixed, GPT-5.6 Luna reuses the valid idempotency key in 10/40 decisions when an extra key is described as a "Candidate recovery key" but in 39/40 when it is an "Alternative key string"; across three further phrasings per family the gap is 27/120 versus 113/120. GPT-5.6 Sol and Terra are at ceiling (40/40). Study 2 (action order): under underspecified lookup guarantees, retry rates are 17-27 points lower for GPT-5.6 Terra and GPT-5.4 when retry is listed first (option-order bias), mainly on two tasks; we make no claim about which behavior is better. Findings are limited to researcher-chosen phrasings, four tasks and unpinned model aliases. Code and all model responses are released.
comment: LLM agents, tool use, idempotency, retry, failure recovery, evaluation, prompt sensitivity, position bias, reliability

title: Where Is the "Self" of a Large Language Model? -- From Self-Index to Self-Reference
summary: Whether a large language model has a self is usually argued without a way to measure it. We measure a functional self with two levels familiar from biology: a self-index, which marks material as the model's own, as animals tag self-generated signals with a corollary discharge, and self-reference, the ability to recognize what is one's own, as in mirror self-recognition. Our main finding is that language models mark their own messages in their internal representations and that recognizing these messages depends on this mark: no model we tested recognizes its own messages without it, and in the three models we edited, changing the mark removes or creates the recognition. We place the same text in an Assistant, a User, or a System message of the model's own chat template. In Qwen3.8-27B, the representation separates the model's own message from both external sources at every one of its 64 layers and in every held-out text. Asked who wrote a message, the model answers "you" with probability 0.77 for its own messages and at most 0.07 for the others. At each layer, we find eight directions along which the model's own message differs most from the same text as a User message. Giving the model's own message the User values along these directions lowers the rate of "you" to at most 0.05. Giving a User message the model's own values makes the model claim it, closing 41-67% of the gap between the two messages. Edits along eight random directions do neither. This holds in Qwen3.8-27B without and with thinking, gpt-oss-20b, and gpt-oss-120b. Across twenty-five open-weight models from fourteen developers, the two levels are nested: no model recognizes its own messages without a self-index, a pattern that would arise by chance with probability 0.004 if the levels were unrelated. These results support the account that self-reference is a readout of a self-index.

title: DTA-GT: Direction- and Topology-Aware Graph Transformer for Neural Network Representation Learning
summary: Architecture attribute predictors reduce the cost of neural architecture search by estimating accuracy or latency from a small set of evaluated candidates. Neural architectures are operation-labeled directed acyclic graphs (DAGs), where edge directions determine computational roles and execution dependencies. Existing graph Transformer predictors incorporate topological and directional information in different ways, but primarily focus on specific mechanisms rather than coordinated encoder-wide modeling of these semantics. We introduce encoder-wide directional consistency, a design principle that coordinates the modeling of directed computational semantics across node initialization, global spectral encoding, pairwise interaction, and feature updates. To implement this principle, we propose DTA-GT, a Direction- and Topology-Aware Graph Transformer that integrates direction- and topology-aware node initialization, Magnetic Laplacian spectral encoding, direction-dual structural attention, and a Direction-Sensitive MoE-FFN. Across accuracy and latency prediction on NAS-Bench-101 and NAS-Bench-201, DTA-GT consistently outperforms representative sequence-, GNN-, Transformer-, and hybrid predictors under limited-budget settings. Ablations and Magnetic spectral controls support the contribution of the direction-aware stages and orientation-sensitive spectral information, while mechanistic diagnostics characterize module behavior. These results support encoder-wide directional consistency as an effective design principle for architecture DAG representation.

title: Neuromorphic Decoding and Dynamical Image Reconstruction from Populations of Spiking Retinal Ganglion Cells
summary: Decoding visual stimuli from the spiking activity of retinal ganglion cells (RGCs) informs both our understanding of the retinal code and the design of visual prostheses. Natural vision is dynamic, yet state-of-the-art decoders mostly reconstruct single frames with artificial neural networks that process dense, continuous-valued signals rather than the retina's sparse, asynchronous spikes. We asked whether dynamic scenes can be reconstructed and tracked entirely within the spike domain, and at what computational cost. We built an end-to-end spiking neural network (SNN) whose neurons integrate the recorded RGC spikes over time. Populations of up to 1836 RGCs were recorded ex vivo from mouse retina on high-density microelectrode arrays while flashed images, moving bars, drifting gratings and randomly moving handwritten digits were presented. For moving digits, one shared spiking encoder fed two readouts, one reconstructing the image and one decoding the digit's position. Compute energy was estimated from counted synaptic operations. The SNN decoded what and where at once. It reconstructed the stimuli with a structural similarity (SSIM) of up to 0.93, refining the reconstruction as spikes accumulated, and tracked a randomly moving target with a mean error of 1.33 pixels on a $32\times32$ grid. Its fidelity nearly matched that of the best of 17 larger spiking and artificial decoders (5.9 million to 1.7 billion parameters, versus 5.4 million), and at a mean firing rate of 14.2% it needed an estimated $\sim$70-fold less compute energy than a dense artificial network of the same architecture. Dynamic visual scenes can thus be decoded from retinal population activity in the spike domain, with a compact network and at a compute cost compatible with implantable and wearable neural interfaces, supporting spike-native decoders for visual prostheses.

title: Revisiting the 16x Pretraining Compute Gap between Diffusion and Autoregressive Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have attracted wide attention for their fast, parallel decoding, but they are believed to be far less efficient to train than autoregressive language models (ARMs): a widely cited study reports that a DLM needs roughly 16x the training compute of an ARM to match its likelihood, a figure that has made pretraining DLMs from scratch look prohibitive at scale. We find that the methodology behind this figure has fallen out of step with current DLM practice: it scores the model with its evidence lower bound (ELBO) and trains a full-sequence, decoder-only model. We therefore revisit the scaling laws of DLMs, adopting the exact likelihood under the model's own decoding order, block diffusion training, an encoder-decoder architecture, and a sweep over the block sizes used in practice. Under this new protocol, we study across ten model variants, about 1,700 models in total, and find that pretraining DLMs is far cheaper than previously thought. Concretely, scoring with the exact likelihood reduces the compute multiple to 12.8x; block diffusion training and an encoder-decoder architecture further reduce it to 7.8x at block size 32, and smaller block sizes narrow it to 4.6x at block size 8 and 3.0x at block size 4. We complement these scaling analyses with an empirical rule for the optimal decoder depth of encoder-decoder block diffusion, a held-out compute budget beyond the fitting range at which the gap between variants persists, and downstream benchmark results where likelihood improvements carry over to accuracy. Overall, the 16x figure substantially overstates the pretraining cost gap between DLMs and ARMs, and pretraining DLMs from scratch is far more viable than previously assumed.

title: X.js: A Live Benchmark for Node.js Taint-Style Vulnerabilities
summary: JavaScript vulnerabilities in npm packages pose a significant risk to the Node$.$js ecosystem, and a growing body of work aims to detect, exploit, and mitigate them. Studying and evaluating this work requires up-to-date collections of real vulnerabilities, yet the most commonly used datasets stop recording vulnerabilities in 2022. We present X$.$js, a live benchmark of real-world Node$.$js taint-style vulnerabilities covering code and command injection, prototype pollution, and path traversal. Built from 1,738 advisories collected through mid-2026, primarily from the GitHub Advisory Database, X$.$js pairs each vulnerability with precise source and sink locations, a validated executable exploit and its execution trace, and, when available, a patched version of the package. X$.$js supports long-term reproducibility and growth: dependencies are mirrored in a self-hosted registry to guard against package removal from the ecosystem, and dedicated infrastructure generates and validates exploits for newly reported vulnerabilities. The current release contains 1,159 validated exploits for 965 packages. Using X$.$js, we characterize how the frequency, structure, and complexity of Node$.$js taint-style vulnerabilities have evolved over time. We find that these vulnerabilities are increasingly reported in large packages: the median vulnerable package grew from roughly 250 LoC in 2021--2022 to 6,100 LoC in 2026.

title: Settling the Approximability of Submodular Facility Location
summary: In submodular facility location (SFL), introduced by Svitkina and Tardos (SODA 2006), clients $\mathcal{C}$ in a metric space are assigned to facilities $\mathcal{F}$. A facility serving a set $S \subseteq \cal C$ of clients incurs cost $g(S)$, where $g$ is a monotone submodular function common to all facilities. The best known approximation factor for SFL is $O(\log\log|\mathcal{C}|)$, due to Abbasi, Adamczyk, Bosch-Calvo, Byrka, Grandoni, Sornat, and Tinguely (ICALP 2024), improving on the $O(\log|\mathcal{C}|)$-approximation of Svitkina and Tardos. We show that this is best possible up to a constant factor in the value-oracle model by showing that there exists no algorithm with only polynomially many queries to $g$ with approximation ratio $o(\log\log|\mathcal{C}|)$. This bound holds for algorithms with unlimited computation time, and when $g$ is restricted to matroid rank functions. We also show that the natural linear programming relaxation has an integrality gap of $Θ(\log\log|\mathcal{C}|)$. Our lower bound follows by constructing an extension of Vondrák's symmetry-gap approach (FOCS 2009) for matroid rank functions.

title: A Mode-Unified, Continuous, and Biomimetic Control Strategy of a Robotic Lower Limb Prosthesis
comments: This work has been submitted to a research journal for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Existing biomimetic lower-limb prosthesis controllers are commonly designed for discrete locomotion modes, requiring separate parameterizations for level walking, ramps, and stairs. We present a mode-unified prosthesis control framework that represents knee and ankle biomechanics continuously as functions of terrain slope and gait phase across those locomotion conditions. Locally optimized ascent and descent polynomial models were unified using radial basis function (RBF) interpolation, preserving the accuracy of the partitioned models while outperforming a global polynomial representation. The resulting biomechanics were transformed into continuous and slope-dependent impedance parameters and implemented within a single finite-state-machine (FSM) controller using bilateral sensing for gait-state estimation. Experiments with 10 individuals with transfemoral amputation demonstrated terrain-adaptive locomotion from level walking through ramps and stairs up to 35 degrees, including 13 degree ramp and 15 degree stair conditions absent from the underlying able-bodied (AB) dataset. Experimental results reproduced the principal slope-dependent biomechanical trends predicted by the unified model, with high agreement for knee-related measures (r-square = 0.82 - 0.99) and ankle kinematics (r-square= 0.78 - 0.96). These findings demonstrated that unified biomechanical parameterization enables a prosthesis control architecture across diverse terrain conditions while preserving key features of AB biomechanics without requiring independently tuned impedance parameter sets for each locomotion mode. To facilitate reproducibility and further development, the biomechanics modeling and impedance parameterization code is publicly available at https://github.com/kim2576.

title: A Critical Review of Grid Integration Challenges and Flexibility Opportunities for Large-Scale Data Centers
summary: The rapid proliferation of cloud computing and artificial intelligence workloads is fundamentally reshaping the magnitude, spatial concentration, and electrical characteristics of data center power demand. Data centers differ from conventional commercial loads because they combine high rack densities, converter-dominated interfaces, thermally coupled cooling, uninterruptible power supplies, programmable workloads, and increasingly complex behind-the-meter generation and storage within a single facility. This review examines their grid integration from utility and sustainable-energy perspectives across resource planning, large-load interconnection, distribution feeders, market operation, real-time dynamics, power quality, and asset management. Particular attention is given to distribution-level issues that receive limited treatment in broader energy reviews: bidirectional operation on renewable-rich feeders, harmonic propagation and resonance, ride-through and reconnection, transformer derating, cable ampacity, neutral-conductor heating, protection, and measurement. Static, composite, physics-based dynamic, calibrated, impedance, electromagnetic transient, and hybrid load models are compared according to study purpose and data requirements, and utility coordination platforms, uninterruptible power supply and battery control, workload flexibility, renewable co-location, cogeneration, fuel cells, thermal storage, and clean firm supply are assessed. The central finding is that requested peak demand and annual energy matching alone cannot establish reliable or sustainable integration. Credible assessment must consider hourly and locational supply, network deliverability, marginal emissions, lifecycle and water impacts, backup obligations, rebound, asset health, and verified operating capability.

title: JetStream: Generating Verified Query Accelerators for Existing Database Systems
summary: Recent work has shown that LLMs can synthesize highly instance-optimized database systems for fixed workloads, but to date these systems only replace the DBMS's native storage and assume static data: users must migrate their data, often give up ad-hoc queries, lose acceleration once the data changes, and lack formal correctness guarantees. We present JetStream, which instead generates query-specific accelerators that extend an existing DBMS. Given a set of parameterized query templates, a staged agentic workflow synthesizes accelerators that run directly over the DBMS's native tables and may maintain custom auxiliary state, while the host DBMS remains responsible for storage, transactions, recovery, and all the other queries. A fixed, engine-neutral substrate keeps auxiliary state transactionally consistent under writes, while generated backend adapters handle engine-specific hooks. JetStream generates two kinds of accelerators: tested accelerators, which may use any optimization and are validated by differential testing, and verified accelerators, which trade some performance for a machine-checked proof that every answer satisfies a trusted specification derived from the SQL. On TPC-H at SF=20, JetStream achieves a $584\times$ geomean read speedup over DuckDB ($89\times$ verified) and retains $139\times$ ($46\times$ verified) under a continuous update stream of 10,000 modified rows per second.

title: Feed-Forward Multi-View Feature Coding for 3D Gaussian Splatting
comments: 13 pages. Submitted to IEEE TCSVT. Revised the presentation and appendix, with additional minor changes
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods enable efficient reconstruction of 3D scenes from sparse multi-view images in a single forward pass, without scene-specific optimization. However, existing feed-forward scene-coding pipelines follow a "generate-then-compress" framework, first generating a Gaussian representation and then encoding its geometry and appearance through separate coding paths, complicating codec design and limiting the exploitation of cross-attribute redundancy. We propose multi-view feature coding for Gaussian splatting (MFGS), an end-to-end feed-forward framework for scene coding. Instead of compressing an explicit Gaussian representation, MFGS extracts multi-view features from the input images and encodes them into a compact bitstream. Through end-to-end rate-distortion training, MFGS learns a compact latent representation of multi-view features that jointly represents geometry and appearance, enabling the receiver to predict Gaussian attributes from the decoded features. We further introduce importance-guided Gaussian selection to accommodate different rendering budgets, allowing the receiver to adjust the number of Gaussians used for rendering from the same bitstream. Across RE10K, ACID, and DL3DV, MFGS achieves 99.76-99.86% bitrate savings over the generate-then-compress pipeline, as measured by BD-rate, while reducing total GMACs by 52-55% and providing an approximately 12 times end-to-end speedup.

title: Fractional Power-of-Two Quantization for Efficient and Effective Multiplier-Free LLM Inference
comments: 40 pages (10 main), 19 figures, 24 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) demand efficient inference, where the multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations in linear projections dominate compute and energy cost. Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces this cost by mapping weights and activations to low-bit integers. Power-of-Two (PoT) weight quantization promises efficient multiplier-free LLM inference via shift-add logic, but suffers significant accuracy degradation at low bit-widths due to its coarse base-2 quantization grid. We introduce Fractional PoT (FPoT), a base-$\sqrt{2}$ (half-octave) fractional PoT grid that achieves practical 4-bit weight quantization while preserving a fully integer shift-add datapath. The method combines (i) the base-$\sqrt{2}$ weight grid with uniform integer activations, (ii) a calibration-time grid-alignment refinement absorbed into the static per-channel scale, and (iii) a lightweight 1-adder $\sqrt{2}$ approximation whose error is absorbed during weight calibration via approximate-grid quantization, yielding a processing element (PE) with significantly fewer gates than a 4-bit integer multiplier. On Llama-3-8B with 4-bit weight and activation quantization, FPoT improves zero-shot commonsense reasoning performance by 8.72% relative to the PoT baseline, while maintaining performance close to the uniform integer baseline, with only a negligible 0.4%p degradation. These results hold across various configurations spanning seven models and three bit-widths. Furthermore, FPoT can be integrated with state-of-the-art LLM PTQ methods, demonstrating framework-agnostic applicability.

AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的线性投影中乘加（MAC）操作占主导地位，传统的 PoT（Power-of-Two）权重量化虽然能通过移位相加逻辑实现免乘法器的高效推理，但由于其粗糙的以2为底的量化网格，在低比特位宽下会导致严重的准确度下降。

AI.conclusion: FPoT 是一种有效且通用的方法，能够在保持免乘法器架构的同时，显著提升低比特大语言模型推理的准确性。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）需要高效的推理，其中线性投影中的乘加（MAC）操作主导了计算和能量成本。后训练量化（PTQ）通过将权重和激活映射到低比特整数来降低这种成本。幂之二（PoT）权重量化通过移位相加逻辑有望实现高效的免乘法器 LLM 推理，但由于其粗糙的以2为底的量化网格，在低比特位宽下会导致严重的准确度下降。我们引入了分数次 PoT（FPoT），这是一个以 $\sqrt{2}$ 为底（半倍频程）的分数次 PoT 网格，它实现了实用的 4-bit 权重量化，同时保持了完全整数的移位相加数据路径。该方法结合了（i）以 $\sqrt{2}$ 为底的权重网格与均匀整型激活，（ii）吸收到静态每通道缩放中的校准时网格对齐精炼，以及（iii）轻量级的 1-adder $\sqrt{2}$ 近似，其误差在权重校准期间通过近似网格量化被吸收，从而产生一个比 4-bit 整数乘法器使用显著更少门电路的处理单元（PE）。在具有 4-bit 权重和激活量化的 Llama-3-8B 上，FPoT 将零样本常识推理性能相对于 PoT 基线提升了 8.72%，同时保持了接近均匀整型基线的性能，仅有 0.4%p 的微不足道的下降。这些结果适用于跨越七个模型和三种位宽的各种配置。此外，FPoT 可以与最先进的 LLM PTQ 方法集成，展示了与框架无关的适用性。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种名为分数次PoT（FPoT）的新型量化方法，通过构建基数为 $\sqrt{2}$ 的量化网格及近似技术，在实现 4-bit 免乘法器大语言模型推理的同时，大幅减小了传统 PoT 方法的精度损失，并具有良好的框架兼容性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 后训练量化, 幂之二量化, 免乘法器推理, 移位相加逻辑

title: AdaLoop: Thinking with the Vision Encoder
summary: Most vision-language models (VLMs) treat the vision encoder as a static feature extractor: it encodes an image once, independently of the question, and leaves subsequent reasoning to the language model. Yet different questions may require different visual operations and processing depths. We present AdaLoop, a framework for question-conditioned visual recurrence in VLMs. AdaLoop adapts visual computation to the question and reuses the encoder's transformations across multiple iterations, with the pretrained vision weights frozen. We also introduce VisRO, a procedural dataset and generation pipeline for training and evaluating vision-centric reasoning. On six VisRO tasks, AdaLoop outperforms standard fine-tuning and question-conditioned single-pass baselines with matched training data and optimizer updates. These gains hold across three VLM families on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution examples. Our findings suggest that pretrained vision encoders can contribute to reasoning through task-directed, iterative visual computation.

AI.tldr: AdaLoop通过问题条件下的视觉循环，使视觉编码器参与推理，在多个VLM家族和VisRO任务上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 大多数视觉语言模型（VLMs）将视觉编码器视为静态特征提取器，对所有问题进行一次编码，而不同问题可能需要不同的视觉操作和处理深度。
AI.method: 本文提出了AdaLoop框架，用于VLMs中的问题条件视觉循环。AdaLoop使视觉计算适应问题，并在多次迭代中重用编码器的变换，同时冻结预训练的视觉权重。此外，还引入了VisRO，一个用于训练和评估以视觉为中心推理的程序数据集和生成管道。

AI.conclusion: 预训练的视觉编码器可以通过任务导向的迭代视觉计算来促进推理。

AI.summary: 本文提出了AdaLoop框架，旨在改进视觉语言模型（VLMs）中视觉编码器的作用，使其不再是静态特征提取器。AdaLoop通过引入问题条件下的视觉循环，使视觉计算能够根据具体问题进行调整，并重复利用冻结的预训练视觉编码器进行迭代处理。为了训练和评估这种视觉中心推理能力，作者还开发了VisRO数据集。实验结果表明，AdaLoop在VisRO任务上显著优于现有基线方法，并对多种VLM架构具有普适性，证明了预训练视觉编码器通过迭代计算参与推理的潜力。

AI.comments: AdaLoop的创新之处在于改变了VLM中视觉编码器的传统静态角色，使其通过迭代和问题条件循环参与到推理过程中，这为更深层次的视觉理解提供了新的方向。VisRO数据集的引入也为评估视觉中心推理提供了一个有价值的工具。这项工作强调了预训练视觉编码器在推理中的未开发潜力。

title: X-Fly: Learning to Reach and Stop in Full-Chunk Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
comments: 13 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Project page: https://juliusju572.github.io/x-fly/
summary: Aerial vision-language navigation (VLN) agents built on large vision-language models are expensive to query. Executing a complete predicted action chunk before replanning amortizes this cost, reducing model inference from 195 to 42 ms per executed waypoint for our policy. It also moves the states at which the policy is queried away from expert demonstrations, which supervise neither recovery from these states nor termination at the learner's own arrival. On OpenFly test-seen, no-stop failures account for 47.78% of full-chunk behavior cloning (BC) outcomes. We present X-Fly, a staged training framework for full-chunk aerial VLN. Recovery DAgger labels learner-visited decision states with smooth chunks that reconnect to future expert segments and with STOP at the first in-region state. Flow-GRPO then jointly refines the chunked flow controller and a Bernoulli STOP policy from same-task closed-loop outcomes, supplemented by outcome-verified stopping supervision. With eight controls per decision, X-Fly reaches 74.18% SR on test-seen and 51.73% on test-unseen, compared with 16.45% and 18.43% for full-chunk BC and 32.04% and 29.46% for DreamFly.

AI.title_translation: X-Fly：学习在全分块空中视觉语言导航中到达与停止
AI.tldr: X-Fly是一个针对空中视觉语言导航的分阶段训练框架，通过解决全分块推理带来的恢复和终止难题，大幅提升了导航成功率。
AI.motivation: 基于大视觉语言模型的空中视觉语言导航智能体查询成本高，通过执行完整的预测动作分块（full-chunk）可以摊销成本并加速推理，但这导致查询状态偏离专家示范，无法有效处理状态恢复和到达终止，从而引发严重的“无停止”失败问题。

title: Sparse Federated Echo State Networks for Time-Series Classification via Smooth-L1 Regularization
comments: 30 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Extended version of a paper presented at IDEAL 2025. Code: https://github.com/oroboro235/FedESN-SmoothL1. The abstract and the corresponding results and discussion sentences now state that the accuracy margins are differences of ten-seed means, not bounds that hold for other seeds
summary: Echo State Networks (ESNs), as lightweight implementations of reservoir computing, provide efficient solutions for temporal data processing in resource-constrained environments. While standard ESNs offer computational efficiency, their dense readout layers inflate the stored model and the per-sample inference cost. This paper introduces a Smooth-L1 regularized ESN (SL1ESN) that promotes sparsity in the readout layer while preserving differentiability for gradient-based optimization. The method employs a twice-differentiable Smooth-L1 approximation compatible with Newton's method, which we exploit both for centralized training and for a second-order (Newton-step) federated aggregation scheme. Under a single fixed shrinkage threshold shared by every dataset and both settings, experiments on seven time-series classification benchmarks show that SL1ESN learns readouts that are 77-95% sparse in the centralized setting and 75-95% sparse in the federated one. On five of the seven benchmarks, the mean accuracy of the sparse readout over ten seeds differs from that of the stronger dense baseline by at most 0.7 points in the centralized setting and 1.6 points in the federated one, differences of the same order as the seed-to-seed variation, while on the remaining two it trails by 2.4-5.8 points. The second-order federated update converges in only a few rounds. The resulting sparsity compresses the stored model, the per-sample inference cost, and the server-to-client broadcast by a comparable factor. These results demonstrate the practical value of sparse readouts for edge computing and IoT deployments.

AI.title_translation: 基于Smooth-L1正则化的稀疏联邦回声状态网络用于时间序列分类
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种Smooth-L1正则化的回声状态网络（SL1ESN），通过促进读出层的稀疏性来降低模型大小和推理成本，同时在集中式和联邦学习设置中保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 标准回声状态网络（ESNs）虽然计算效率高，但其密集的读出层增加了模型存储和每样本推理成本，这在资源受限的环境中是一个问题。
AI.method: 本文引入了一种Smooth-L1正则化的回声状态网络（SL1ESN），它在保持可微性的同时促进读出层的稀疏性。该方法采用与牛顿法兼容的二次可微Smooth-L1近似，并将其应用于集中式训练和二阶（牛顿步）联邦聚合方案。
AI.result: 实验表明，在集中式设置中，SL1ESN的读出层稀疏度达到77-95%；在联邦设置中，稀疏度达到75-95%。在七个基准中的五个上，稀疏读出的平均准确性与密集基线相比，集中式设置中差异不超过0.7点，联邦设置中不超过1.6点。二阶联邦更新在几轮内收敛。由此产生的稀疏性将模型存储、每样本推理成本和服务器到客户端的广播压缩了可比的因子。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏读出层对于边缘计算和物联网部署具有实际价值，SL1ESN在保持性能的同时显著降低了模型复杂度和计算开销。
AI.translation: 回声状态网络（ESNs）作为储层计算的轻量级实现，为资源受限环境中的时间数据处理提供了高效解决方案。虽然标准ESNs提供了计算效率，但其密集的读出层增加了模型存储和每样本推理成本。本文引入了一种Smooth-L1正则化的ESN（SL1ESN），它在促进读出层稀疏性的同时保留了可微性以进行基于梯度的优化。该方法采用与牛顿法兼容的二次可微Smooth-L1近似，我们将其用于集中式训练和二阶（牛顿步）联邦聚合方案。在每个数据集和两种设置共享的单个固定收缩阈值下，在七个时间序列分类基准上的实验表明，SL1ESN在集中式设置中学习到的读出层稀疏度为77-95%，在联邦设置中为75-95%。在七个基准中的五个上，稀疏读出在十次随机种子运行下的平均准确性与更强的密集基线相比，在集中式设置中最多相差0.7点，在联邦设置中最多相差1.6点，这些差异与种子间的变异性处于同一数量级，而在其余两个基准上则落后2.4-5.8点。二阶联邦更新仅在几轮内收敛。由此产生的稀疏性将模型存储、每样本推理成本以及服务器到客户端的广播压缩了可比的因子。这些结果证明了稀疏读出层对于边缘计算和物联网部署的实际价值。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为Smooth-L1正则化回声状态网络（SL1ESN）的新方法，旨在解决标准ESNs密集读出层导致的模型膨胀和高推理成本问题。SL1ESN通过引入二次可微的Smooth-L1正则化来促进读出层的稀疏性，并支持基于梯度的优化以及二阶联邦聚合。实验结果表明，该方法能在集中式和联邦学习环境中实现高稀疏度（75-95%），同时在大多数时间序列分类任务上保持与密集模型相当的准确性，显著降低了模型存储、推理成本和通信开销，证明了其在边缘和物联网部署中的应用潜力。
AI.keywords: 稀疏性, 联邦学习, 回声状态网络, Smooth-L1正则化, 时间序列分类
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将Smooth-L1正则化引入到回声状态网络中，并将其扩展到联邦学习环境，有效地解决了资源受限设备上的模型部署问题。通过促进稀疏性，SL1ESN显著减少了模型大小和计算成本，这对于边缘计算和物联网设备至关重要。其采用的二阶联邦聚合方案也展示了快速收敛的优势。

title: From Adults to Children: Benchmarking Foundation Models for Chest X-Ray Classification under Domain Shift
summary: Foundation models have shown significant potential across diverse fields and have been applied to medical imaging, but their robustness across patient populations remains unclear. In this work, we investigate foundation models' ability to generalize from adult to pediatric chest X-ray classification. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first benchmark to compare multiple foundation models under a common adult-to-pediatric evaluation setting while also analyzing the effect of adaptation depth. We harmonize VinDr-CXR and PediCXR into a five-label classification task and evaluate six foundation models and two CNN baselines. All models are adapted using adult data only and tested in both the in-domain and pediatric domains using linear probing, partial fine-tuning, and full fine-tuning. The benchmark reveals a clear and consistent trend: all models suffer a substantial performance degradation when transferred from adult to pediatric data, with drops exceeding 10 percentage points. While Macro-AUROC values reach approximately 92% on the adult test set, performance decreases to around 78% on the pediatric domain. Another important finding is that increasing the depth of adaptation improves pediatric performance on average, although the effect varies across models. Moreover, strong in-domain performance does not necessarily indicate greater robustness to domain shift.

AI.title_translation: 从成人到儿童：在域偏移下基准测试胸部X射线分类的基础模型
AI.tldr: 针对胸部X射线分类，基础模型在从成人数据泛化到儿科数据时表现出显著的性能下降（Macro-AUROC下降超过10个百分点），尽管增加适应深度能在一定程度上提高儿科性能。
AI.motivation: 基础模型在医学影像领域展现出潜力，但其在不同患者群体（如成人到儿童）间的泛化能力和鲁棒性尚不明确，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 本研究将VinDr-CXR和PediCXR数据集统一为五分类任务，并评估了六种基础模型和两种CNN基线模型。所有模型均仅使用成人数据进行适应性训练，并采用线性探测、部分微调和完全微调等策略，在域内（成人）和儿科域进行测试。
AI.result: 基准测试显示，所有模型在从成人数据转移到儿科数据时，性能均出现大幅下降，降幅超过10个百分点。成人测试集上的Macro-AUROC值约为92%，而在儿科域下降到约78%。增加适应深度平均而言能提高儿科性能，但效果因模型而异。此外，强大的域内性能不一定预示着对域偏移有更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型在从成人胸部X射线分类任务泛化到儿科任务时面临严重的域偏移挑战，导致性能大幅下降。增加适应深度可以缓解部分性能下降，但仍需进一步研究以提高其跨患者群体的鲁棒性。域内表现优异的模型，其域外泛化能力不一定更强。
AI.translation: 基础模型在不同领域展现出巨大潜力，并已应用于医学影像，但其在不同患者群体间的鲁棒性仍不明确。在这项工作中，我们研究了基础模型从成人胸部X射线分类泛化到儿科胸部X射线分类的能力。据我们所知，这是首次在共同的成人到儿科评估设置下比较多个基础模型的基准测试，同时分析了适应深度的影响。我们将VinDr-CXR和PediCXR数据集统一为五分类任务，并评估了六种基础模型和两种CNN基线模型。所有模型均仅使用成人数据进行适应性训练，并使用线性探测、部分微调和完全微调在域内和儿科域进行测试。基准测试揭示了一个清晰且一致的趋势：所有模型在从成人数据转移到儿科数据时，性能均出现大幅下降，降幅超过10个百分点。虽然成人测试集上的Macro-AUROC值达到约92%，但儿科域的性能下降到约78%。另一个重要发现是，平均而言，增加适应深度可以提高儿科性能，尽管效果因模型而异。此外，强大的域内性能不一定预示着对域偏移有更强的鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本研究首次在成人到儿科胸部X射线分类的域偏移背景下，对多个基础模型的泛化能力进行了基准测试。研究发现，所有测试的基础模型在从成人数据转移到儿科数据时，性能均出现显著下降（Macro-AUROC降幅超过10个百分点），从成人域的约92%降至儿科域的约78%。增加适应深度能平均提高儿科性能，但效果因模型而异。研究强调，模型在域内的强大性能并不保证其对域偏移的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 基础模型, 胸部X射线分类, 域偏移, 成人到儿童, 泛化能力
AI.comments: 这项工作的重要创新在于首次系统地在成人到儿科胸部X射线分类这一关键医学影像域偏移场景下，对基础模型的泛化能力进行了基准测试。其揭示的性能大幅下降以及域内强性能不代表域外鲁棒性的发现，对未来医学AI模型的开发和部署具有重要指导意义，强调了在真实世界应用中，模型跨患者群体的鲁棒性评估至关重要。

title: FutureLift: Lifting Trajectory Proposals into Bidirectional Future Graphs for Motion Forecasting
summary: Accurate motion prediction is critical for safe autonomous driving, yet even strong forecasters leave residual errors in their multimodal proposals. Existing refiners compress complete proposals or update their segments sequentially, preventing the full proposed future from serving as explicit relational context for correction. We introduce FutureLift, a backbone-agnostic refiner that represents each multimodal proposal as a heterogeneous future graph, with spatially grounded temporal nodes connected to agent histories, map elements, alternative modes, and, for joint prediction, other agents future trajectories. Bidirectional temporal edges allow later evidence to revise earlier segments in a single pass, and the updated nodes predict residual coordinate and confidence corrections. Requiring only proposals, scores, and scene context, FutureLift provides a common refinement interface for structurally different forecasting backbones. On Argoverse2 and the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, it consistently improves frozen proposals and outperforms native and specialized refiners across marginal and joint forecasting. On the WOMD motion-prediction leaderboard, FutureLift ranks first in minADE (0.5049m) and minFDE (0.9942m) among the compared standard-input methods, without LiDAR or ensembling, while achieving a competitive 0.4874 Soft mAP.

AI.title_translation: FutureLift：将轨迹提案提升为双向未来图以用于运动预测
AI.tldr: FutureLift 将轨迹提案转化为双向未来图进行联合优化，无需 LiDAR 或集成即可在主流自动驾驶运动预测数据集上取得第一的精度。
AI.motivation: 准确的运动预测对自动驾驶至关重要，但现有的预测器在多模态提案中仍存在残差误差。现有的修正方法通常压缩完整提案或按顺序更新片段，无法让整个提议的未来作为显式关系上下文来进行修正。
AI.method: 引入了 FutureLift，一个与骨干网络无关的修正器。它将每个多模态轨迹提案表示为异构未来图，包含空间落地的时序节点，连接至历史轨迹、地图元素、其他模态及其他智能体的未来轨迹。利用双向时间边实现单次遍历中后期证据对早期片段的修正，并预测残差坐标和置信度修正量。
AI.result: 在 Argoverse2 和 Waymo Open Motion Dataset (WOMD) 上，FutureLift 稳定地改善了冻结的提案，并在边缘和联合预测中超越了原生和专门的修正器。在 WOMD 运动预测排行榜上，在对比的标准输入方法中，minADE (0.5049m) 和 minFDE (0.9942m) 排名第一，同时实现了 0.4874 的 Soft mAP。
AI.conclusion: FutureLift 作为一个通用的、与骨干网络无关的轨迹修正器，能够有效提升现有各种运动预测模型的性能，在多个权威数据集上达到了 SOTA 水平。
AI.translation: 准确的运动预测对于安全的自动驾驶至关重要，然而即使是强大的预测器在其多模态提案中也留下残差误差。现有的修正器压缩了完整的提案或按顺序更新其片段，阻止了完整的提议未来作为显式关系上下文来进行修正。我们介绍了 FutureLift，这是一个与骨干网络无关的修正器，它将每个多模态提案表示为一个异构未来图，其中包含空间落地的时序节点，这些节点连接到智能体历史、地图元素、替代模态，以及对于联合预测而言的其他智能体未来轨迹。双向时间边允许后续的证据在单次遍历中修正先前的片段，并且更新后的节点预测残差坐标和置信度修正。FutureLift 仅需提案、得分和场景上下文，为结构不同的预测骨干网络提供了一个通用的修正接口。在 Argoverse2 和 Waymo 开放运动数据集上，它持续改进了冻结的提案，并在边缘和联合预测中优于原生和专门的修正器。在 WOMD 运动预测排行榜上，在对比的标准输入方法中，FutureLift 在 minADE (0.5049m) 和 minFDE (0.9942m) 中排名第一（无需 LiDAR 或模型集成），同时实现了具有竞争力的 0.4874 Soft mAP。
AI.summary: FutureLift 是一种通用的运动预测修正框架，它将多模态轨迹提案提升为双向未来图，通过利用场景上下文和智能体间的交互来预测残差并修正轨迹，从而在多个自动驾驶数据集上实现了卓越的预测精度。
AI.keywords: 运动预测, 轨迹修正, 异构图, 自动驾驶, 多模态预测
AI.comments: FutureLift 提出了一种基于异构未来图（Heterogeneous Future Graph）的运动预测修正方法，通过双向时间边和多模态交互实现了端到端的轨迹优化，无需依赖 LiDAR 或模型集成，在 WOMD 和 Argoverse2 数据集上取得了领先性能。其创新之处在于将轨迹提升为图结构并支持双向信息流，具有很好的通用性。

title: Where Prefill Expert Reduction Hurts MoE Models: A Few Prompt Tokens Carry Most of the Short-Answer F1 Loss
comments: 8 pages main text, 26 pages with appendices; supplementary material in ancillary files
summary: Running prompt tokens through fewer routed experts during prefill makes mixture-of-experts (MoE) serving cheaper, but what it damages has not been measured. We locate the damage with token-, layer- and attention-path interventions in four MoE families on short-answer question answering. At half the experts the F1 loss is mostly answer form: the model still finds the answer but no longer answers briefly. The loss is made at a few tokens: the two chat-template tokens before the answer in Qwen3-30B-A3B, and the first 8-32 tokens, where the instruction sits, in DeepSeek-V2-Lite. Keeping them at full experts removes most of the F1 loss and about half and a fifth of the increase in answer NLL. Reduction changes the first-token sink statistics by less than 4%, and restoring super experts or massive activations recovers at most a quarter of the loss. We then test placement on real prompts with about 4% of tokens at full experts. Putting them on the task interface keeps F1 within one point of the unmodified model, while the same budget scattered in the documents is about 3 points worse in both prespecified primary tests of this comparison. Time to first token falls about 14% on 11K-token prompts.
comment: 8 pages main text, 26 pages with appendices; supplementary material in ancillary files

AI.title_translation: 预填充专家缩减对MoE模型的损害：少量提示词元承载了大部分短答案F1损失
AI.tldr: 在MoE模型预填充期间减少专家数量以降低成本主要损害短答案F1得分，原因在于答案不再简洁，且大部分损失集中在少数特定提示词元上。将这些关键词元保持在完整专家数量下可以显著减轻F1损失并提高效率。
AI.motivation: 在预填充期间，通过更少的路由专家运行提示词元可以降低混合专家（MoE）服务的成本，但其损害尚未被衡量。本研究旨在定位并量化这种损害。
AI.method: 研究通过在短答案问答任务中对四种MoE家族进行词元、层和注意力路径干预来定位损害。此外，还在真实提示词上测试了不同专家放置策略。
AI.result: 1. 专家数量减半时，F1损失主要体现在答案形式上（模型能找到答案但回答不简洁）。2. 损失集中在少数词元上，例如Qwen3-30B-A3B中答案前的两个聊天模板词元，以及DeepSeek-V2-Lite中指令所在的最初8-32个词元。3. 将这些关键词元保持在完整专家数量下，可消除大部分F1损失，并减少约一半到五分之一的答案NLL增加。4. 专家缩减对第一个词元汇聚统计量的改变小于4%。5. 恢复超级专家或大规模激活最多只能恢复四分之一的损失。6. 将约4%的词元（任务接口）保持在完整专家数量下，F1得分与未修改模型保持在一个点以内；而将相同预算分散在文档中则差约3个点。7. 在11K词元提示词上，首个词元生成时间下降了约14%。
AI.conclusion: MoE模型预填充专家缩减造成的损害集中在少数关键提示词元上。通过策略性地将这些关键词元（如任务接口）分配给完整数量的专家，可以有效减轻F1损失，同时仍能实现效率提升（如降低首个词元生成时间）。
AI.translation: 在预填充期间，通过更少的路由专家运行提示词元可以降低混合专家（MoE）服务的成本，但其损害尚未被衡量。我们通过在短答案问答任务中对四种MoE家族进行词元、层和注意力路径干预，来定位这种损害。在专家数量减半的情况下，F1损失主要体现在答案形式上：模型仍然能找到答案，但不再能简洁地回答。损失发生在少数词元上：在Qwen3-30B-A3B中，是答案前的两个聊天模板词元；在DeepSeek-V2-Lite中，是指令所在的最初8-32个词元。让这些关键词元保持在完整专家数量下，可以消除大部分F1损失，并减少大约一半到五分之一的答案NLL增加。缩减对第一个词元汇聚统计量的改变小于4%，并且恢复超级专家或大规模激活最多只能恢复四分之一的损失。然后，我们用大约4%的词元在完整专家数量下测试了真实提示词的放置。将它们放在任务接口上，F1得分与未修改模型保持在一个点以内，而将相同预算分散在文档中则在两次预设的主要测试中都差了大约3个点。在11K词元提示词上，首个词元生成时间下降了大约14%。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在混合专家（MoE）模型预填充阶段减少专家使用对性能的影响，该技术旨在降低服务成本。研究发现，主要的损害，尤其是在短答案F1得分方面，源于模型无法提供简洁的答案，而非未能找到答案。关键的是，F1损失集中在少数特定的提示词元上，例如聊天模板词元或指令词元。通过策略性地将这些关键词元保持在完整专家容量下，可以恢复大部分F1损失，同时仍能实现效率提升（例如缩短首个词元生成时间），这表明了一种在不显著降低性能的情况下优化MoE服务的有效方法。
AI.keywords: MoE模型, 专家缩减, 预填充, F1损失, 提示词元
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过精确指出在预填充过程中减少专家数量导致性能下降的关键词元，为优化MoE模型服务提供了宝贵的见解。发现仅需对少量词元（例如任务接口）分配完整专家数量即可显著恢复F1性能，这一创新点为成本效益部署提供了实用的策略。它突出了对MoE模型如何处理信息以及计算资源何处最有效的细致理解。

title: HexaShell: A Universal Harness for Robot Coding Agents in Simulation and the Real World
summary: Agents built on vision language models (VLMs) now control robots by writing code, but the strongest of them refine task-specific code over many rounds of trial and revision. Such code tends to overfit the benchmark on which it was tuned, can exploit the benchmark's shortcuts, and is costly to carry over to a new benchmark or robot. We present HexaShell, a thin, task-agnostic harness designed to test how far general tools can go instead. We design a simple and complete set of 14 basic tools, 4 for motion, 5 for perception and 5 for state, which the agent calls in one Python cell per turn. Perception pairs SAM 3, which segments an object from a few words or a click, with NumPy and OpenCV geometry that turns its outlines in several cameras, or a depth image, into its position, size and grasp angle. The API, agent loop and sandbox are shared across all tasks; a new simulator or robot needs only an adapter of 350 to 1,450 lines and a prompt describing its world, and the only task-specific input is an optional skill of about a page of guidance. The same code runs on four simulated benchmarks, built on three simulators with two kinds of arm, and on real robots. With GPT-6-Astra and no task-specific input, HexaShell reaches success rates of 69.9% on RoboDojo, 59.3% on RoboCasa365, 78.3% on LIBERO-PRO and 82.2% on RoboTwin 2.0. With task skills, it reaches 85.0% (score 88.8), 85.6%, 96.7% and 96.8%, respectively, above the best published result we are aware of on each benchmark. The RoboCasa365 result is listed first on its leaderboard. On real dual-arm robots, HexaShell succeeds in 76 of 90 episodes across nine tasks.

AI.title_translation: HexaShell：一种用于模拟和现实世界中机器人编程代理的通用线束
AI.tldr: HexaShell 是一个通用的、任务无关的线束，旨在测试通用工具在机器人代码代理中的潜力。它通过一套精简的工具集和跨任务共享的API，在模拟和真实机器人上实现了SOTA性能，解决了现有VLM代理过拟合和迁移成本高的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的机器人代理通过编写代码来控制机器人，但它们通常需要多轮试错来优化特定任务的代码，这导致代码容易过拟合基准、利用捷径，并且难以迁移到新的基准或机器人上。本研究旨在探索通用工具在机器人控制中的潜力，而非依赖任务特定的微调。
AI.method: HexaShell 提出一个轻量级、任务无关的线束，包含14个基本工具（4个用于运动，5个用于感知，5个用于状态），代理在每个回合通过一个Python单元格调用这些工具。感知工具结合了SAM 3（用于从文本或点击分割物体）与NumPy和OpenCV几何学（将多摄像头轮廓或深度图像转换为位置、大小和抓取角度）。API、代理循环和沙盒在所有任务中共享。新的模拟器或机器人只需350至1,450行的适配器和一个描述其世界的提示，任务特定的输入仅是一个可选的、约一页的指导性技能。相同的代码可运行在四种模拟基准和真实机器人上。
AI.result: 在没有任务特定输入的情况下，HexaShell 在RoboDojo上达到69.9%的成功率，RoboCasa365上59.3%，LIBERO-PRO上78.3%，RoboTwin 2.0上82.2%。加入任务技能后，成功率分别提升至85.0%（得分88.8）、85.6%、96.7%和96.8%，超过了已知所有这些基准上已发表的最佳结果。RoboCasa365的结果位列其排行榜首位。在真实双臂机器人上，HexaShell 在9个任务的90个回合中成功了76次。
AI.conclusion: HexaShell 通过提供一个通用的、任务无关的线束和精简的工具集，显著提升了机器人编程代理在模拟和真实世界中的性能，并在多个基准测试中超越了现有最佳结果，证明了通用工具在机器人控制中的巨大潜力，有效解决了现有VLM代理过拟合和迁移成本高的问题。
AI.translation: 基于视觉语言模型（VLM）构建的代理现在通过编写代码来控制机器人，但其中最强大的代理需要经过多轮试错和修改才能完善特定任务的代码。此类代码往往会过度拟合其调优所用的基准，可能会利用基准的捷径，并且将其迁移到新的基准或机器人上成本很高。我们提出了HexaShell，一个轻量级、任务无关的线束，旨在测试通用工具能走多远。我们设计了一套简单而完整的14个基本工具，其中4个用于运动，5个用于感知，5个用于状态，代理在每个回合中通过一个Python单元格调用这些工具。感知功能将SAM 3（从几个单词或一次点击中分割出物体）与NumPy和OpenCV几何学相结合，将多摄像头中的轮廓或深度图像转换为物体的位置、大小和抓取角度。API、代理循环和沙盒在所有任务中共享；新的模拟器或机器人只需要一个350到1,450行的适配器以及一个描述其世界的提示，唯一的任务特定输入是一个可选的、大约一页的指导性技能。相同的代码在四个模拟基准上运行，这些基准基于三种模拟器和两种机械臂，并可在真实机器人上运行。在没有任务特定输入的情况下，使用GPT-6-Astra，HexaShell 在RoboDojo上达到了69.9%的成功率，在RoboCasa365上达到59.3%，在LIBERO-PRO上达到78.3%，在RoboTwin 2.0上达到82.2%。加入任务技能后，它分别达到了85.0%（得分88.8）、85.6%、96.7%和96.8%，高于我们所知的每个基准上已发表的最佳结果。RoboCasa365的结果位列其排行榜首位。在真实的双臂机器人上，HexaShell 在九个任务的90个回合中成功了76次。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了HexaShell，一个轻量级、任务无关的线束，旨在测试通用工具在机器人编程代理中的潜力。它通过一套包含运动、感知和状态的14个基本工具，结合SAM 3和几何学进行感知，并通过共享API、代理循环和沙盒实现跨任务和跨机器人（模拟和真实）的通用性。HexaShell在不依赖任务特定微调的情况下，在多个模拟基准和真实机器人上取得了显著的成功率，甚至在加入少量任务技能后超越了所有已知基准的最佳表现，证明了其在解决现有VLM代理过拟合和迁移成本高问题上的有效性。
AI.keywords: 机器人编程代理, 视觉语言模型, 通用线束, 模拟, 真实世界
AI.comments: HexaShell的创新之处在于其“薄而任务无关”的设计理念，它通过极简的通用工具集和统一的API，极大地提高了机器人编程代理的泛化能力和迁移效率。这种方法与传统VLM代理依赖大量任务特定微调形成鲜明对比，有效解决了过拟合和高迁移成本的问题。其在多个模拟和真实世界基准上超越SOTA的性能，凸显了其重要性，为未来机器人智能体的发展提供了新的范式。

title: FrameScout: Scouting Query-Relevant Frames for Long Video Understanding
summary: Long video understanding requires VideoLLMs to answer queries about videos spanning tens of minutes to hours, but such long videos produce far more visual tokens than current VideoLLMs can process. To address this issue, keyframe selectors are proposed to select the most query-relevant frames by computing the similarity between frame and query embeddings. Existing selectors either encode frames independently without temporal context or process chunks in isolation with ranking objectives that are difficult to optimize. To alleviate those limitations, we propose FrameScout with two core designs: (i) a streaming selector architecture that leverages a sliding-window KV cache and successor aggregation to produce temporally-contextualized frame embeddings; (ii) a frame-query contrastive objective that aligns frame and query embeddings in a shared space, directly training the selector to distinguish relevant frames from irrelevant ones. Extensive experiments on three long-video benchmarks and six base VideoLLMs demonstrate that FrameScout consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. Code is available at https://github.com/Hubert-1102/FrameScout.

AI.title_translation: FrameScout：为长视频理解筛选查询相关帧
AI.tldr: FrameScout 提出了一种流式选择器架构和帧-查询对比目标，用于高效地从长视频中选择与查询相关的帧，以解决现有 VideoLLMs 处理长视频的视觉token过多的问题，并在多个基准测试中取得了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解要求 VideoLLMs 处理时长达数十分钟甚至数小时的视频，但这些长视频产生的视觉token远超当前 VideoLLMs 的处理能力。现有的关键帧选择器在处理时存在局限性，例如独立编码帧缺乏时间上下文，或孤立处理视频块导致优化困难。
AI.method: FrameScout 包含两个核心设计：(i) 一个流式选择器架构，利用滑动窗口 KV 缓存和后续聚合来生成具有时间上下文的帧嵌入；(ii) 一个帧-查询对比目标，将帧和查询嵌入对齐到共享空间，直接训练选择器区分相关帧和不相关帧。
AI.result: 在三个长视频基准和六个基础 VideoLLMs 上的大量实验表明，FrameScout 始终达到最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: FrameScout 通过其创新的流式选择器架构和帧-查询对比目标，有效解决了长视频理解中视觉token过多的挑战，并显著提升了关键帧选择的性能。
AI.translation: 长视频理解要求 VideoLLMs 回答关于持续数十分钟到数小时的视频的查询，但这些长视频产生的视觉token远超当前 VideoLLMs 的处理能力。为了解决这个问题，提出了关键帧选择器，通过计算帧和查询嵌入之间的相似性来选择最与查询相关的帧。现有的选择器要么独立编码帧而没有时间上下文，要么孤立地处理视频块，其排名目标难以优化。为了缓解这些限制，我们提出了 FrameScout，它具有两个核心设计：(i) 一个流式选择器架构，它利用滑动窗口 KV 缓存和后续聚合来生成具有时间上下文的帧嵌入；(ii) 一个帧-查询对比目标，它在共享空间中对齐帧和查询嵌入，直接训练选择器区分相关帧和不相关帧。在三个长视频基准和六个基础 VideoLLMs 上的大量实验表明，FrameScout 始终达到最先进的性能。代码可在 https://github.com/Hubert-1102/FrameScout 获取。
AI.summary: FrameScout 提出了一种新的关键帧选择器，旨在解决长视频理解中 VideoLLMs 无法处理过多视觉token的问题。它通过流式选择器架构提供时间上下文，并使用帧-查询对比目标直接训练选择器识别相关帧。实验证明，FrameScout 在多个长视频基准上优于现有方法，实现了最先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 长视频理解, 关键帧选择, 流式选择器, 对比学习, VideoLLMs
AI.comments: FrameScout 的创新点在于其流式选择器架构和帧-查询对比目标，有效解决了长视频理解中关键帧选择的效率和准确性问题。通过引入时间上下文和直接的对比学习，它克服了现有方法的局限性，对于处理大规模视频数据具有重要意义。

title: Stochastic Gradient Leimkuhler-Matthews Integrator with Second Order Discretization Error
summary: Stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics (SGLD) has a discretization error of first order in the step size $h$, even with the full gradient. We study the stochastic gradient Leimkuhler--Matthews (SGLM) integrator, which has the same cost as SGLD, one stochastic gradient per step, and reuses each Gaussian vector in consecutive steps. With the full gradient, SGLM is the Leimkuhler--Matthews (LM) integrator, whose discretization error for the invariant distribution is of second order. For a potential strongly convex outside a ball, we prove the bound $\mathcal O(\frac{1}{Nh} + Σ^2 h^2 + h^4)$ on the mean square error (MSE) of time averages of SGLM over $N$ steps, where $Σ$ bounds the variance of the gradient noise. The proof uses a modified class that absorbs the non-Markovian part of SGLM. The discretization error enters this bound as $h^4$ and the MSE bound of SGLD as $h^2$, while a larger batch reduces only the term $Σ^2 h^2$ in both bounds. In Bayesian logistic regression on MNIST, SGLM has a smaller estimated MSE than SGLD. The coefficient of $h$ in the numerical bias of SGLM is given explicitly by the covariance of the gradient noise and the continuous Poisson equation. The coefficient for SGLD contains in addition the Hessian of the potential, which comes from the discretization error. Through Riesz representors, the coefficients of the numerical bias determine the coefficients of the Wasserstein-1 errors of SGLM and SGLD.

AI.title_translation: 具有二阶离散化误差的随机梯度Leimkuhler-Matthews积分器
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的随机梯度Leimkuhler-Matthews (SGLM) 积分器，与SGLD成本相同，但具有更高的二阶离散化精度，并在理论和实验上表现出更低的均方误差。
AI.motivation: 现有的随机梯度Langevin动力学 (SGLD) 积分器即使使用完整梯度，其离散化误差也仅为步长$h$的一阶，限制了其精度。
AI.method: 提出了一种随机梯度Leimkuhler-Matthews (SGLM) 积分器。该方法与SGLD具有相同的计算成本，每步使用一个随机梯度，并在连续步骤中重用每个高斯向量。在完整梯度情况下，SGLM是Leimkuhler-Matthews (LM) 积分器，其不变分布的离散化误差为二阶。证明使用了一种修改后的类来吸收SGLM的非马尔可夫部分。
AI.result:
1. 对于在球体外强凸的势函数，SGLM在$N$步时间平均的均方误差(MSE) 上界为$\mathcal O(\frac{1}{Nh} + \Sigma^2 h^2 + h^4)$。
2. SGLM的离散化误差以$h^4$形式进入此界限，而SGLD的MSE界限为$h^2$，表明SGLM具有更高的精度。
3. 在MNIST上的贝叶斯逻辑回归中，SGLM的估计MSE小于SGLD。
4. SGLM的数值偏差中$h$的系数由梯度噪声的协方差和连续泊松方程明确给出，而SGLD的系数额外包含势函数的Hessian。
5. 通过Riesz表示，数值偏差的系数决定了SGLM和SGLD的Wasserstein-1误差的系数。
AI.conclusion: SGLM积分器在计算成本与SGLD相同的情况下，通过引入二阶离散化误差，显著提高了随机梯度动力学的精度，并在理论和实践中展现出优越的性能。
AI.translation: 随机梯度Langevin动力学（SGLD）即使使用完整梯度，其离散化误差也仅为步长$h$的一阶。我们研究了随机梯度Leimkuhler-Matthews（SGLM）积分器，它与SGLD具有相同的成本，每步一个随机梯度，并在连续步骤中重用每个高斯向量。在完整梯度情况下，SGLM是Leimkuhler-Matthews（LM）积分器，其不变分布的离散化误差为二阶。对于在球体外强凸的势函数，我们证明了SGLM在$N$步时间平均的均方误差（MSE）的上界为$\mathcal O(\frac{1}{Nh} + \Sigma^2 h^2 + h^4)$，其中$\Sigma$限制了梯度噪声的方差。该证明使用了一个修改后的类，该类吸收了SGLM的非马尔可夫部分。离散化误差以$h^4$的形式进入此界限，而SGLD的MSE界限为$h^2$，同时，更大的批次只减少了两个界限中的$\Sigma^2 h^2$项。在MNIST上的贝叶斯逻辑回归中，SGLM的估计MSE小于SGLD。SGLM数值偏差中$h$的系数由梯度噪声的协方差和连续泊松方程明确给出。SGLD的系数额外包含势函数的Hessian，这来源于离散化误差。通过Riesz表示，数值偏差的系数决定了SGLM和SGLD的Wasserstein-1误差的系数。
AI.summary: 这篇论文引入了一种名为随机梯度Leimkuhler-Matthews (SGLM) 的新型积分器，旨在解决传统随机梯度Langevin动力学 (SGLD) 仅具有一阶离散化误差的问题。SGLM与SGLD具有相同的计算效率，但能实现二阶离散化误差。研究证明了SGLM在时间平均上的均方误差上界为$\mathcal O(\frac{1}{Nh} + \Sigma^2 h^2 + h^4)$，其中离散化误差项为$h^4$，显著优于SGLD的$h^2$。实验结果表明SGLM在贝叶斯逻辑回归任务中表现出更低的均方误差。论文还详细分析了两种方法的数值偏差系数及其与Wasserstein-1误差的关系。
AI.keywords: 随机梯度Langevin动力学, Leimkuhler-Matthews积分器, 离散化误差, 均方误差, 贝叶斯抽样
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入SGLM积分器，有效地将随机梯度动力学的离散化误差从一阶提升到二阶，这对于需要高精度采样的应用具有重要意义。其创新之处在于在保持计算成本与SGLD相同的同时，利用Leimkuhler-Matthews积分器的特性来提高精度。理论分析严谨，给出了明确的MSE上界，并从数值偏差的角度进行了深入比较。实际应用效果也得到了验证。

title: A Bulow-Klemperer Theorem for Bundling and Improved Approximation Bounds for Simple Auctions
summary:
We study simple auctions for one additive bidder whose values for $m$ items are independent. Write $\mathrm{REV}$ for the optimal revenue, $\mathrm{SREV}$ and $\mathrm{BREV}$ for the optimal revenues from separate selling and grand bundling, and $\mathrm{BSPA}_2$ for the grand-bundle second-price revenue with two independent bidders.
  For independent regular items, we prove $\mathrm{REV} \le \mathrm{BSPA}_2 \le 2\,\mathrm{BREV}$. Thus, one additional bidder lets a reserve-free second-price auction for the grand bundle match the optimal revenue from one bidder, regardless of the number of items. This gives a Bulow-Klemperer theorem for bundling and resolves an open question of Beyhaghi, Cai, Feng, Li, and Weinberg (EC 2025) on whether constant competition suffices for bundling. The factor-$2$ bundling approximation is also tight.
  For general independent items, we prove $\mathrm{REV} \le \mathrm{SREV} + \frac{π^2}{6}\mathrm{BREV} \le 2.645 \max\{\mathrm{SREV}, \mathrm{BREV}\}$. This improves the previous approximation factors of $6$ from Babaioff, Immorlica, Lucier, and Weinberg (FOCS 2014, JACM 2020) and $5.2$ from Ma and Simchi-Levi (AISTATS 2021). For the lower bound, we construct an instance in which pricing three disjoint bundles earns more than $2.11\max\{\mathrm{SREV},\mathrm{BREV}\}$, improving the previous lower bound of $2$ from Rubinstein (ITCS 2016). Together, these results narrow the tight approximation ratio to the range $[2.11, 2.645]$.

AI.title_translation: 捆绑销售的Bulow-Klemperer定理和简单拍卖的改进近似界限
AI.tldr: 本文研究了对一个加性竞标者的简单拍卖，证明了对于独立常规商品，一个额外的竞标者通过捆绑销售的第二价格拍卖可以达到最优收益，并给出了捆绑销售的Bulow-Klemperer定理。对于一般独立商品，本文改进了最优收益的近似因子，并缩小了紧密近似比的范围。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在研究在简单拍卖中，如何通过捆绑销售和增加竞标者来提高收益，并改进现有拍卖机制的近似界限，以解决捆绑销售中常数竞争是否足够的问题。
AI.method: 本文通过理论分析和数学证明来推导不同拍卖机制（独立销售、捆绑销售、第二价格拍卖）之间的收益关系。具体方法包括：1. 证明了对于独立常规商品，$\mathrm{REV} \le \mathrm{BSPA}_2 \le 2\,\mathrm{BREV}$。2. 证明了对于一般独立商品，$\mathrm{REV} \le \mathrm{SREV} + \frac{\pi^2}{6}\mathrm{BREV} \le 2.645 \max\{\mathrm{SREV}, \mathrm{BREV}\}$。3. 构造了一个实例来提供下界。
AI.result: 1. 对于独立常规商品，证明了$\mathrm{REV} \le \mathrm{BSPA}_2 \le 2\,\mathrm{BREV}$。这意味着一个额外的竞标者通过对大捆绑包进行无保留价的第二价格拍卖，可以匹配一个竞标者的最优收益。2. 解决了Beyhaghi等人提出的关于捆绑销售中常数竞争是否足够的问题。3. 证明了因子-2的捆绑近似是紧密的。4. 对于一般独立商品，将近似因子从之前的6和5.2改进到2.645。5. 构造了一个实例，将下界从2提高到2.11。6. 将紧密近似比的范围缩小到[2.11, 2.645]。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了一个关于捆绑销售的Bulow-Klemperer定理，表明对于独立常规商品，一个额外的竞标者足以使捆绑销售的第二价格拍卖达到最优收益。同时，本文显著改进了简单拍卖中一般独立商品的近似界限，并将紧密近似比的范围缩小到一个更精确的区间。
AI.translation:
我们研究了对一个加性竞标者的简单拍卖，其对m个商品的价值是独立的。我们用REV表示最优收益，SREV和BREV分别表示独立销售和整体捆绑销售的最优收益，BSPA2表示两个独立竞标者对整体捆绑包进行第二价格拍卖的收益。
对于独立常规商品，我们证明了REV ≤ BSPA2 ≤ 2·BREV。因此，一个额外的竞标者使得对整体捆绑包进行无保留价的第二价格拍卖能够匹配一个竞标者的最优收益，无论商品数量多少。这为捆绑销售提供了一个Bulow-Klemperer定理，并解决了Beyhaghi、Cai、Feng、Li和Weinberg（EC 2025）提出的关于捆绑销售中常数竞争是否足够的一个开放问题。因子-2的捆绑近似也是紧密的。
对于一般独立商品，我们证明了REV ≤ SREV + (π^2/6)BREV ≤ 2.645 max{SREV, BREV}。这改进了Babaioff、Immorlica、Lucier和Weinberg（FOCS 2014, JACM 2020）之前提出的6的近似因子和Ma和Simchi-Levi（AISTATS 2021）提出的5.2的近似因子。对于下界，我们构建了一个实例，其中对三个不相交的捆绑包定价获得的收益超过2.11 max{SREV, BREV}，改进了Rubinstein（ITCS 2016）之前提出的2的下界。总而言之，这些结果将紧密近似比的范围缩小到[2.11, 2.645]。
AI.summary: 本文研究了对单一加性竞标者的独立商品拍卖。对于独立常规商品，研究表明一个额外的竞标者通过捆绑销售的第二价格拍卖可以达到最优收益，并提出了捆绑销售的Bulow-Klemperer定理，解决了常数竞争是否足够的问题。对于一般独立商品，本文将最优收益的近似因子从6和5.2改进到2.645，并通过构造实例将下界提高到2.11，从而将紧密近似比的范围缩小到[2.11, 2.645]。
AI.keywords: 拍卖理论, 捆绑销售, Bulow-Klemperer定理, 近似算法, 收益优化
AI.comments: 本文在拍卖理论领域做出了重要贡献，特别是在捆绑销售和近似机制设计方面。它通过引入Bulow-Klemperer定理到捆绑销售语境中，解决了长期存在的关于常数竞争充分性的开放问题，具有创新性。同时，对一般独立商品近似界限的显著改进，将研究推向了更精确的理解，对于实际拍卖设计具有重要指导意义。其贡献在于理论深度和对现有界限的量化提升。

title: PanoDent-KD: From Generalist Knowledge Distillation to Cross-Dataset Specialist Detection and Embedded Deployment in Panoramic Radiographs
summary: Reliable panoramic-radiograph detection requires consistency across datasets with different class definitions and deployment software. We present PanoDent-KD, an auditable 1280-pixel YOLO26m pipeline linking a 12-class source generalist, feature-level knowledge distillation (KD), exact classifier-row transfer, teacher-free five-class specialization, and embedded deployment. A common training and evaluation pipeline compares three source-training arms across three seeds: a supervised baseline (B1), single-teacher KD (STKD), and multi-teacher KD (MTKD). Five shared classifier rows initialize nine OralXrays-9 specialists, while the backbone, FPN-PAN neck, and dual-detection-head topology are retained unchanged. On the 2,686-image test subset, all three arms achieve macro box F1 near 0.82. B1 achieves the highest three-seed arm-level mean macro box F1 (0.8239$\pm$0.0027) and $mAP_{50:95}$ (0.6130$\pm$0.0067). STKD seed 1, selected after development but before final testing, was used for deployment. Its Jetson Orin Nano Super FP16 TensorRT engine achieves 77.03-ms median and 80.86-ms P95 prediction-call latency, throughput of 12.90 images/s, and gross total-module energy of 1.39 J/image, with high numerical agreement between within-device PyTorch and TensorRT FP16 inference. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of an auditable, device-specific deployment workflow, but do not establish clinical validity or improved target-domain accuracy from KD.

AI.title_translation: PanoDent-KD：从通才知识蒸馏到跨数据集专科检测和全景X光片嵌入式部署
AI.tldr: PanoDent-KD提出了一种可审计的YOLO管线，通过知识蒸馏实现全景X光片的跨数据集专科检测和嵌入式部署，并在嵌入式设备上展示了可行性。
AI.motivation: 可靠的全景X光片检测需要跨不同类定义和部署软件的数据集保持一致性。
AI.method: 本研究提出了PanoDent-KD，一个可审计的1280像素YOLO26m管线，它结合了12类源通才模型、特征级知识蒸馏（KD）、精确分类器行迁移、无教师五类专科化和嵌入式部署。通过一个共同的训练和评估管线，比较了三种源训练分支（监督基线B1、单教师KD STKD、多教师KD MTKD）在三个种子下的表现。保留骨干网络、FPN-PAN颈部和双检测头拓扑结构不变，使用五个共享分类器行初始化九个OralXrays-9专科模型。
AI.result: 在2686张图像的测试子集上，所有三个分支的宏观框F1均接近0.82。B1实现了最高的三种子分支级别平均宏观框F1（0.8239±0.0027）和$mAP_{50:95}$（0.6130±0.0067）。用于部署的STKD种子1在Jetson Orin Nano Super FP16 TensorRT引擎上实现了77.03毫秒的中位数和80.86毫秒的P95预测调用延迟，吞吐量为12.90图像/秒，总模块能耗为1.39焦耳/图像，并且设备内PyTorch和TensorRT FP16推理之间具有高度的数值一致性。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现证明了可审计的、特定于设备的部署工作流程的可行性，但并未确立临床有效性或知识蒸馏对目标域准确性的改进。
AI.translation: 可靠的全景X光片检测需要跨不同类定义和部署软件的数据集保持一致性。我们提出了PanoDent-KD，一个可审计的1280像素YOLO26m管线，它连接了12类源通才模型、特征级知识蒸馏（KD）、精确分类器行迁移、无教师五类专科化和嵌入式部署。一个共同的训练和评估管线比较了三个源训练分支在三个种子下的表现：监督基线（B1）、单教师KD（STKD）和多教师KD（MTKD）。五个共享分类器行初始化了九个OralXrays-9专科模型，同时骨干网络、FPN-PAN颈部和双检测头拓扑结构保持不变。在2686张图像的测试子集上，所有三个分支的宏观框F1均接近0.82。B1实现了最高的三种子分支级别平均宏观框F1（0.8239±0.0027）和$mAP_{50:95}$（0.6130±0.0067）。在开发后但在最终测试前选择的STKD种子1用于部署。其Jetson Orin Nano Super FP16 TensorRT引擎实现了77.03毫秒的中位数和80.86毫秒的P95预测调用延迟，吞吐量为12.90图像/秒，总模块能耗为1.39焦耳/图像，并且设备内PyTorch和TensorRT FP16推理之间具有高度的数值一致性。这些发现证明了可审计的、特定于设备的部署工作流程的可行性，但并未确立临床有效性或知识蒸馏对目标域准确性的改进。
AI.summary: PanoDent-KD提出了一种基于1280像素YOLO26m的可审计管线，旨在解决全景X光片检测中跨数据集一致性和部署问题。该方法通过特征级知识蒸馏和分类器行迁移，将12类通才模型转换为五类专科模型，并实现了在嵌入式设备上的高效部署。实验结果表明，在检测性能上，监督基线略优于知识蒸馏方法，但该研究成功验证了可审计、设备特定部署工作流程的可行性，尽管尚未确立临床有效性或KD带来的准确性提升。
AI.keywords: 知识蒸馏, 全景X光片, 嵌入式部署, 跨数据集, YOLO
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个端到端的可审计管线PanoDent-KD，实现了从通用模型到特定领域模型的知识蒸馏和跨数据集的专业化检测，并成功部署到嵌入式设备。这对于资源受限的医疗影像设备具有重要意义。然而，论文也明确指出，知识蒸馏并未带来目标域准确性的显著提升，且尚未建立临床有效性，这提示未来研究需进一步优化知识蒸度策略并进行临床验证。

title: MuLaCover: Flexible Cover Song Generation via Symbolic Tonal Control
summary: A cover song re-renders an existing piece, most commonly by preserving its tonal content -- melody and chord progression -- while reshaping other musical attributes. This suggests a natural formulation for generative cover synthesis with pretrained music language models: explicitly control tonal content, while specifying lyrics and style through text. Existing approaches condition on frame-level features, tightly coupling generation to the reference's timing and structure, and limiting flexibility such as tempo variation, structural rearrangement, or partial conditioning. To this end, we present MuLaCover, a cover generation model that conditions a pretrained text-to-song foundation model on an editable symbolic lead sheet. Our design enables alignment-free control: generated outputs preserve the tonal signature of the source without frame-level alignment, allowing flexible timing, structure, and segment-level generation. We further introduce a training curriculum with partially mismatched audio-symbolic pairs, improving diversity and robustness. We evaluate MuLaCover with objective metrics, standard subjective ratings, and in-depth expert interviews that provide fine-grained diagnostic insights. Experiments show that MuLaCover achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source systems and is competitive with leading commercial models such as Suno-v5.5. Audio samples and code are available at our project page: https://mulalabs.ai/mulacover/

AI.title_translation: MuLaCover：通过符号音调控制实现灵活的翻唱歌曲生成
AI.tldr: MuLaCover是一个新的翻唱歌曲生成模型，通过可编辑的符号乐谱控制音调内容，实现灵活的生成，无需帧级对齐，并在开源系统中达到SOTA，与商业模型竞争。
AI.motivation: 现有的翻唱歌曲生成方法依赖于帧级特征，导致生成与参考作品的时序和结构紧密耦合，限制了如速度变化、结构重排或部分条件控制等灵活性。
AI.method: 本文提出了MuLaCover模型，它将预训练的文本到歌曲基础模型与可编辑的符号主旋律谱表相结合。该设计实现了无对齐控制，在不进行帧级对齐的情况下保留了音源的音调特征，允许灵活的时序、结构和片段级生成。此外，还引入了包含部分不匹配的音频-符号对的训练课程，以提高多样性和鲁棒性。
AI.result: MuLaCover在客观指标、标准主观评分和专家访谈中进行了评估。实验表明，MuLaCover在开源系统中达到了最先进的性能，并与Suno-v5.5等领先的商业模型具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: MuLaCover通过符号音调控制实现了灵活的翻唱歌曲生成，解决了现有方法的局限性，并在性能上表现出色。
AI.translation: 翻唱歌曲是对现有作品的重新演绎，通常在保留其音调内容（旋律和和弦进行）的同时，重塑其他音乐属性。这为使用预训练音乐语言模型进行生成式翻唱合成提供了一个自然的公式：明确控制音调内容，同时通过文本指定歌词和风格。现有方法以帧级特征为条件，将生成与参考作品的时序和结构紧密耦合，限制了灵活性，例如速度变化、结构重排或部分条件控制。为此，我们提出了MuLaCover，一个翻唱生成模型，它以可编辑的符号主旋律谱表为条件，控制一个预训练的文本到歌曲基础模型。我们的设计实现了无对齐控制：生成输出在没有帧级对齐的情况下保留了音源的音调特征，允许灵活的时序、结构和片段级生成。我们进一步引入了一个包含部分不匹配的音频-符号对的训练课程，以提高多样性和鲁棒性。我们通过客观指标、标准主观评分和深入的专家访谈来评估MuLaCover，这些访谈提供了细致的诊断见解。实验表明，MuLaCover在开源系统中取得了最先进的性能，并与Suno-v5.5等领先的商业模型具有竞争力。音频样本和代码可在我们的项目页面获取：https://mulalabs.ai/mulacover/
AI.summary: MuLaCover是一个创新的翻唱歌曲生成模型，它通过将预训练的文本到歌曲模型与可编辑的符号乐谱相结合，解决了现有方法在灵活性上的局限性。该模型实现了无对齐的音调控制，允许用户自由调整歌曲的时序、结构和片段，同时保持原曲的音调特征。通过引入特殊的训练课程，模型的多样性和鲁棒性也得到了提升。评估结果显示，MuLaCover在开源系统中表现出最先进的性能，并能与顶级的商业模型竞争。
AI.keywords: 翻唱歌曲生成, 符号音调控制, 音乐语言模型, 无对齐控制, 灵活生成
AI.comments: MuLaCover的创新之处在于其“无对齐控制”的设计，通过利用可编辑的符号主旋律谱表，摆脱了传统帧级特征的束缚，极大地提升了翻唱歌曲生成的灵活性，允许用户进行更自由的创作，如速度、结构和片段的调整。这对于音乐创作者和研究者来说是一个重要的进步，因为它使得生成式音乐更具可控性和实用性。其在开源系统中的SOTA表现以及与商业模型的竞争力，也凸显了其技术实力和应用潜力。

title: RefCraft: Benchmarking Visual-Reference-Conditioned Agentic Generation through Web Development
summary: Beyond basic tool use and coding skills, effectively incorporating visual references into agentic generation is equally essential for applying AI agents to real-world productivity tasks. We study this crucial capability through webpage development, a practical and readily evaluable setting in which existing benchmarks remain largely idealized: they typically focus on reconstructing visual targets or generating webpages from textual instructions alone, overlooking the more common workflow of developing from visual examples. Specifically, we introduce RefCraft, a benchmark comprising 300 realistic multimodal webpage-development tasks that combine natural-language instructions with screenshots from one to five reference webpages. Agents must selectively interpret and utilize these references while rendering, visually inspecting, and iteratively refining their outputs. We evaluate the resulting open-ended artifacts using independently verifiable keypoints and complementary programmatic and VLM judges. Across nine frontier (M)LLMs, the strongest system achieves an overall score of only 52.12 out of 100, revealing that visual-reference-conditioned agentic generation remains a substantial challenge for current models in practical webpage-development settings.

AI.title_translation: RefCraft：通过网页开发对视觉参考条件下的智能体生成进行基准测试
AI.tldr: 本文提出了RefCraft基准测试，用于评估AI智能体根据视觉参考进行网页开发的能力，结果发现当前前沿大模型在该任务上的表现普遍较差（最高仅52.12分）。
AI.motivation: 现有的智能体基准测试通常局限于从文本指令重构视觉目标或生成网页，忽视了实际工作流中更常见的“根据视觉示例进行开发”的需求，因此需要研究如何有效将视觉参考纳入智能体生成中。
AI.method: 引入了RefCraft基准，包含300个多模态网页开发任务（结合自然语言指令和1-5个参考网页截图），要求智能体进行选择性解释、渲染、视觉检查和迭代优化，并使用独立验证的关键点、程序化以及VLM评判器进行综合评估。
AI.result: 在评估的9个前沿（多模态）大模型中，表现最好的系统总分仅为52.12分（满分100分），表明当前模型处理视觉参考条件下的智能体网页开发任务仍面临巨大挑战。
AI.conclusion: 当前的（多模态）大模型在结合视觉参考进行智能体网页开发任务上表现不足，最强系统得分也仅刚过半数，证明视觉参考条件下的智能体生成是一个亟待攻克的难题。
AI.translation: 除了基本的工具使用和编码技能外，将视觉参考有效地结合到智能体生成中，对于将AI智能体应用于真实世界的生产力任务同样至关重要。我们通过网页开发这一实用且易于评估的场景研究了这一关键能力，现有的基准测试在这一场景下大多仍显理想化：它们通常侧重于重构视觉目标或仅从文本指令生成网页，忽略了从视觉示例进行开发的更常见工作流。具体而言，我们引入了RefCraft，这是一个包含300个真实多模态网页开发任务的基准测试，它将自然语言指令与来自1到5个参考网页的截图相结合。智能体在渲染、视觉检查和迭代优化其输出时，必须选择性地解释和利用这些参考内容。我们使用独立可验证的关键点以及互补的程序化和VLM评判器来评估这些开放式产物。在9个前沿（多模态）大模型中，最强的系统总得分仅为52.12分（满分100分），这表明在实际的网页开发环境中，视觉参考条件下的智能体生成对当前模型而言仍然是一个重大的挑战。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了RefCraft基准测试，用于评估大模型在结合自然语言指令和多个视觉参考截图的网页开发任务中的表现。评估结果显示，现有的前沿大模型在该任务上的得分普遍较低，凸显了视觉参考条件下的智能体生成的巨大挑战。
AI.keywords: 视觉参考, 智能体生成, 网页开发, 多模态基准, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文填补了评估智能体在网页开发中利用视觉参考能力的研究空白，提出的RefCraft基准测试真实且具有挑战性，揭示了当前前沿大模型在该任务上的巨大提升空间。

title: A latent control model for realistic rodent motion
comments: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 10 pages, 13 figures. Project page with supplementary videos: https://aidansirbu.com/SCAMPER-site/
summary: The development of embodied models of animal behavior is a major goal of the neuro-AI community. Embodied models will enhance our ability to make direct comparisons between biological and artificial agents. To make such comparisons effective, though, we need embodied models that actually move like animals. Previous work has developed virtual animal bodies and techniques for training realistic motion through imitation. However, to date, there is no system for embodied animal modeling that produces natural movements both during trained goal-directed behavior, and during exploration driven by random generation. Here, we introduce Simulated Control via Augmented Motor Priors for Embodied Reinforcement learning (SCAMPER), a system for training an embodied virtual rat model, enabling natural movements during both goal-directed behavior and random exploration. SCAMPER uses a variational architecture with two distinct priors, a motion prior for control and a behavior prior for exploration. We show that combining both of these priors allows SCAMPER to generate realistic behavior during exploration and exploit the task structure effectively. SCAMPER can also learn from sparse rewards as a result of the diverse movements induced by the behavior prior, allowing the system to model realistic sparse-reward tasks from experimental neuroscience. Altogether, SCAMPER provides the neuro-AI community with an effective new system for training embodied models of rodents on realistic tasks.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 10 pages, 13 figures. Project page with supplementary videos: https://aidansirbu.com/SCAMPER-site/

AI.title_translation: 用于真实啮齿动物运动的潜在控制模型
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为SCAMPER的新型具身强化学习系统，通过结合双重先验，使虚拟大鼠在目标导向和随机探索中均能展现出逼真的动作。
AI.motivation: 为了弥补现有具身动物模型无法在训练的目标导向行为和随机生成的探索过程中同时产生自然运动的缺陷，从而更好地促进生物与人工智能代理之间的直接比较。
AI.method: 提出SCAMPER（Simulated Control via Augmented Motor Priors for Embodied Reinforcement learning）系统，采用包含两个不同先验（用于控制的运动先验和用于探索的行为先验）的变分架构。
AI.result: 实验表明，SCAMPER能够通过结合运动先验和行为先验，在探索过程中生成逼真的行为，有效利用任务结构，并能从稀疏奖励中学习，从而对神经科学实验中的稀疏奖励任务进行真实建模。
AI.conclusion: SCAMPER系统通过结合运动先验和行为先验，成功实现了具身虚拟大鼠在目标导向与随机探索下的真实运动，并能有效处理稀疏奖励任务，为神经AI社区提供了强大的具身建模新系统。
AI.translation: 构建具身动物行为模型是神经AI社区的主要目标。具身模型将增强我们直接比较生物和人工代理的能力。然而，为了使这种比较有效，我们需要真正像动物一样运动的具身模型。先前的研究开发了虚拟动物身体以及通过模仿训练真实运动的技术。然而，迄今为止，还没有一个具身动物建模系统能够在训练有素的目标导向行为和随机生成的探索驱动下都产生自然运动。在这里，我们引入了用于具身强化学习的增强运动先验模拟控制（SCAMPER），这是一个用于训练具身虚拟大鼠模型的系统，它使自然运动能够在目标导向行为和随机探索中实现。SCAMPER使用具有两个不同先验的变分架构：用于控制的运动先验和用于探索的行为先验。我们表明，结合这两个先验允许SCAMPER在探索过程中生成真实的行为并有效地利用任务结构。由于行为先验引起的各种运动，SCAMPER还可以从稀疏奖励中学习，从而允许系统对来自实验神经学的现实稀疏奖励任务进行建模。总之，SCAMPER为神经AI社区提供了一个有效的新系统，用于在真实任务上训练啮齿动物的具身模型。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了SCAMPER系统，这是一种用于训练具身虚拟大鼠模型的新型潜在控制模型。通过结合控制的运动先验和探索的行为先验，该系统能够在目标导向行为和随机探索中均产生逼真的运动，并能有效应对神经科学中的稀疏奖励任务。
AI.keywords: 具身模型, 神经AI, 强化学习, 运动先验, 虚拟大鼠
AI.comments: 该论文在神经AI领域具有重要意义，通过引入SCAMPER模型和双先验架构，成功解决了虚拟动物模型在目标导向和随机探索中难以同时保持动作真实性的难题，为生物与人工智能的对比研究提供了强大的工具。

title: EchoNav: Evidential BEV Completion from Historical Observations for Visual Navigation
summary: Visual navigation in cluttered environments requires robots to recover previously observed structure and infer obstacles and free space that remain occluded. We present a framework that combines temporal aggregation and occupancy completion in an evidential bird's-eye-view (BEV) representation predicted from short RGB sequences. A decoder adapts frozen VGGT-Omega features and combines historical residual proposals using cellwise weights and a learned no-update option. The BEV predictor produces a local map in the latest ego frame without depth or camera-pose inputs or explicit geometric warping. The evidential model treats observed free space separately and predicts occupancy with associated confidence across the remaining supported region. We train the predictor on simulated RGB sequences paired with complete and visibility-masked occupancy annotations. Our experiments evaluate navigation in simulation and on a wheeled robot, with additional demonstrations on quadruped and humanoid robots. In simulated sequential two-goal navigation, our system achieves 86.3% success, outperforming the strongest evaluated baseline by 32.2 percentage points. Across 60 wheeled-robot trials in 20 scenes, it achieves 73.3% success, compared with 33.3% for the strongest evaluated baseline.

AI.title_translation: EchoNav：基于历史观测的证据式BEV补全用于视觉导航
AI.tldr: EchoNav是一个利用历史观测进行证据式鸟瞰图（BEV）补全的框架，显著提高了机器人在复杂环境中的视觉导航成功率。
AI.motivation: 在杂乱环境中进行视觉导航时，机器人需要恢复之前观察到的结构，并推断被遮挡的障碍物和自由空间。
AI.method: EchoNav框架结合了时间聚合和占用补全，生成了来自短RGB序列的证据式鸟瞰图（BEV）表示。它使用解码器适配冻结的VGGT-Omega特征，并通过单元格权重和学习到的“不更新”选项结合历史残差提案。BEV预测器在最新的自我坐标系中生成局部地图，无需深度、相机姿态输入或显式几何扭曲。证据模型独立处理观察到的自由空间，并预测剩余支持区域的占用及其置信度。该预测器在模拟RGB序列上进行训练，并配有完整和可见性遮蔽的占用注释。
AI.result: 在模拟顺序双目标导航中，系统取得了86.3%的成功率，比最强的基线高出32.2个百分点。在20个场景的60次轮式机器人试验中，系统取得了73.3%的成功率，而最强的基线为33.3%。此外，还在四足和人形机器人上进行了演示。
AI.conclusion: EchoNav通过结合时间聚合和证据式BEV补全，显著提高了机器人在杂乱环境中的视觉导航成功率，在模拟和真实机器人实验中均表现出色。
AI.translation: 在杂乱环境中进行视觉导航需要机器人恢复之前观察到的结构，并推断被遮挡的障碍物和自由空间。我们提出了一个框架，该框架结合了时间聚合和占用补全，以一种从短RGB序列预测的证据式鸟瞰图（BEV）表示。一个解码器适配冻结的VGGT-Omega特征，并使用单元格权重和学习到的“不更新”选项结合历史残差提案。BEV预测器在最新的自我坐标系中生成局部地图，无需深度或相机姿态输入，也无需显式几何扭曲。证据模型独立处理观察到的自由空间，并预测剩余支持区域的占用及其相关置信度。我们在模拟RGB序列上训练该预测器，并配有完整和可见性遮蔽的占用注释。我们的实验评估了模拟和轮式机器人上的导航，并附加了在四足和人形机器人上的演示。在模拟顺序双目标导航中，我们的系统取得了86.3%的成功率，比最强的评估基线高出32.2个百分点。在20个场景的60次轮式机器人试验中，它取得了73.3%的成功率，而最强的评估基线为33.3%。
AI.summary: EchoNav是一个针对杂乱环境中视觉导航的框架，它通过结合时间聚合和占用补全，从短RGB序列预测证据式鸟瞰图（BEV）表示。该系统无需深度或相机姿态输入，利用学习到的解码器和证据模型来恢复历史结构并推断被遮挡的障碍物和自由空间。实验结果表明，EchoNav在模拟和真实轮式机器人导航任务中均显著优于现有基线，成功率分别达到了86.3%和73.3%。
AI.keywords: 视觉导航, BEV补全, 时间聚合, 证据式模型, 占用预测
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个无需显式几何扭曲、深度或相机姿态输入即可进行BEV补全的端到端框架。其证据模型能够有效处理观测到的自由空间和未知的占用区域，并提供置信度，这对于不确定性较高的导航任务非常重要。在多种机器人平台上的成功演示也表明了其方法的泛化能力和实用性。

title: AEON: Unifying Video and 3D World Models
comments: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project Page: https://weiqi-zhang.github.io/AEON
summary: Current world models for explicit world simulation typically follow two distinct pathways: (1) video generative models (e.g., Sora), which simulate realistic appearances but fail to preserve 3D consistency; and (2) 3D generative models (e.g., Marble), which generate geometrically consistent scenes but often yield static, less realistic observations. We present AEON, a unified framework that bridges video-based and 3D-based world models and combines the benefits of both. The key insight of AEON lies in a generative model that operates within the text- or image-conditioned video latent space while producing renderable 4D graphics primitives---specifically, 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS)---as the explicit world representation. We train a 4D reconstruction model to predict both 4DGS and camera poses from monocular videos, serving as our initialized 4D decoder. Furthermore, we design a domain adapter that translates generative video latents into reconstructive 4D latents through a distillation process on the video VAE. AEON naturally supports video-based world modeling by rendering 4DGS at predicted camera trajectories, and constructs a persistent 4D environment with scene dynamics for realistic world simulation. Consequently, AEON empowers a diverse range of world modeling applications and achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks. Project Page: https://weiqi-zhang.github.io/AEON
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project Page: https://weiqi-zhang.github.io/AEON

AI.tldr: AEON是一个统一框架，通过在视频潜在空间中生成4D高斯泼溅来结合视频和3D世界模型的优点，解决了现有模型在3D一致性和真实感方面的不足，实现了逼真且动态的4D环境模拟，并取得了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前的世界模型分为视频生成模型（如Sora，缺乏3D一致性）和3D生成模型（如Marble，静态且不够真实）两种途径，AEON的动机是弥合这两种模型的不足，结合两者的优点，实现既真实又具有3D一致性的世界模拟。
